InvalidDataResponse2.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure where the provided date value for Available_Dates is not in the accepted format. The response identifies the field and the expected data type.

DependentMismatchResponse3.summary: Dependent mismatch when Duration does not satisfy service timing

data.message: Duration does not satisfy the service timing

DependentMismatchResponse3.description: Returned when the Duration field does not satisfy the service timing constraint imposed by the Status dependee. The response includes code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and identifies Duration as the offending field.

DependentFieldMissingResponse1.summary: DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error when Unavailable_From is absent and Status is its dependee.
DependentFieldMissingResponse1.description: Represents an error response in which a required dependent field was omitted from the request. The error identifies Unavailable_From as the missing field, with Status acting as its dependee, indicating that Unavailable_From must be provided whenever the service status implies unavailability.

LimitExceededResponse1.summary: LIMIT_EXCEEDED error when more than five members are associated with a service

data.message: More than 100 users cannot be associated

LimitExceededResponse1.description: Shows a LIMIT_EXCEEDED failure returned when the Members array contains more than five users for a single service. The response identifies the Members field and its position in the request payload.

LimitExceededResponse2.summary: LIMIT_EXCEEDED error when the 500-active-service limit for the organization is reached

data.message: You cannot create more than 500 active services

LimitExceededResponse2.description: Shows a LIMIT_EXCEEDED failure returned when the organization has reached the maximum of 500 active services. The response identifies the constraint at the record level.

DependentMismatchResponse7.summary: Dependent mismatch when Job_Sheet_Section__s requires Job_Sheet_Required is Yes

data.message: Job_Sheet_Section__s can have value only when value of Job_Sheet_Required is Yes

DependentMismatchResponse7.description: Returned when Job_Sheet_Section__s is provided but Job_Sheet_Required is not set to Yes. The response includes code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and identifies Job_Sheet_Section__s as the field that cannot hold a value under this condition.

DependentMismatchResponse8.summary: Dependent mismatch when Available_Timings To must be greater than From.

data.message: To value must be Greater than From value

DependentMismatchResponse8.description: Returned when the To time in Available_Timings is not greater than the corresponding From time. The response includes code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH with the json_path $.data[0].Available_Timings[0].To identifying the offending value.

DependentMismatchResponse9.summary: Dependent mismatch when Available_Dates falls on a holiday or non-business day.

data.message: Available Dates value in holiday or Not in BusinessDays

DependentMismatchResponse9.description: Returned when an Available_Dates value falls on a holiday or a non-business day. The response includes code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH with Status as the dependee field driving the constraint.

InvalidDataResponse3.summary: Invalid data error when a Members entry is an unconfirmed user
InvalidDataResponse3.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure returned when one of the Members is an unconfirmed user. The response identifies the Members field and its JSON path in the request payload.

InvalidDataResponse4.summary: Invalid data error when a Members entry is an inactive user
InvalidDataResponse4.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure returned when one of the Members is an inactive user. The response identifies the Members field and its JSON path in the request payload.

InvalidDataResponse5.summary: Invalid data type error for the Job_Sheet_Required field
InvalidDataResponse5.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure for the Job_Sheet_Required field, indicating that the supplied value is of an invalid data type. The response identifies the field and its position in the request payload.

InvalidDataResponse6.summary: Invalid data error for the Available_Timings request payload.
InvalidDataResponse6.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure for the Available_Timings field, indicating that the request payload for Available_Timings is invalid. The response identifies the field by name and JSON path.

MandatoryNotFoundResponse1.summary: MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND error when a required service field is missing from the request
MandatoryNotFoundResponse1.description: Shows a MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND failure returned when a required service field is absent from the request. The response identifies the missing field by name and JSON path.

DependentMismatchResponse10.summary: An error when Unavailable_From violates null rule when status is Available.

data.message: When the service status is available, Unavailable From must be greater than current date

DependentMismatchResponse10.description:
Represents an error response returned when the service status is set to Available but the Unavailable_From field violates the null constraint.

This DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error requires that when status is Available, either both Unavailable_From and Unavailable_Till are null, or only Unavailable_From may carry a value.

DependentMismatchResponse11.summary: An error when Unavailable_Till not greater than current time

data.message: Unavailable Till must be greater than current Time.

DependentMismatchResponse11.description:
Represents an error response returned when Unavailable_Till is not set to a datetime greater than the current time. 

This DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error is triggered when status is Temporarily Unavailable and the supplied Unavailable_Till value fails the future-datetime constraint.

DependentMismatchResponse12.summary: An error when invalid Unavailable_Till supplied when status is Available

data.message: When the service status is available,  either both Unavailable From and Unavailable Till must be null, or only Unavailable From can have a value.

DependentMismatchResponse12.description: Represents an error response returned when status is Available but only one of Unavailable_From or Unavailable_Till is supplied. This DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error enforces that when status is Available, either both fields are null or only Unavailable_From may carry a value.

DependentMismatchResponse13.summary: Dependent mismatch when Unavailable Till must be before Unavailable From

data.message: Unavailable Till must be lesser than Unavailable From

DependentMismatchResponse13.description: Represents an error response returned when the supplied Unavailable_Till value is not less than Unavailable_From. This DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error enforces the chronological ordering constraint between the two unavailability boundary fields.

DependentMismatchResponse14.summary: Dependent mismatch when past Available_From blocks Available/Scheduled status

data.message: Service status cannot be marked as Not In Use or Temporarily Unavailable for scheduled services.

DependentMismatchResponse14.description: Illustrates a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the Available_From date falls before the current date. A service with a past start date cannot be set to a status of Available, Scheduled, or Temporarily Unavailable.

DependentMismatchResponse15.summary: Dependent mismatch when past Available_Till blocks Available/Scheduled status

data.message: Services status cannot be marked as Not In Use when Unavailable From falls after the current Date

DependentMismatchResponse15.description: Illustrates a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the Available_Till date falls before the current date. A service with a past end date cannot be set to a status of Available, Scheduled, or Temporarily Unavailable.

DependentMismatchResponse16.summary: Dependent mismatch when past Available_From prevents Scheduled status

data.message: Starting date of service availability falls before the current Date, so service cannot be marked as Scheduled

DependentMismatchResponse16.description: Illustrates a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the Available_From date falls before the current date. A service with a past start date cannot be marked as Scheduled.

DependentMismatchResponse17.summary: Dependent mismatch when past Available_Till blocks Available/Scheduled/Temp Unavailable

data.message: End Date of service availability falls before the current Date, so service cannot be marked as Available or Scheduled or Temporarily Unavailable

DependentMismatchResponse17.description: Illustrates a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the Available_Till date falls before the current date. A service with a past end date cannot be set to a status of Available, Scheduled, or Temporarily Unavailable.

InvalidDataResponse7.summary: Invalid data error when Unavailable_From falls outside the service availability window.

data.message: Unavailable From time does not fall within service availability

InvalidDataResponse7.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure where the Unavailable_From time does not fall within the configured service availability window. The response identifies the Unavailable_From field and its position in the request.

DependentFieldMissingResponse2.summary: An error when Available_From missing when Availability_Type is Specific Date Range
DependentFieldMissingResponse2.description: Represents an error response in which Available_From was omitted while Availability_Type was set to Specific Date Range. The error identifies Availability_Type as the dependee, indicating that a start date must be supplied whenever a date-range availability type is selected.

InvalidDataResponse8.summary: Invalid data error when an Available_Dates value falls on a holiday or non-business day

value.message: invalid data

InvalidDataResponse8.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure for the Available_Dates field, indicating that one of the specified dates is a holiday or falls on a non-business day. The response identifies the field and its position in the request payload.

InvalidDataResponse9.summary: Invalid data type error for the Status field
InvalidDataResponse9.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure for the Status field, indicating that the supplied value is of an incorrect data type. The response identifies the field by name and JSON path.

InvalidDataResponse10.summary: Invalid data error when Available_From has an invalid date format.
InvalidDataResponse10.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure for the Available_From field, indicating that the supplied value does not conform to the required YYYY-MM-DD date format.

InvalidDataResponse11.summary: Invalid data error when Available_Till has an invalid date format.
InvalidDataResponse11.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure for the Available_Till field, indicating that the supplied value does not conform to the required date format.

InvalidDataResponse12.summary: Invalid data error when Duration is outside the permitted 5-min to 24-hr range.

data.message: Duration value should not be greater than 24hrs or less than 5mins

InvalidDataResponse12.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure for the Duration field, indicating that the supplied value falls outside the permitted range of five minutes to 24 hours.

NotAllowedResponse1.summary: NOT_ALLOWED error when Job Sheet is not configured in service preferences

data.message: Job Sheet is not configured in services preferences

NotAllowedResponse1.description: Shows a NOT_ALLOWED failure returned when Job Sheet is not configured in the organization's service preferences. The response indicates that job sheet must be enabled before services requiring it can be created or updated.

NotAllowedResponse2.summary: NOT_ALLOWED error when past availability dates prevent an Active or Temporarily Unavailable status change

data.message: As service availability is not valid, status cannot be changed

NotAllowedResponse2.description: Shows a NOT_ALLOWED failure returned when the service availability dates are in the past and the status cannot be changed to Available or Temporarily Unavailable. The response identifies the constraint.

MandatoryNotFoundResponse2.summary: MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND error when another required field is absent from the request
MandatoryNotFoundResponse2.description: Shows a MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND failure returned when a required field is not present in the request payload. The response identifies the absent field by name and its position in the request.

MandatoryNotFoundResponse3.summary: MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND error when a third required field is absent from the request
MandatoryNotFoundResponse3.description: Shows a MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND failure returned when a third required field is missing from the request payload. The response identifies the field by name and JSON path.

InvalidDataResponse13.summary: Invalid data error when Available_Timings From or To is not in HH:MM format.

data.message: The given custom time is invalid

InvalidDataResponse13.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure for a From or To field within Available_Timings, indicating that the supplied time value does not conform to the required HH:MM 24-hour format.

InvalidDataResponse14.summary: Invalid data type error for the Owner field
InvalidDataResponse14.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure for the Owner field, indicating that the supplied value is not of the expected object data type.

InvalidDataResponse15.summary: Invalid data error when Available_Till has an invalid value
InvalidDataResponse15.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA failure for the Available_Till field, indicating that the supplied value is not valid. The response identifies the offending field and its position in the request payload.

post.summary: Create service records in Zoho CRM
post.description: To create one or more service records in your Zoho CRM organization, submitting up to 100 service objects per request, each configurable with a name, duration, price, location, members, availability type, and availability window.

requestBody.description: The request body must contain a data array. You can include a maximum of 100 objects per request.

SamplePostRequest.summary: Successful creation of a service with specific-day availability and job-sheet configuration
SamplePostRequest.description: Shows a complete service create request for a 60-minute AC Repair service with specific-day availability on Monday and Tuesday, client-address location, an available status, and a job-sheet requirement referencing the Standard job sheet section.

201.description: Returns a data array confirming the successful creation of each service record. Each item contains the success code, the ID assigned to the created record, and audit metadata including the creation and last-modified timestamps and the users who performed those actions.

Success201.summary: Successful single-record service creation returning a 201 with new record ID and audit metadata.
Success201.description: Shows the success response returned after the API creates a single service record successfully, including the new record ID, creation and modification timestamps, and the identities of the users who created and last modified the record.

207.description: Returns a multi-status response when the submitted service records yield mixed outcomes. Each item in the data array independently indicates success or failure for its corresponding record. Successful operation include the created record's ID and audit metadata, while failed items include the error code and a description of the validation failure.

schema.description: Represents the multi-status response returned when some service records were created successfully and others encountered errors. Contains a data array with one entry per service record submitted in the request; each entry independently indicates success or failure for its corresponding record.

data.description: Contains one entry per service record submitted in the request, indicating success or failure for the corresponding record.

items.description: Represents one entry in the multi-status data array. Each item is either a success object containing the created record's ID and audit metadata, or an error object describing the validation failure for the corresponding service record.

Success207.summary: Partial batch success with one record created and one rejected due to an invalid Duration value.
Success207.description: Shows the multi-status response returned when a batch request partially succeeds: the API creates the first record and assigns a new ID, while rejecting the second record with an INVALID_DATA error indicating that the Duration value falls outside the permitted range.

400.description:
The request could not be processed because one or more service records contain invalid data, fail a field-level validation check, or violate a service-availability constraint.

**Resolution:** The caller must inspect each error item to identify the offending field, correct the request payload accordingly, and resubmit the request.

oneOf.description: Represents the wrapped error response returned when one or more service records in the request fail per-record validation. Contains a data array where each item describes the specific validation failure for the corresponding service record.

data.description: Contains one error entry for each service record in the request that failed validation, describing the specific reason the record was rejected.

items.description: Represents a single validation error for a rejected service record. Each item identifies the affected field, the error code, and a descriptive message explaining why the record failed. For example, an invalid data type, a missing mandatory field, an unavailable status, or a dependent field mismatch.

schema.description: Represents the bad-request error response returned when the request payload or query parameters fail validation. Contains one of several error structures depending on whether the failure is a top-level data-type error, a per-record validation error, or an invalid value for a data field.

InvalidDataResponse1.summary: Availability_Type value rejected as not a valid picklist entry.

data.message: The given Availability Type is not in picklist

InvalidDataResponse1.description: Shows an error returned when the value supplied for Availability_Type is not a recognised picklist option. The API responds with code INVALID_DATA, identifying the field and indicating that only predefined picklist values are accepted.

DependentMismatchResponse1.summary: Dependent mismatch error when Available_Days conflict with business days.

data.message: The given Available Days are not there in business days

DependentMismatchResponse1.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the Available_Days values do not align with the business days defined by the Availability_Type field. The API rejects the request with a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error indicating that Available_Days must be a subset of the configured business days.

DependentMismatchResponse2.summary: Dependent mismatch where Available_Timings value does not satisfy business timing constraints.

data.message: Service available time does not satisfy the business timing

DependentMismatchResponse2.description:
Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the service's Available_Timings fall outside the configured business hours while the Status is Available. 

The API rejects the request because the service availability window must align with the organisation's business timing configuration.

InvalidDataResponse2.summary: Available_Dates contains a value in an invalid date format.
InvalidDataResponse2.description: Shows the INVALID_DATA error returned when the Available_Dates field contains a value that does not conform to the required YYYY-MM-DD date format. The API rejects the request with an invalid data message.

InvalidDataResponse3.summary: Invalid data when duration value is outside allowed range.

data.message: Duration value should not be greater than 24hrs or less than 5mins

InvalidDataResponse3.description: Shows the INVALID_DATA error returned when the Duration field contains a value outside the permitted range of five minutes to 24 hours. The API rejects the request with a message indicating the duration constraint violation.

NotAllowedResponse1.summary: Not allowed when job sheets not configured in service preferences.

data.message: Job Sheet is not configured in services preferences

NotAllowedResponse1.description: Returned when Job_Sheet_Required is set to Yes but job sheets have not been enabled in the organization's service preferences. The API rejects the request with a NOT_ALLOWED error on the Job_Sheet_Required field.

DependentMismatchResponse3.summary: Dependent mismatch where Duration does not fit within the configured service timing window.

data.message: Duration does not satisfy the service timing

DependentMismatchResponse3.description: Shows an error returned when the service Duration does not fall within the configured available timings. The API responds with code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH, identifying Duration as the field whose value conflicts with the Status-driven timing requirement.

MandatoryNotFoundResponse1.summary: Mandatory not found when required Members field is missing
MandatoryNotFoundResponse1.description: Returned when the required Members field is absent from the request payload. The API rejects the request with a MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND error identifying Members as the missing required field.

DependentFieldMissingResponse1.summary: DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error when Available_From is omitted despite Availability_Type being set.
DependentFieldMissingResponse1.description: Shows a DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error response triggered when the Availability_Type field is provided but its required dependent field, Available_From, is omitted from the request payload.

InvalidDataResponse5.summary: Invalid data when Unavailable_From time is outside service availability.

data.message: Unavailable From time does not fall within service availability

InvalidDataResponse5.description: Returned when the Unavailable_From time does not fall within the configured service availability window. The API rejects the request with an INVALID_DATA error indicating the time value is out of range.

LimitExceededResponse1.summary: Limit exceeded when Members array exceeds 100-user maximum.

data.message: More than 100 users cannot be associated

LimitExceededResponse1.description: Returned when the Members array contains more than 100 users, exceeding the per-service member limit. The API rejects the request with a LIMIT_EXCEEDED error on the Members field.

LimitExceededResponse2.summary: Limit exceeded when organization has reached 500 active services.

data.message: You cannot create more than 500 active services

LimitExceededResponse2.description: Returned when the organization has already reached the maximum of 500 active services and a new service with an active status is submitted. The API rejects the request with a LIMIT_EXCEEDED error on the Status field.

DependentMismatchResponse7.summary: Dependent mismatch where Job_Sheet_Section__s is set but Job_Sheet_Required is No.

data.message: Job_Sheet_Section__s can have value only when value of Job_Sheet_Required is Yes

DependentMismatchResponse7.description: Shows an error returned when Job_Sheet_Section__s is supplied but Job_Sheet_Required is set to No. The API responds with code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH, indicating that Job_Sheet_Section__s may only carry a value when its controlling field Job_Sheet_Required is set to Yes.

DependentMismatchResponse8.summary: Dependent mismatch where the Available_Timings To value is not greater than the From value.

data.message: To value must be Greater than From value

DependentMismatchResponse8.description: Shows an error returned when the To time in an Available_Timings window is not later than the corresponding From time. The API responds with code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH, identifying the To field as invalid because a valid availability window requires To to be strictly greater than From.

DependentMismatchResponse9.summary: Dependent mismatch where Available_Dates includes a holiday or non-business day.

data.message: Available Dates value in holiday or Not in BusinessDays

DependentMismatchResponse9.description: Shows an error returned when one or more dates provided in Available_Dates fall on a holiday or outside configured business days. The API responds with code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH, indicating that all Available_Dates values must correspond to valid, non-holiday business days.

InvalidDataResponse6.summary: Invalid data when custom time value in Available_Timings is invalid.

data.message: The given custom time is invalid

InvalidDataResponse6.description: Returned when a custom time value supplied in the To field of Available_Timings is not a valid time. The API rejects the request with an INVALID_DATA error targeting the offending entry in the availability timings array.

InvalidDataResponse7.summary: Invalid data when member has not confirmed their account.
InvalidDataResponse7.description: Returned when a user specified in the Members array has not confirmed their account. The API rejects the request with an INVALID_DATA error and identifies the unconfirmed member's ID in the response.

InvalidDataResponse8.summary: Invalid data when member is inactive.
InvalidDataResponse8.description: Returned when a user specified in the Members array has an inactive status. The API rejects the request with an INVALID_DATA error because only active users may be associated with a service.

InvalidDataResponse9.summary: Invalid data when Owner field received wrong data type.
InvalidDataResponse9.description: Returned when the Owner field receives a value of an incorrect data type; the API expects a JSON object but received an incompatible type. The request is rejected with an INVALID_DATA error identifying the Owner field.

InvalidDataResponse10.summary: Owner field value exceeds the maximum allowed field length.
InvalidDataResponse10.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA error returned when the Owner field value submitted to the Services endpoint exceeds the maximum allowed field length. The response identifies the Owner field as the source of the invalid data.

MandatoryNotFoundResponse2.summary: Mandatory not found when required Location field is missing.
MandatoryNotFoundResponse2.description: Returned when the required Location field is absent from the request payload. The API rejects the request with a MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND error identifying Location as the missing required field.

DependentMismatchResponse10.summary: Dependent mismatch when Unavailable_From is invalid for Available status.

data.message: When the service status is available, Unavailable From must be greater than current date

DependentMismatchResponse10.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when Unavailable_From is set while the service Status is Available, violating the dependency rule that requires Unavailable_From to be null or specified alone without Unavailable_Till.

DependentMismatchResponse11.summary: Dependent mismatch error when Unavailable_Till is not a future datetime.

data.message: Unavailable Till must be greater than current Time.

DependentMismatchResponse11.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the supplied Unavailable_Till value does not exceed the current server time, violating the temporal constraint imposed by the Status dependency. The API rejects the request indicating that Unavailable_Till must be set to a future datetime.

DependentMismatchResponse12.summary: Dependent mismatch when both unavailability fields are set for Available status.

data.message: When the service status is available,  either both Unavailable From and Unavailable Till must be null, or only Unavailable From can have a value.

DependentMismatchResponse12.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when both Unavailable_From and Unavailable_Till are provided while Status is Available, which violates the rule requiring both fields to be null or only Unavailable_From to carry a value.

DependentMismatchResponse13.summary: Dependent mismatch where Unavailable_Till is not earlier than Unavailable_From.

data.message: Unavailable Till must be lesser than Unavailable From

DependentMismatchResponse13.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the Unavailable_Till value is not chronologically later than Unavailable_From, violating the ordering constraint imposed by the Status dependency. The API rejects the request requiring Unavailable_Till to be set after Unavailable_From.

DependentMismatchResponse14.summary: Dependent mismatch when Not In Use status conflicts with a future Unavailable_From date.

data.message: Services status cannot be marked as Not In Use when Unavailable From falls after the current Date

DependentMismatchResponse14.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when a service record is submitted with a Status of Not In Use while Unavailable_From is set to a future date. The API rejects the request because a future unavailability start date is incompatible with the Not In Use status.

DependentMismatchResponse15.summary: Dependent mismatch when Available_From precedes the current date.

data.message: Starting date of service availability falls before the current Date, so service cannot be marked as Scheduled

DependentMismatchResponse15.description: Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when the Available_From field is set to a date that precedes the current date. The API rejects the request because the service availability start date must not fall before the current date.

DependentMismatchResponse16.summary: Dependent mismatch when a past Available_Till conflicts with an active service status.

data.message: End Date of service availability falls before the current Date, so service cannot be marked as Available or Scheduled or Temporarily Unavailable

DependentMismatchResponse16.description:
Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when Available_Till is set to a past date while the service Status is Available, Scheduled, or Temporarily Unavailable. 

The API rejects the request because an expired availability end date is incompatible with those active status values.

InvalidDataResponse11.summary: Unavailable_From time falls outside the service availability window.

data.message: Unavailable From time does not fall within service availability

InvalidDataResponse11.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA error returned when the Unavailable_From time submitted to the Services endpoint falls outside the configured availability window for the service. The response identifies the Unavailable_From field as the source of the scheduling conflict.

DependentFieldMissingResponse2.summary: Dependent field missing error when Unavailable_From is absent for Status.
DependentFieldMissingResponse2.description: Shows a DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error response triggered when the Status field is provided but its required dependent field, Unavailable_From, is absent from the request payload.

InvalidDataResponse12.summary: Invalid data error returned with no specific error code in the payload.

value.message: invalid data

InvalidDataResponse12.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA error returned for a service record that contains invalid field data. This example represents a minimal error response where no specific error code is present in the payload.

InvalidDataResponse13.summary: Status field rejected due to incorrect data type instead of expected text.
InvalidDataResponse13.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA error returned when the Status field receives a value of an incorrect data type instead of the expected text type. The response identifies the Status field and specifies that the expected data type is text.

InvalidDataResponse14.summary: Status value exceeds maximum allowed length.
InvalidDataResponse14.description: Shows an INVALID_DATA error returned when the Status field value exceeds the maximum allowed length of 120 characters. The response identifies the Status field as the source of the length violation.

InvalidDataResponse15.summary: Unavailable_Till contains an unsupported picklist value.
InvalidDataResponse15.description: Shows the INVALID_DATA error returned when the Unavailable_Till field contains a value not in the supported picklist. The accepted values are Temporarily Unavailable, Available, Not In Use, and Scheduled.

InvalidDataResponse16.summary: Job_Sheet_Required receives an invalid data type.
InvalidDataResponse16.description: Shows the INVALID_DATA error returned when the Job_Sheet_Required field receives a value of an incorrect data type instead of the expected text type. The API rejects the request with an invalid data type message.

InvalidDataResponse17.summary: Job_Sheet_Required value exceeds the maximum allowed length.
InvalidDataResponse17.description: Shows the INVALID_DATA error returned when the Job_Sheet_Required field contains a value that exceeds the maximum allowed length of three characters. The API rejects the request with an invalid data message.

DependentMismatchResponse17.summary: Dependent mismatch when a scheduled service is set to Not In Use or Temporarily Unavailable.

data.message: Service status cannot be marked as Not In Use or Temporarily Unavailable for scheduled services.

DependentMismatchResponse17.description:
Shows the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error returned when a status of Not In Use or Temporarily Unavailable is requested for a service that has future appointments scheduled. 

The API rejects the request because a service with upcoming bookings must retain a status compatible with active scheduling.

delete.summary: Delete one or more service records
delete.description: To delete one or more service records from your Zoho CRM organization. All appointments associated with the deleted services are also deleted; however, deals created upon completion of those appointments are not deleted.

200.description: Returns the result of a single-record service delete operation. The response body contains a `data` array with one entry that includes the status code `SUCCESS`, the deleted record ID, a confirmation message, and the operation status.

Success200.description: Represents a successful single-record delete response from the DELETE operation. The data array contains one entry with code=SUCCESS, the deleted service ID under `details.id`, message="record deleted", and status="success".

207.description: Returns a multi-status response. Each item in the array independently indicates success or failure for the corresponding service ID in the ids query parameter.

schema.description: Wrapped multi-status response for a batch service delete operation. Contains a `data` array (2–200 items) with one entry per service record in the request; each entry independently indicates success or failure for that record.

data.description: Represents the per-record status array in the multi-status response. Contains between 2 and 200 entries, each independently indicating success or failure for the corresponding service ID supplied in the `ids` query parameter.

items.description: Represents one entry in the multi-status data array, indicating success or failure for the corresponding service record.

Success207.summary: Mixed batch delete when one record deleted, one fails with INVALID_DATA
Success207.description: Represents a multi-status response from the DELETE /Services__s endpoint when a batch delete yields mixed results. The data array contains one entry with code=SUCCESS indicating a successfully deleted record and one entry with code=INVALID_DATA indicating a record that could not be deleted.

400.description:
Returned when the service ID is invalid or already deleted, the `ids` query parameter is missing, or the module name is unrecognized.

**Resolution:** A valid service record ID must be supplied in the `ids` query parameter. The module name must match a recognized API name before retrying the request.

schema.description: Bad-request error response for the delete services operation. Returned when the module name is invalid, the `ids` parameter is missing, or one or more service records could not be deleted. The response body conforms to one of: `RecordNotDeletedError`, `InvalidModuleNameError`, `RequiredParamMissingForDeleteError`, or `DataError`.

post.description:
To share a specific record in a module with one or more users, roles, or groups. A record can be shared with up to 10 users, 5 roles, and 5 groups.
> **Note**:
> - The records can be shared to other users in the organization only if certain conditions are met. For simplicity, let us assume that User A shares a record with User B. Now, User A can share the record successfully only if:
>    - User B is a **confirmed** and **active** user.
>    - User B **does not already have access** to that particular record.
>    - User B has access to that particular module. For instance, to share a contact, User B must have access to the Contacts module.
> - You cannot share the records in Calls, Meetings, Tasks, and Linking modules directly. They can be shared as related lists.
> - The users who have profiles with **share** permission can share any records that they have access to, except the records that are shared to them. To check the same, go to Setup > Users and Control > Security Control > Choose the profile > Tool Permissions. Check if **share** is enabled. It is enabled by default for Standard and Administrator Profiles.
> - The details of the records that form many-to-many relationships (with multi-select lookup) cannot be shared.
> - A record can be shared only with **10 users**, **5 groups**, and **5 roles**.
> - Once the record gets shared successfully, the user who initiated the share operation can be notified via email.

get.description: To retrieve a paginated list of timeline entries for a specific record in your Zoho CRM organization. Each timeline entry captures an audited event such as field changes, ownership transfers, workflow actions, Approval Process progressions, Scoring Rule updates, and signal events from extensions.
get.x-zs-llm-description: Retrieves the activity timeline (audit trail) for a specific record in a given module. Returns chronological entries showing actions performed on the record - such as field updates, owner changes, workflow executions, email events, portal activity, blueprint transitions, and more. Requires the module-specific READ scope (e.g., ZohoCRM.modules.Leads.READ). Returns 204 No Content when no timeline entries exist for the record. Supports pagination via page_token or page/per_page (fixed at 3 per page), sorting by audited_time (asc/desc), and filtering by timeline type. The include_inner_details parameter expands nested field-change details within each timeline entry. Only works for standard and custom modules that support timeline tracking.

post.description: To unblock soft-bounced email addresses for multiple records in your Zoho CRM organization. When emails sent from CRM bounce temporarily, the Email field on the affected records is blocked. This operation removes those blocks in bulk so email communication with the records can resume.
post.x-zs-llm-description: Use to unblock the `Email` field for up to 100 records of a module in a single call. Pass `module` in the path (currently `Leads` only), and send `ids` (array of record ids, max 100) and `unblock_fields: ["Email"]` in the body. Returns a `data` array with per-record SUCCESS results.

schema.description: Specify the record IDs and email fields to unblock in bulk.

times**.

> - A **custom email field** cannot be unblocked.

**Approval Process/Review Process**.

post.description: To upload a CSV file in ZIP format for bulk write API. The response contains the **file_id**. Use this ID while making the bulk write request.

schema.description: Specify the multipart/form-data payload containing the ZIP file to upload for the bulk write operation.

file.description:
Specify the file to upload. The file must be a ZIP archive containing one or more CSV files, with a maximum of **25,000 records** per file. The maximum file size is **25 MB.**  If there are more records, make a separate API call by with a ZIP file containing the next 25,000 records in the module.
Please note that the **Subform** and **multi-module lookup (MxN linking module)** fields are treated as separate modules in Zoho CRM. This is a parent-child modulecase, for example, the Contacts module is the parent module, and the subform within it is the child module. So, **prepare separate CSV files for parent and child modules**, then ZIP them together into a ZIP file and upload.
For more details on preparing the input file for parent-child record imports, refer to [Kaizen #131 - Bulk Write for parent-child records using Scala SDK.](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/community/topic/kaizen-131-bulk-write-for-parent-child-records-scala-sdk)

get.description: To retrieve the list of all webhook action configurations available in your Zoho CRM organization. The response contains summary-level data for each webhook, including the module, URL, HTTP method, feature type, and audit metadata. Use the [Get Webhooks API using ID](webhooks.yaml#$.paths./settings/automation/webhooks/{webhook_ID}.get) to retrieve the full configuration of a specific webhook.
get.x-zs-llm-description: Fetches a paginated list of webhook definitions; narrow results using filters for module, feature_type, related_module, or name. page defaults to 1, per_page max is 200; sort_by accepts only Modified_Time with asc/desc sort_order. The response carries summary-level data only headers, body, authentication, url_parameters, and date_time_format are omitted; call `getWebhookById` for the full config. Run this before PUT/DELETE to discover webhook IDs.

put.description:
To update the configuration of an existing webhook in your Zoho CRM organization.

The module field cannot be changed after creation. The request body must contain a webhooks array with exactly one webhook object.

To retrieve valid module API names, refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource.
put.x-zs-llm-description: Replaces one webhook in a single call. Before submitting: (1) list webhook IDs via `getWebhooks`; (2) confirm valid module api_names via `getModules`. Full-replacement semantics apply include every field you want to keep, since omitted fields revert to defaults or null. The webhook object must carry its id field. Module and kiosk names cannot be changed; read-only or marketplace/extension webhooks return NOT_ALLOWED.

requestBody.description: The request body must contain a webhooks array with one object.

post.description:
To create a webhook action that fires an HTTP request to an external URL in your Zoho CRM organization when an automation trigger fires. 

The `http_method` value controls which optional request fields are accepted. 

- POST and PUT accept `headers` and `body`
- GET and DELETE methods accept `url_parameters`
- DELETE also accepts `headers` 

To retrieve valid module API names, refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource.
post.x-zs-llm-description: Adds a new webhook action that fires when automation triggers. Before calling: `getModules` to look up valid module api_names. Send a webhooks array with exactly one entry; required fields are name, module, url, http_method, authentication, and feature_type. http_method determines which keys are allowed: POST/PUT accept headers and body; GET/DELETE accept url_parameters; DELETE also accepts headers. Sending keys not allowed for the chosen method returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. The URL must begin with http://, https://, www., or ${...}; SSRF-protected hosts are rejected. The response contains the new webhook ID.

requestBody.description: The request body must contain a webhooks array with one object. The webhook object requires name, module, url, http_method, authentication, and feature_type.

delete.description:
To delete one or more webhook actions configured in your Zoho CRM account.

Up to 10 webhooks can be deleted in a single API call using the **ids** query parameter. Read-only webhooks created by Zoho extensions cannot be deleted. 

Webhooks associated with active Workflow Rules, Approval Processes, or Blueprints cannot be deleted.
delete.x-zs-llm-description: Bulk-deletes webhooks by their IDs; supply ids as a comma-separated query parameter (up to 10). Read-only webhooks created by extensions and webhooks tied to active workflow rules, approval processes, or blueprints all return NOT_ALLOWED. Returns 200 when all succeed or 207 (Multi-Status) for mixed results. Use `getWebhooks` to find IDs first.

get.description:
To retrieve detailed information about webhook execution failures in your Zoho CRM organization.

Optionally filter results by module, webhook ID, and date range. If the **from** and **to** parameters are not specified, the API returns webhook failures from the last 30 days by default. The maximum allowed span between **from** and **to** is 90 days.
get.x-zs-llm-description: Returns the failure log for workflow webhook executions. Filter by module api_name (defaults to 'all') or a specific webhook_id (defaults to 'all'). from/to accept YYYY-MM-DD evaluated in the org time zone; from defaults to 30 days before to, to defaults to today. Returns 204 when no failures match the filters. Each entry includes failure_time, failure_reason, the webhook reference, the triggering workflow rule, and the CRM record in entity_details.

get.description: To retrieve the wizard configurations available in your Zoho CRM organization. The response can be filtered by module using the `**module**` query parameter. When you set up conditional rules for a wizard, the response contains the keys execute_on and type. execute_on represents when the conditional rule is executed. The values are create, edit, and create_edit. type represents the action you want to take when the condition is met. The values are set_values, set_lock, show_component, and show_widget. When type=set_lock, the response contains the key exempted_profiles. This array contains the list of profiles that allow edits even after locking specific fields. The color_palette key is added that displays the colors available for a button on a screen. Note that this key is available in the response only if you have chosen at least one custom color for the button on a screen. Changes made to this API from version 5 when you fetch a specific wizard in a layout: - A new JSON array portal_user_types is added to the response that displays the list of portal user types that have access to the wizard. - A new JSON array exempted_portal_user_types is added to the response that represents the list of portal user types that have access to wizards that are blocked for other user types. - Under the segments, for buttons, the Profiles JSON array is added. This indicates the profiles that have access to that button in that screen. - In the Screens JSON array, the "type" of segments JSON object is changed from fields to composite. - In the segments JSON array, the fields JSON array is renamed to elements. - Each object in the elements JSON array contains the sequence number, resource, and type keys. Resource includes the "name" and "id" of the field or the query component on the screen. type indicates whether the resource is a field or query component. From V6, you can get the list of available screens in Wizards. See the sample response for reference.

put.summary: Update workflow rules by ID in the request body
put.description: To update one or more existing workflow rules in your Zoho CRM organization, submit a `workflow_rules` array in the request body with each entry containing the rule's `id`. You can modify a rule's name, description, criteria, conditions, actions, and active status. Triggers may be updated only within the same trigger type — changing from one trigger category to another (for example, from a Record Action trigger to a Score-based trigger) is not supported. The module associated with a workflow rule cannot be changed after creation. To remove an existing condition or action, include it in the request with `_delete` set to `null`. Use the [Get Workflow Rules API](workflow_rules.yaml#$.paths./settings/automation/workflow_rules.get) to retrieve rule IDs before calling this operation.
put.x-zs-llm-description: Updates one or more workflow rules identified by id in the request body. Supports partial updates  include only fields to change. Omitted actions are preserved; to remove an action set _delete: null. Cannot change module after creation. Locked rules return RECORD_LOCKED. Always GET the current rule first to avoid overwriting concurrent changes.

post.description: PURPOSE: Creates an automation task definition used by workflow rules, approval processes, blueprints, kiosks, scoring rules, and case escalation rules. PREREQUISITES: (1) Call GET /settings/automation/tasks to check existing task definitions and avoid duplicates. (2) Call GET /settings/layouts?module=Tasks to discover supported fields and identify mandatory fields where required: true in the field info. STRUCTURE: The request body contains a tasks array with exactly 1 task object. Each task requires: name (string), module ({api_name, id}), and field_mappings (array). Omitting mandatory fields returns REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Returns the created task ID.

Send a tasks array with exactly one entry covering name (string), module ({api_name, id}), and field_mappings (array). Leaving out a mandatory field returns REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. The response contains the new task ID.

put.description: PURPOSE: Updates an existing automation task definition identified by the path parameter ID. PREREQUISITES: (1) Call GET /settings/automation/tasks/{id} to obtain the current task structure. (2) Call GET /settings/layouts?module=Tasks to verify supported fields and identify mandatory fields where required: true in the field info. BEHAVIOR: This is a full replacement - all field_mappings must be provided, not just the changed ones. KEY CONSTRAINTS: Locked tasks (locked by workflow rules, approval processes, or blueprints) return 401 AUTHORIZATION_ERROR. Read-only tasks return 400.
put.x-zs-llm-description: Replaces the full configuration of an existing automation task identified by the path parameter ID. Before calling: (1) GET /settings/automation/tasks/{id} to read the current structure; (2) GET /settings/layouts?module=Tasks to confirm supported fields and find any where required: true. Every field_mapping must be sent  partial payloads are not supported. Locked tasks return 401 AUTHORIZATION_ERROR; read-only tasks return 400.

400.description: Validation error in request payload. (2) Per-task validation errors (e.g., field_mapping errors, dependent mismatch, mandatory not found) return tasks as an array with one error object per task entry. Parse tasks as either object or array to handle both shapes.

post.description: To submit a request that schedules a Zia organization enrichment job in your Zoho CRM organization. The job runs asynchronously and uses the supplied name, email, or website to retrieve publicly available details such as address, primary contact, industries, and social media handles, and to populate the configured fields of the target module or record.

items.description: Represents a single Zia organization enrichment request that defines the trigger fields used to identify the organization.

enrich_based_on.description: Specify the details of the fields on whose values you want to trigger enrichment.  Note that you must provide at least one of the following values in the input. Based on these values, Zia will look for information on the web and enrich fields as per [Enrichment Configuration.](zia_enrichment.yaml#$.paths./settings/zia/data_enrichment.get)) Note that the values of these keys must be at least three characters long and only in English.

name.description: Specify the name of the organization  that Zia uses as a trigger value to look up enrichment data.

email.description: Specify the email address of the organization that Zia uses as a trigger value to look up enrichment data.

website.description: Specify the website domain of the organization that Zia uses as a trigger value to look up enrichment data.

200.description: Returns the details and enriched data of the requested organization enrichment job.

schema.description: Defines the response body returned when the requested organization enrichment job is retrieved successfully.

__zia_org_enrichment.description: Contains the details of the requested organization enrichment job.

items.description: Represents the full record of a single organization enrichment job, including its trigger fields and enriched output.

id.description: Shows the unique identifier of the organization enrichment job.

status.description:
Indicates the current execution status of the enrichment job.

Possible values:
**COMPLETED** - The job has finished and enriched data is available.
**SCHEDULED** - The job is queued and yet to run.
**FAILED** - The job ended in a failure.
**DATA_NOT_FOUND** - The job completed but Zia could not locate public data to enrich.

enrich_based_on.description: Shows the trigger values that were supplied when the enrichment job was scheduled.

name.description: Shows the organization name that was used as a trigger value.

email.description: Shows the email address that was used as a trigger value.

website.description: Shows the website domain that was used as a trigger value.

enriched_data.description: Contains the data retrieved by Zia for the organization. The keys present in this object depend on the fields configured in the enrichment configuration of the organization. Returns `null` when the job has not yet completed or when no public data could be retrieved.

address.fill_address: Estancia IT Park, Plot no. 140, 151, GST Road, Vallancheri

204.description: Returned when no enrichment job exists for the supplied identifier or when the identifier is invalid.

assignment_rules__FilterFieldBase.description: Represents the base field reference used in filter operations, containing minimal required properties. The field's data_type is not part of this object; resolve it from the corresponding FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the field used for filter operations.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field used for filter application. Supports relationship notation, for example, Deals__r.Stage.

assignment_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionV.description: Represents a string filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime, as well as any data_type not explicitly covered by SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber, SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse, or the multiselect lookup value schemas.
Represents a numeric filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of integer, currency, or double.
Represents the base minified record structure of a lookup module, containing the record's unique identifier and display name.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the lookup module record.

name.description: Represents the display name of the lookup module record.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint that the ID property is required for the lookup object filter criterion value in request bodies.

assignment_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionV.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for request bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. The ID property is required.

Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user, in which only the name property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property is included.

name.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the currently logged-in user.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSER} - Represents the currently logged-in user.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user's role, in which the ID property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and the name property is an optional display label.

id.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the logged-in user's role record ID.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSERROLE} - Represents the role of the currently logged-in user.

name.description: Represents an optional display label for the predefined role, such as Logged in User Role.

assignment_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionV.description: Represents a Boolean filter criterion value. Applicable only when the field has a Boolean data type (checkbox field).

Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator.
Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

assignment_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionV.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROWPLUS}: Matches records where the date field is on tomorrow or any later date (tomorrow onwards).
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the previous calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAYMINUS}: Matches records where the date field is on yesterday or any earlier date (up to and including yesterday).
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the entire previous calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar week (Monday–Sunday).
x-enumDescriptions.${THISWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has no value set.
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has a value set.

assignment_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionV.description: Represents a predefined N-period range placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator. Follows the pattern ${NEXT_N_<PERIOD>:<n>} or ${LAST_N_<PERIOD>:<n>}, where PERIOD is DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, or YEARS and n is a positive integer. The current period is always excluded from the range.

Represents a predefined age or due-in-days placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime. Follows the pattern ${AGEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field was exactly n days in the past, or ${DUEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field is exactly n days in the future. Supported comparators are equal, not_equal, less_than, greater_than, less_equal, and greater_equal.

assignment_rules__EqualFilterCriterionRe.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

assignment_rules__NotEqualFilterCriterio.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the not-equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the not-equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the not-equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
not_equal - Matches records where the field value does not equal the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the not_equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the not_equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

assignment_rules__EqualityFilterCriterio.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

assignment_rules__TextFilterCriterionReq.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the text filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the text filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the text comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern.
not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern.
starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string.
ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string.
contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string.
not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

value.description: Represents the string filter value used in the text comparator. Accepts a scalar string or an array of string values.

oneOf.description: Contains an array of primitive string values for the text filter comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

assignment_rules__OrderingFilterCriterio.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the ordering filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the ordering filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the ordering comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
less_than - Matches records where the field value is less than the specified filter value.
less_equal - Matches records where the field value is less than or equal to the specified filter value.
greater_than - Matches records where the field value is greater than the specified filter value.
greater_equal - Matches records where the field value is greater than or equal to the specified filter value.

value.description: Represents the scalar filter value used in the ordering comparator. Arrays and objects are not supported for ordering comparators.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

assignment_rules__BetweenFilterCriterion.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the range comparison operator applied to the criterion, indicating whether the field value falls within or outside the specified bounds.
Possible values:
between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range.
not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

assignment_rules__SetFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the set membership comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
in - Matches records where the field value is in the specified set of values.
not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

assignment_rules__MultiSelectLookupFilte.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the multi-select lookup filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the multi-select lookup filter criterion is applied. The field must have a data_type of multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

comparator.description:
Represents the multi-select lookup comparison operator applied to the criterion. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Possible values:
include_all - Matches records that include all specified lookup values.
include_any - Matches records that include at least one of the specified lookup values.
exclude_all - Matches records that exclude all specified lookup values.
exclude_any - Matches records that exclude at least one of the specified lookup values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

assignment_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionR.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

assignment_rules__GroupedFilterCriterion.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description:
Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.
Possible values:
AND - All conditions in the group must be satisfied.
OR - At least one condition in the group must be satisfied.
and - Equivalent to AND; all conditions in the group must be satisfied.
or - Equivalent to OR; at least one condition in the group must be satisfied.

assignment_rules__FilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

cadences__AutomationModuleRef.description: PURPOSE: Module reference used across non-associate actions. At least one of api_name or id required (EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING if neither). If both given, must match (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). GET /settings/modules to discover. Always use full 19-digit module ID.
cadences__AutomationModuleRef.x-zs-llm-description: Module reference for action targeting. At least one of api_name or id required  EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING if neither is present. If both provided and they refer to different modules  AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getModules. Used in most non-associate action details to specify where the action operates.

api_name.description: API name of the module (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Vendors).

id.description: Unique module ID (19-digit format). Always use the full ID as returned by GET /settings/modules - truncated or shortened IDs return INVALID_DATA ('the tabId given seems to be invalid'). Optional in requests if api_name is provided; always present in responses.

cadences__AutomationModuleRef.title: Automation Module Reference
