id.description: Unique layout ID. Required. Obtain from GET /settings/layouts?module={module_api_name}.

name.description: Display name of the layout. Optional in requests; present in GET responses.

display_label.description: Human-readable label of the layout. Present in GET responses.

cadences__AutomationLayoutRef.title: Automation Layout Reference

cadences__AutomationFieldAttributes.description: Identifies the target CRM field to which a mapping value is applied within an automation rule. The api_name and ID properties must both be supplied and must refer to the same field; a mismatch between the two causes an AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING error. Available fields for a given module can be discovered via GET /settings/fields?module={api_name}.
cadences__AutomationFieldAttributes.x-zs-llm-description: Target field identifier. Both api_name and id are mandatory  providing only one still works but both should be given for reliability. If both provided and they refer to different fields: AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getFields?module={module_api_name}. The field must be writable and compatible with mapping type.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the target field in the destination module — for example, Subject, Due_Date, or Owner — used to identify the field receiving the mapped value within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, and convert.

id.description: Represents the numeric identifier of the target CRM field. Used in conjunction with the field's API name, both of which must resolve to the same field for a mapping to be valid.

cadences__AutomationFieldAttributes.title: Automation Field Attributes

cadences__StaticStringValue.description: Represents a plain string value used as the static value for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields. Numeric values are expressed as strings rather than numeric literals. Picklist values must exactly match one of the options defined for the field.
cadences__StaticStringValue.x-zs-llm-description: String value for type=static mappings. Applies to: text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, percentage fields. Numbers must be sent as strings (e.g., '100' not 100). Picklist values must match available options  invalid values return INVALID_DATA.

cadences__StaticArrayValue.description: Represents an array of string values used as the static value for multiselectpicklist fields, where each element corresponds to an available picklist option. Valid option labels are retrievable from the GET /settings/fields endpoint filtered by data_type=multiselectpicklist.
cadences__StaticArrayValue.x-zs-llm-description: Array value for type=static on multiselect_picklist fields. Each element must match an available picklist option. Discover valid options from getFields for the target module. Invalid options return INVALID_DATA.

items.description: A single picklist option string to include in the multi-select field value. Each entry corresponds to one selectable option as defined for the target field in Zoho CRM.

cadences__StaticObjectValue.description: Represents an object value used as the static value for ownerlookup and layout fields, containing an ID that identifies the target user or layout and an optional name that the server resolves from the ID when not supplied. Typically used to assign record ownership by providing the user ID.
cadences__StaticObjectValue.x-zs-llm-description: Object value for type=static on ownerlookup and layout fields. id is mandatory (user ID or layout ID). name is optional server resolves from id. Use getUsers for owner IDs, getLayouts for layout IDs.

id.description: The system identifier of the referenced entity, such as a user or layout record. This value drives entity resolution by the automation engine and must be provided when the target field references an entity.

name.description: The display name of the referenced entity, such as a user full name or a layout label. When omitted from a request payload, the server resolves and populates this property from the supplied ID. The property is present in all GET responses.

cadences__StaticObjectValue.title: Static Object Value

cadences__StaticFieldMapping.description: Represents a static-type mapping that assigns a literal value directly to the target field at execution time. The value shape varies by field data type: a plain string for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields (numeric values expressed as strings); an array of strings for multiselectpicklist fields; and an object containing ID and name for ownerlookup fields. Date, datetime, and ALARM fields do not support this type — use execution_time instead, as static on those fields produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Fields marked unique in the module settings also require merge_field rather than static for create_record actions.
cadences__StaticFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='static' mapping. Value is used as-is without runtime resolution. NOT for Date/DateTime/ALARM fields (use execution_time  static returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). NOT for unique fields or formula fields. Value structure depends on field data_type: string for most fields, array for multiselect_picklist, object for ownerlookup/layout.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping strategy for this field assignment. The value must be `static`, which instructs the automation engine to assign a fixed, literal value to the target field at execution time rather than resolving it dynamically.

value.description: The literal value assigned to the target field at automation execution time. The expected shape is determined by the target field data_type, discoverable via GET /settings/fields?module={module}. For most field types, supply a string (for example, "High", "Not Started", "1234"). For multi-select picklist fields (data_type: multiselectpicklist), supply an array of option strings. For fields that reference an entity such as an owner or layout (data_type: ownerlookup), supply an object with at minimum the entity ID.

cadences__StaticFieldMapping.title: Static Field Mapping

cadences__MergeFieldStringValue.description: Represents the string value carried by a merge_field mapping, containing one or more runtime-resolved token references. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), lookup traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Tokens may be combined with surrounding text for multi-line field targets. Fields that hold a single typed value such as email or URL accept exactly one token.
cadences__MergeFieldStringValue.x-zs-llm-description: String containing merge-field tokens for type=merge_field mappings. Resolved at runtime. Formats: ${!Module.Field} (direct access), ${!Module.Lookup.Field} (traverse lookup). Multiple tokens can be combined in one string. Unsupported tokens return UNSUPPORTED_MERGE_FIELD error.

cadences__MergeFieldMapping.description: Represents a merge_field-type mapping whose value is resolved at execution time by substituting token references with live field data. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Applies to text-based fields such as Subject, Description, and custom text fields. Targeting owner or lookup fields with this type produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error; those fields require a static mapping using an object with a numeric identifier and an optional name. Multiple tokens may be chained with surrounding text for multi-line fields, while single-value fields such as email or URL accept exactly one token.
cadences__MergeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='merge_field' mapping. Value contains ${!Module.Field} tokens resolved at execution time. ONLY for text-based fields (Subject, Description, etc.)  using on date/number/picklist fields returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Supports lookup traversal: ${!Module.Lookup.Field}. Multi-module not supported.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping strategy for this field assignment. The value must be `merge_field`, which instructs the automation engine to resolve the field value dynamically from a merge field token at execution time rather than from a static literal.

value.description: A string containing one or more ${!...} merge-field tokens resolved at runtime.

allow_agent_user.description:
Controls whether agent users are eligible for record assignment. Possible values:
**true** — agent users are included in the assignment pool alongside standard users.
**false** — agent users are excluded from assignment.
Applies to mapping types role, group, profile, merge_field, and criteria. Does not apply to user or assignment_rule types.

cadences__MergeFieldMapping.title: Merge Field Mapping

cadences__ExecutionTimeValue.description: Represents the offset configuration used by an execution_time mapping to compute a final date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime. Contains period (the time unit granularity), unit (the numeric magnitude expressed as a string integer), and trigger_field (a merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}). Date fields use period, unit, and trigger_field with an implied positive direction. Datetime fields additionally accept sign to control direction. ALARM fields additionally accept time and notify_type, and always require a minus sign. Workflow task actions restrict period to days or business_days.
cadences__ExecutionTimeValue.x-zs-llm-description: Offset computation object for date/datetime/ALARM fields. Required fields: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (string integer  quantity), trigger_field (merge-field token like ${!Leads.Created_Time} or ${CURRENTTIME}). Optional: sign ('positive' for after, 'negative' for before  default varies by context). Missing required fields return DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING.

period.description:
The calendar or time unit applied to the offset. Possible values:
**days** — counts all calendar days including weekends and holidays; supported by every action type.
**business_days** — excludes weekends and requires the organisation's business-day setting to be enabled; supported by all action types.
**hours** — available only for create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call.
**minutes** — available only for create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call.
workflow_tasks accept only **days** or **business_days**.

unit.description: The number of period units to offset from the trigger date, supplied as a non-negative integer string (for example, "1", "30"). Passing "0" produces a same-day result, such as scheduling a Remind_At on the same day as the due date.

sign.description:
The direction of the offset relative to the trigger date. Possible values:
**plus** — places the computed value after the trigger (for example, a due date two days after record creation).
**minus** — places the computed value before the trigger (for example, a reminder one day before the due date).
For datetime fields (data_type=datetime) a value is expected; omitting it returns a DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error. For date-only fields (data_type=date) the value defaults to **plus** when absent. When targeting Remind_At (data_type=ALARM), **minus** is the only applicable direction.

trigger_field.description: The reference date or datetime field from which the offset is measured. Accepts a merge-field token that resolves to a Date or DateTime field on the parent module (for example, "${!Leads.Modified_Time}", "${!Tasks.Due_Date}"), or the reserved constant "${CURRENTTIME}" to use the automation execution timestamp. When computing a Remind_At (ALARM) value, "${!Tasks.Due_Date}" is the typical anchor.

time.description: The time-of-day component of the computed value, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (for example, "13:00", "01:30"). Applies when the target field carries data type datetime or ALARM (as reported by GET /settings/fields). Supplying this property for a date-only field (data_type=date) produces a validation error.

notify_type.description:
The notification channel used to deliver the reminder. Applies exclusively when the target field carries data type ALARM (i.e., Remind_At); date and datetime fields do not use this property. Possible values:
**popup** — triggers an in-app notification.
**email** — sends a message to the task owner.
**emailandpopup** — delivers both simultaneously.

cadences__ExecutionTimeValue.title: Execution Time Value

cadences__ExecutionTimeFieldMapping.description: Represents an execution_time-type field mapping that computes a date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime by applying a signed offset to a trigger field or the current time. The value carries an ExecutionTimeValue object specifying the period, unit, trigger_field, and optional time or notify_type properties. A plus sign places the result after the trigger; a minus sign places it before. ALARM fields always require minus. Workflow task actions support only days and business_days as period values.
cadences__ExecutionTimeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='execution_time' mapping. REQUIRED for Date, DateTime, and ALARM field types (static/merge_field on these returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). Computes value as offset from trigger_field. Value object needs: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (integer as string), trigger_field (merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}), sign (for before/after offset).

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping variant as an execution-time offset. The value is always "execution_time" for this schema and acts as the polymorphic discriminator across the AutomationFieldMappings union.

value.description: Execution-time object specifying how to compute the date/datetime offset from a reference field.

cadences__ExecutionTimeFieldMapping.title: Execution Time Field Mapping

cadences__CompositeFieldMapping.description: Represents a composite-type field mapping used exclusively for the Participants field in the Events module via the add_meeting action. The value carries a structured object that encodes participant data and is not applicable to any other field or automation action type.
cadences__CompositeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='composite' mapping. Used ONLY for the Participants field in Events module (add_meeting action). Value is a structured object representing multiple participant entries. Cannot be used on other field types  returns NOT_ALLOWED.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Serves as the polymorphic discriminator that identifies this field mapping as a composite mapping; the value must be set to "composite" to select this schema variant.

value.description: Holds the structured composite object that encodes participant data for the Events module Participants field; the shape of this object varies according to the participant type configuration defined for the automation rule.

cadences__CompositeFieldMapping.title: Composite Field Mapping

cadences__AutomationFieldMappings.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping used within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call. Each mapping identifies a target field via api_name or ID, declares a type discriminator that determines value interpretation, and supplies a value whose shape varies by type: static supplies a literal value, merge_field supplies a runtime-resolved token string, execution_time supplies a date or datetime offset object, and composite supplies structured participant data for the Events Participants field. The field_mappings array must include all fields the target module requires; omitting any produces a REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND error.
cadences__AutomationFieldMappings.x-zs-llm-description: A single field-to-value mapping entry used in create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call, convert, and workflow task actions. Each entry targets one field and assigns a typed value. The type field discriminates the value structure: static (literal), merge_field (runtime token), execution_time (date offset), composite (multi-value). field identifies the target, type selects the value schema, value provides the data.
cadences__AutomationFieldMappings.title: Automation Field Mappings

cadences__AutomationScheduleCallDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for schedule_call action. Creates a Call record when workflow fires. PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module=Calls for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name: 'Calls', id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include Subject, Call_Type). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool). KEY FIELDS: Subject, Call_Type ('Outbound'|'Inbound'|'Missed'), Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At.
cadences__AutomationScheduleCallDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='schedule_call'. Creates a Calls record. Requires module (Calls), layout, field_mappings (must include Subject). Key fields: Subject, Call_Purpose, Call_Type, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Same field_mapping structure as create_record. Optional: apply_restriction.

module.description: Target module for the call. Must be the Calls module. Provide either api_name ("Calls") or the Calls module id.

layout.description: Layout to use when creating the Call record. Determines which fields are available and their validation rules. Fetch valid layouts from GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls. The layout.id is required.

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new Call. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Subject"}, "type": "static", "value": "Follow-up"}. Must include all mandatory fields from GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls. Call_Type is system-mandatory (values: "Outbound", "Inbound", "Missed") - omitting returns REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Common fields: Subject, Call_Type, Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist fields; NOT for DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Phone} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Call_Start_Time and Remind_At; sign required for datetime; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes.

items.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping entry for the new Call record, conforming to the AutomationFieldMappings schema. Each entry identifies a target Call field and specifies the value resolution strategy: static for literal values, merge_field for runtime token substitution, or execution_time for dynamically resolved DateTime and ALARM fields.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the Call record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this schedule call action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

custom_views__FilterFieldBase.description: Represents the base field reference used in filter operations, containing minimal required properties. The field's data_type is not part of this object; resolve it from the corresponding FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

Represents a numeric filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of integer, currency, or double.
Represents the base minified record structure of a lookup module, containing the record's unique identifier and display name.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the lookup module record.

custom_views__SimpleFilterCriterionValue.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for request bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. The ID property is required.

Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.

Represents the predefined placeholder for the currently logged-in user.

${CURRENTUSER} - Represents the currently logged-in user.

${CURRENTUSERROLE} - Represents the role of the currently logged-in user.

name.description: Represents an optional display label for the predefined role, such as Logged in User Role.

custom_views__SimpleFilterCriterionValue.description: Represents a Boolean filter criterion value. Applicable only when the field has a Boolean data type (checkbox field).

Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator.
Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

custom_views__SimpleFilterCriterionValue.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROWPLUS}: Matches records where the date field is on tomorrow or any later date (tomorrow onwards).
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the previous calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAYMINUS}: Matches records where the date field is on yesterday or any earlier date (up to and including yesterday).
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the entire previous calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar week (Monday–Sunday).
x-enumDescriptions.${THISWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has no value set.
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has a value set.

custom_views__SimpleFilterCriterionValue.description: Represents a predefined N-period range placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator. Follows the pattern ${NEXT_N_<PERIOD>:<n>} or ${LAST_N_<PERIOD>:<n>}, where PERIOD is DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, or YEARS and n is a positive integer. The current period is always excluded from the range.

Represents a predefined age or due-in-days placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime. Follows the pattern ${AGEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field was exactly n days in the past, or ${DUEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field is exactly n days in the future. Supported comparators are equal, not_equal, less_than, greater_than, less_equal, and greater_equal.

custom_views__EqualFilterCriterionReques.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the not-equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the not-equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the not_equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the not_equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

custom_views__TextFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the text filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the text filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:

Possible values:
like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern.
not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern.
starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string.
ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string.
contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string.
not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

value.description: Represents the string filter value used in the text comparator. Accepts a scalar string or an array of string values.

oneOf.description: Contains an array of primitive string values for the text filter comparator.

field - The value references another field.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the ordering filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the ordering filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

field - The value references another field.

custom_views__BetweenFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:

between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range.
not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

field - The value references another field.

custom_views__SetFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:

Possible values:
in - Matches records where the field value is in the specified set of values.
not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

field - The value references another field.

custom_views__MultiSelectLookupFilterCri.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the multi-select lookup filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the multi-select lookup filter criterion is applied. The field must have a data_type of multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

comparator.description:
Represents the multi-select lookup comparison operator applied to the criterion. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Possible values:
include_all - Matches records that include all specified lookup values.
include_any - Matches records that include at least one of the specified lookup values.
exclude_all - Matches records that exclude all specified lookup values.
exclude_any - Matches records that exclude at least one of the specified lookup values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.

value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

custom_views__SimpleFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

custom_views__GroupedFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description:
Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.
Possible values:
AND - All conditions in the group must be satisfied.
OR - At least one condition in the group must be satisfied.
and - Equivalent to AND; all conditions in the group must be satisfied.
or - Equivalent to OR; at least one condition in the group must be satisfied.

custom_views__FilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint that both the ID and name properties are required for the lookup object filter criterion value in response bodies.

custom_views__SimpleFilterCriterionValue.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for response bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. Both the ID and name properties are included.

custom_views__EqualFilterCriterionRespon.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

comparator.description:

include_any - Matches records that include at least one of the specified lookup values.

custom_views__GroupedFilterCriterionResp.description: Represents the grouped filter criterion returned in the response, containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description:

Possible values:
AND - All conditions in the group must be satisfied.

and - Equivalent to AND; all conditions in the group must be satisfied.

custom_views__FilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion returned in the response, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

custom_views__ChildRelationshipReference.description: Represents the reference to a child relationship module. The api_name property is required to identify the child relationship.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the child relationship module used to identify the relationship.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the child relationship module record.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the related module relationship referenced by this criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an unresolvable or deleted relationship definition.

custom_views__CrossFiltersResponse.description: Represents the list of cross-filter objects returned in the response, applied to the Custom View.

items.description: Represents a single cross-filter object returned in the response, containing the relationship reference, filter criteria, and inclusion flag.

include_objects.description: Indicates whether records with matching related records were included in the filtered results.

custom_views__FilterInvalidParamDataType.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter parameter is supplied with an incorrect data type. Contains the error code, a descriptive message, and details identifying the offending parameter along with its expected data type.

code.description:
Represents the error classification code for this response.
Possible values:
**INVALID_DATA** - The filter parameter was supplied with an incorrect data type.

details.description: Contains structured details about the data type mismatch, including the name of the offending filter parameter and the data type it is expected to carry.

expected_data_type.description: Represents the data type that the filter parameter is required to carry for the request to be valid.

param_name.description: Represents the name of the query or body parameter — such as `filters` — that carries the filter criteria and was supplied with an invalid data type.

message.description: Represents a descriptive message explaining the data type error encountered for the filter parameter.

status.description:
Represents the outcome of the request.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed due to an invalid filter parameter data type.

custom_views__FilterNotSupportedApiName.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter criterion references a field API name that is not supported for filtering. The details object identifies the unsupported field and its location within the filter parameter.

code.description:
Indicates the error classification assigned to this response.
Possible values:
**NOT_SUPPORTED** - The referenced field API name is not permitted for use in filter criteria.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field that is not supported for use in filter criteria and triggered this error.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSONPath location of the unsupported field within the filter expression.

param_name.description: Represents the name of the filter request parameter that carried the unsupported field API name.

details.description: Contains the contextual details identifying the unsupported field that caused the error, including its API name, its location within the filter expression, and the name of the filter parameter involved.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the nature of the error returned by the API.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the API response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because an unsupported field API name was used in the filter criteria.

custom_views__FilterFieldComparatorValue.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field that requires a comparator value is submitted without one, typically because a required upstream dependee field is absent from the filter expression.

code.description:
Indicates the error classification assigned to this response.
Possible values:
**DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING** - A filter field's required comparator value is absent because its upstream dependee field was not supplied in the filter criteria.

details.description: Contains structured details about the missing comparator value error, identifying the field in error, the upstream dependee field that constrains it, and the filter parameter context in which the violation occurred.

dependee.description: Represents the upstream field whose value constrains the comparator requirements of the field currently in error. Contains the API name and JSONPath location of that upstream dependee field within the filter expression.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the upstream dependee field whose value constrains the comparator requirements of the field currently in error.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSONPath location of the upstream dependee field within the filter expression.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the filter field whose comparator value is absent, identifying which field in the filter expression triggered the error.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSONPath location of the field in error within the filter expression, pinpointing where the missing comparator value was detected.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the filter parameter that carries the filter criteria in which the missing comparator value was detected.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the missing comparator value error.

status.description:
Represents the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because a required comparator value was absent from the filter criteria.

custom_views__FilterFieldComparatorMisma.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field's comparator value does not match any of the values permitted by the upstream dependee field's value. Contains the offending field's API name and JSONPath location, the dependee field's identity, the filter parameter context, and the list of supported comparator values.

code.description:
Indicates the error type for this response.
Possible values:
**DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** - The comparator supplied for the field does not match the set of comparators permitted given the current value of the dependee field.

details.description: Contains structured details about the comparator mismatch, identifying the field in error, the upstream dependee field whose value constrains valid comparators, and the set of comparator values that are permitted.

dependee.description: Represents the upstream field whose current value determines which comparators are valid for the field identified in `api_name`. Contains the upstream field's API name and its location within the filter expression.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the upstream dependee field whose value constrains the set of comparators permitted for the field currently in error.

json_path.description: Contains the JSONPath expression locating the dependee field within the filter expression submitted in the request.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the field whose supplied comparator value does not match the comparators permitted given the current value of the dependee field.

json_path.description: Contains the JSONPath expression locating the field in error within the filter expression submitted in the request.

items.description: Represents a single comparator value that is valid for the field in error given the current value of the dependee field.

supported_values.description: Contains the complete set of comparator values that are permitted for the field in error, as determined by the current value of the dependee field.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the filter query parameter that carries the filter expression containing the comparator mismatch.

message.description: Represents a short, descriptive summary of the comparator-field dependency violation.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome of the request.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed due to a comparator value mismatch in the filter criteria.

custom_views__FilterFieldValueMismatch.description: Represents the error response returned when a filter field's value carries a data type that does not satisfy the requirement imposed by its dependee field's current value.

code.description:
Indicates the category of error associated with this response.
Possible values:
**DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** - A filter field's value has a data type that conflicts with the requirement set by the dependee field.

details.description: Contains diagnostic details identifying the offending filter field, its expected data type, the dependee field that governs that expectation, and the filter parameter in which the mismatch was detected.

dependee.description: Represents the field whose current value dictates the required data type for the offending filter field.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the dependee field whose value drives the data type requirement for the offending filter field.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSON path locating the dependee field within the request payload.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the filter field whose supplied value does not match the data type required by the dependee field.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSON path locating the filter field whose value carries the data type mismatch within the request payload.

expected_data_type.description: Indicates the data type expected by the dependee field against which the submitted filter value was validated.

param_name.description: Represents the filter-specific query parameter name associated with the field that failed value validation.

message.description: Contains a descriptive explanation of the filter field value mismatch error.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because a filter field value did not match the type required by the dependee field.

custom_views__FilterComparatorValueMisma.description: Represents an error returned when a value associated with a filter comparator fails validation due to constraints imposed by a dependee field. This error targets the value driven by the comparator rather than the comparator operator selection itself.

code.description:
Indicates the classification of the error.
Possible values:
**DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** - The comparator-driven value failed validation due to constraints imposed by the dependee field.

details.description: Contains structured diagnostic details identifying the filter field whose comparator-driven value failed dependency validation, including the controlling dependee field reference.

dependee.description: Represents the dependee field whose state or constraints govern the validation rules applied to the comparator value of the current filter field.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the dependee field whose constraints triggered the comparator value validation failure.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the dependee field within the request structure whose constraints govern the comparator value validation.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the filter field whose supplied value does not match the requirements of the comparator operator in use.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the specific filter field whose value is incompatible with the comparator operator applied to it.

param_name.description: Represents the filter-specific parameter name identifying the request parameter associated with the comparator value mismatch.

message.description: Contains a descriptive error message summarizing the comparator-value mismatch encountered in the filter request.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because the comparator-driven value did not satisfy dependency validation rules.

custom_views__FilterInvalidComparator.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field is provided with a comparator operator that is not supported for that field. The error code is INVALID_DATA.

code.description:
Indicates the category of error associated with this response.
Possible values:
**INVALID_DATA** - An unsupported comparator operator was provided for the filter field.

details.description: Contains structured details identifying the filter field that received an unsupported comparator, including its location, parameter name, and the list of valid comparator values accepted for that field.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the filter field to which an unsupported comparator operator was applied.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the specific filter field within the request payload that carries the unsupported comparator operator.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the filter parameter whose comparator was rejected, scoped as a filter-specific extension to the standard error detail.

items.description: Represents a single comparator value that is valid and accepted for the associated filter field.

supported_values.description: Contains the list of comparator values that are valid for the offending filter field.

message.description: Contains a descriptive summary of the invalid-comparator error, identifying the rejected operator and the affected filter parameter.

status.description:
Indicates the overall outcome of the request.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed due to an invalid filter comparator.

custom_views__FilterEmptyFilterObject.description: Represents the error response returned when a filter object is submitted without any recognized fields — such as group or criteria — where at least one is required for the expression to be valid. The error code is EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING.

code.description:
Indicates the error classification for this failure.
Possible values:
**EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING** - None of the expected filter fields were present in the submitted filter object.

details.description: Contains structured diagnostic detail about the empty filter object, including the parameter name and the list of fields that were expected but entirely absent from the filter expression.

expected_fields.description: Contains the collection of fields that the filter object was expected to include, of which at least one must be present for the request to be valid. Each entry identifies the field by its API name and JSON path.

items.description: Represents a single expected field entry, providing its API name and the JSON path at which it was anticipated within the filter expression.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of a field expected to be present in the filter object.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSON path at which the expected field should be present within the filter object.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the filter parameter associated with the empty filter object error. This field is a filter-specific extension to the standard error detail structure.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the empty filter object error.

status.description:
Represents the outcome status of the API response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because the filter object did not contain any of the expected fields.

custom_views__FilterMandatoryNotFound.description: Represents an error response returned when a mandatory field required by the filter criteria is absent from the request. Includes a filter-specific param_name field that extends the standard MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND error structure.

code.description:
Indicates the error code identifying the category of failure.
Possible values:
**MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND** - A mandatory field was absent from the filter criteria.

details.description: Contains detailed information identifying the mandatory field that is absent from the request, including its API name, JSON path location, and, as a filter-specific extension, its parameter name.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the mandatory field that was not found in the filter criteria.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the mandatory field that is missing from the filter criteria.

param_name.description: Represents the parameter name associated with the missing mandatory field, as a filter-specific extension to the standard error detail.

message.description: Contains a brief error message describing which mandatory field was not found in the filter criteria.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because a mandatory field was absent from the filter criteria.

custom_views__CrossFiltersRequest.description: Represents a list of cross-filter objects that filter Custom View records based on related module records' criteria.

items.description: Represents a single cross-filter object that filters records based on the presence or absence of related module records matching the specified criteria.

include_objects.description: Indicates whether records with matching related records are included in the results.

custom_views__InvalidDataType.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion field value is provided with an incorrect data type. Contains the error code, a descriptive message, the response status, and details identifying the offending field and its expected data type.

code.description:
Represents the error code that identifies the category of validation failure.
Possible values:
INVALID_DATA - Indicates that the value provided for a criterion field does not match the expected data type.

details.description: Contains the details of the invalid data type error, including the API name of the offending criterion field, its JSON path within the request body, and the data type that was expected.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the criterion field whose value was supplied with an invalid data type.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path that locates the specific field within the request body where the invalid data type was detected.

expected_data_type.description: Represents the data type that the API expected for the criterion field identified by the API name, against which the supplied value was validated.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the invalid data type failure in a form suitable for display or logging.

status.description:
Represents the response status for this error response.
Possible values:
error - Indicates that the request failed due to an invalid data type on a criterion field.

custom_views__FieldComparatorValueMissin.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion comparator cannot be applied because the comparator value supplied by the dependee field is absent. Carries error code DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING along with details identifying both the field in error and the dependee field whose value is missing.

code.description:
Represents the error code that identifies the category of failure for this error response.
Possible values:
DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING - Indicates that the comparator value required from the dependee criterion field is absent, preventing the comparator from being evaluated.

details.description: Contains detailed information about the criterion field that caused the error and the dependee field whose comparator value is missing, including the API name and JSON path for each.

dependee.description: Represents the dependee criterion field — that is, the field whose value determines what the current comparator accepts — and whose missing comparator value triggered this error. Contains the API name and JSON path of that dependee field.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the dependee criterion field whose comparator value is absent and caused the evaluation failure.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path that locates the dependee criterion field within the request body, identifying where the missing comparator value was expected.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field that triggered the DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field in error within the request body.

message.description: Error message describing the DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING condition returned in the response envelope.

status.description: Status of the response. Possible values: error.

custom_views__FieldComparatorMismatch.description: Error schema returned when the comparator value supplied for a criterion field does not match the valid comparator values determined by its dependee field. Contains the error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and a details object identifying the criterion field, its dependee field, and the list of supported comparator values.

code.description: Error code identifying the type of field comparator mismatch condition. Possible values: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH.

details.description: Detailed information about the field comparator mismatch, including the API name and JSON path of the criterion field in error, the dependee field that governs valid comparator values, and the array of supported comparator values.

dependee.description: The dependee field whose value determines which comparator values are valid for the criterion field that raised the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Contains the API name and JSON path of the dependee field.

api_name.description: API name of the dependee field that determines the valid comparator values for the criterion field in error.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the dependee field within the request body.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the criterion field whose comparator value does not match any of the supported values determined by the dependee field.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the criterion field whose comparator value does not match any of the supported values determined by the dependee field.

items.description: Represents one supported comparator value valid for the criterion field, as determined by the dependee field.

supported_values.description: Contains the comparator values that are valid for the criterion field, as determined by the dependee field.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the comparator mismatch condition for the criterion field.

status.description: Represents the status of the error response. Possible values: error.

custom_views__FieldValueMismatch.description: Represents the error response returned when the data type of the value supplied for a criterion field does not match the expected data type determined by the dependee field. Returned with error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Contains details identifying the mismatched criterion field, its dependee field, and the expected data type.

code.description: Represents the error code identifying the type of error condition encountered. Possible values: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH.

details.description: Contains detailed information about the data type mismatch, including the criterion field that raised the error, the dependee field whose value determines the expected data type, and the expected data type itself.

dependee.description: Represents the dependee field whose value determines the expected data type for the criterion field that raised the mismatch error. Contains the API name and JSON path of the dependee field.

api_name.description: API name of the dependee field that determines the expected data type for the criterion field in error.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the dependee field within the request body.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field whose value does not match the expected data type.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field whose value contains the data type mismatch.

expected_data_type.description: Data type expected for the criterion field value, as determined by the dependee field.

message.description: Descriptive message providing details about the field value mismatch error.

status.description: Status of the response. Possible values: error.

custom_views__ComparatorValueMismatch.description: Error schema returned when the comparator value itself does not satisfy the dependency validation rules imposed by the dependee field. Carries error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and includes details identifying the criterion field with the invalid comparator value, its dependee field (api_name, json_path), and the criterion field own api_name and json_path.

code.description: Error code identifying the comparator dependency mismatch condition. Possible values: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH.

details.description: Object containing diagnostic detail about the dependency mismatch, including the criterion field with the invalid comparator value (api_name, json_path) and the dependee field that imposed the violated validation rule (dependee.api_name, dependee.json_path).

dependee.description: Identifies the dependee field whose value determines the validation rules applied to the comparator of the criterion field in error. Contains the API name and JSON path of the dependee field.

api_name.description: API name of the dependee field whose value imposed the violated validation rule on the criterion field comparator.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the dependee field within the request body.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field whose comparator value does not satisfy the dependency rule imposed by the dependee field.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field with the invalid comparator value within the request body.

message.description: Descriptive message providing details about the comparator value mismatch error.

status.description: Status of the response indicating the outcome of the request. Possible values: error.

custom_views__InvalidComparator.description: Error schema returned when the comparator specified in a criterion field is not one of the allowed comparator values for the given field type. Returned with error code INVALID_DATA. The details object identifies the offending field by API name and JSON path, and enumerates the supported comparator values.

code.description: Error code identifying the category of error. Possible values: INVALID_DATA.

details.description: Contains structured information about the invalid comparator error. Identifies the offending criterion field by API name and JSON path, and provides the list of supported comparator values valid for the given field type.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field for which an invalid comparator was specified.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field with the invalid comparator within the request body.

items.description: Represents one valid comparator value accepted for the criterion field type.

supported_values.description: Contains the comparator values that are valid for the criterion field type.

message.description: Descriptive error message conveying the nature of the invalid comparator condition to the caller.

status.description: Status of the response indicating the outcome of the request. Possible values: error.

custom_views__LookupLimitExceeded.description: Represents the error response returned when the count of lookup fields used in criterion expressions exceeds the allowed limit. The error code is LOOKUP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. The details object contains a used_in array (minItems: 1, maxItems: 10) in which each entry identifies an affected location by name and provides the relevant lookup fields and the applicable lookup limit.

code.description: Identifies the error code that signals the lookup field limit has been exceeded. Possible values: LOOKUP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

details.description: Provides structured information about the locations where the lookup field count exceeded the allowed limit. The required used_in array contains objects that each specify a location name (such as "criteria" or "cross_filters"), the lookup fields in use, and the applicable lookup limit.

used_in.description: Lists the locations (for example, "criteria" or "cross_filters") where lookup field usage exceeded the allowed limit. Each entry in the array contains a location name, the lookup fields involved, and the applicable lookup limit. The array contains between 1 and 10 items.

items.description: Represents one location — such as criteria or cross_filters — where lookup field usage has exceeded the allowed limit. Each entry identifies the location by name, lists the offending lookup fields, and specifies the maximum number of lookup fields permitted in that location.

name.description: Identifies the location — such as criteria or cross_filters — where the lookup field count exceeded the allowed limit.

lookup_fields.description: Lists the lookup fields present in the specified location that contributed to exceeding the allowed lookup field limit. Contains between 1 and 100 entries, each identifying a single lookup field by its API name.

items.description: Represents one lookup field used in the specified criterion location that was counted against the lookup field limit. Each entry exposes the API name of the offending field.

api_name.description: Specifies the API name of a lookup field that was counted against the lookup field limit for the specified location.

lookup_limit.description: Specifies the maximum number of lookup fields permitted in the associated location, such as criteria or cross_filters.

message.description: Contains a descriptive error message explaining why the lookup field limit was exceeded.

status.description: Indicates the outcome of the request. Possible values: error.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) should be enforced when updating the field. Only applicable when the target field is an Owner field and the org has assignment thresholds configured. When true, the system checks whether the new owner has reached their record limit before applying the update. Ignored for non-Owner fields.

editable.description: Whether the current user can edit this field update action.

source.description: Source application that created or manages this action (e.g., crm).

type.description: Type returned by the API for this field update. Create/update accepts only static; GET responses can include merge_field for pre-existing actions.

created_by.description: User who created this field update action.

notify.description: Whether to send an email notification to the new record owner when the Owner field is updated via this action. Only applicable when the target field is an Owner field. When true, the newly assigned owner receives an email informing them of the ownership change. Ignored for non-Owner fields.

feature_type.description: Automation feature where this field update action is used.

field.description: The target CRM field that this action updates.

dependent_fields.description: Dependent fields that must be set alongside the target field when dependency rules apply. Includes patterns such as Pipeline -> Stage and Layout -> Pipeline -> Stage (nested). Nested dependencies can be represented through dependent_fields within each item. Null when the target field has no dependency rules configured.

associated.description: Whether this action is currently linked to any automation rule, approval process, or blueprint.

related_records.description: List of related modules whose record ownership should also be transferred along with the parent record when the Owner field is updated. Only applicable when the target field is an Owner field. Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules. Additional related modules are available depending on the parent module: Accounts can also include Contacts and Deals; Contacts can also include Deals. Null when the target field is not an Owner field or when no related modules are selected for ownership transfer.

name.description: Display name of the field update action.

modified_by.description: User who last modified this field update action.

value.description: The value configured for the field update. The shape depends on the target field type.

oneOf.description: A plain text value. Used when the target field is a single-value field such as a text field (e.g., Deal_Name), picklist (e.g., Pipeline, Stage), number, date, or similar scalar field types. Example: "PostTest", "Qualification".
An array of selected option values. Used when the target field is a multi-select picklist. Each element represents one selected option. Example: ["Option 1", "Option 2"].

items.description: One selected option value for the multi-select field.

oneOf.description: A structured object value. Used when the target field requires composite data  - for example, a Layout field (with id, name, display_label), an Owner/user-lookup field (with id, name), or other lookup-type fields that resolve to a resource with an identifier.
A boolean value. Used when the target field is a checkbox or boolean-type field. true enables/checks the field, false disables/unchecks it.
A numeric value. Used when the target field is a number, currency, decimal, or percentage field type. Example: 100, 25.5.
A null value. Used to clear/empty the target field  - equivalent to choosing 'empty value' in the field update configuration.

parent_module.description: Parent module context when the field update is configured on a child module. Null when the field update is on a top-level module.

field_updates__FieldUpdateConfigurationF.description: Defines a single field update action, including the target module, target field, mapping type, and the value to apply. Some properties are conditionally required depending on the target field's type — for example, Owner fields require notify and related_records.
field_updates__FieldUpdateConfigurationF.x-zs-llm-description: Describes a single field update action. Required: name, module ({api_name}), field ({id, api_name}), type ('static'), and a value whose shape matches the field's data_type. Conditional: Pipeline field needs a string value (pipeline name) and Stage in dependent_fields; Layout field needs an object value and Pipeline in dependent_fields; Owner field needs value={id}, notify (boolean, required), and related_records (array, required  pass null to skip). Optional: update_type ('overwrite' or 'append' for multi-select fields), apply_assignment_threshold (Owner only).

name.description: Name of the field update action. Must be unique within the org. This label is displayed in the automation rule configuration UI.

module.description: The CRM module where this field update should be applied. Specify using the module's unique ID and/or API name (e.g., Deals, Leads, Contacts).

field.description: Target field to be updated. Provide both field.id and field.api_name. If both are present but inconsistent, ambiguity or invalid-data errors can be returned.

value.description: The value to assign to the target field when this action is triggered. The type must match the target field's data type  - a mismatch returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Pipeline expects a string value from Pipelines metadata; Layout expects a layout object from Layouts metadata; Owner expects a user object from Users API.

type.description: Create/update mapping type. Only static is accepted for create/update payloads.

feature_type.description: The automation feature this field update is associated with. Defaults to 'workflow' if omitted. All enum values are supported for creation via API.

notify.description: Whether to send an email notification to the new owner when the Owner field is updated. Required when the target field is Owner (omitting returns DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING). Must not be sent when the target field is not Owner (returns NOT_ALLOWED).

update_type.description: Strategy for applying the value. Required for multi-select fields: 'overwrite' replaces all existing values, 'append' adds to them. Omit or pass null for single-value fields.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules when updating the Owner field. This key is applicable only for Owner updates, and is required only when active owner-assignment thresholds exist for the module. If thresholds are not configured, sending this key can be rejected as not allowed.

dependent_fields.description: Dependent fields that must be set alongside the target field. Required for dependent picklist relationships. Common chains: Pipeline -> Stage, Layout -> Pipeline, and Layout -> Pipeline -> Stage (nested via dependent_fields inside the Pipeline node).

related_records.description: Related modules whose open record ownership should also be transferred when the Owner field is updated. Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules. Additional modules depend on the parent module: Accounts can also include Contacts and Deals; Contacts can also include Deals. Required when the target field is Owner (omitting returns DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING). Must not be sent when the target field is not Owner (returns NOT_ALLOWED). Pass null to skip ownership transfer on related records.

related_module.description: Related module context when the field update is configured on a related module's records (e.g., updating a field on Contacts related to Accounts). Pass null or omit when not applicable.

field_updates__FieldUpdateConfigurationF.title: Field Update Configuration For Create

fiscal_year__GETFiscalYearNested.description: Represents the fiscal year settings configured for the organization, including the calendar type, start month, structure, and surplus week information.

calendar_type.description: Represents the calendar type configured for the fiscal year.

start_month.description: Represents the start month of the fiscal year.

interval_display_option.description: Represents the display format configured for fiscal periods.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the fiscal year configuration.

structure.description: Represents the week distribution structure configured for the custom fiscal year.

past_surplus_weeks.description: Represents the surplus week configurations from past fiscal years.

start_date.description: Represents the start date of the custom fiscal year.

fiscal_year__SurplusWeekNested.description: Represents the surplus week configuration to apply for a custom fiscal year. Send `null` to clear the configured surplus week, or send a complete object with the quarter, period, and year to set a new surplus week.

oneOf.description: Clears any existing surplus week configuration for the custom fiscal year.

fiscal_year__SurplusWeekValue.description: Represents the surplus week configuration values, including the quarter, period, and year in which the surplus week is placed.

period.description: Specify the fiscal period within the quarter that contains the surplus week.

year.description: Specify the year in which the surplus week is configured. You can configure this only for the current year and the following year.

quarter.description: Specify the fiscal quarter that contains the surplus week.
