allOf.description: Represents the constraint that the ID property is required for the lookup object filter criterion value in request bodies.

related_records__SimpleFilterCriterionVa.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for request bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. The ID property is required.

Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user, in which only the name property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property is included.

name.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the currently logged-in user.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSER} - Represents the currently logged-in user.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user's role, in which the ID property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and the name property is an optional display label.

id.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the logged-in user's role record ID.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSERROLE} - Represents the role of the currently logged-in user.

name.description: Represents an optional display label for the predefined role, such as Logged in User Role.

related_records__SimpleFilterCriterionVa.description: Represents a Boolean filter criterion value. Applicable only when the field has a Boolean data type (checkbox field).

Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator.
Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

related_records__SimpleFilterCriterionVa.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROWPLUS}: Matches records where the date field is on tomorrow or any later date (tomorrow onwards).
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the previous calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAYMINUS}: Matches records where the date field is on yesterday or any earlier date (up to and including yesterday).
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the entire previous calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar week (Monday–Sunday).
x-enumDescriptions.${THISWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has no value set.
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has a value set.

related_records__SimpleFilterCriterionVa.description: Represents a predefined N-period range placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator. Follows the pattern ${NEXT_N_<PERIOD>:<n>} or ${LAST_N_<PERIOD>:<n>}, where PERIOD is DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, or YEARS and n is a positive integer. The current period is always excluded from the range.

Represents a predefined age or due-in-days placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime. Follows the pattern ${AGEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field was exactly n days in the past, or ${DUEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field is exactly n days in the future. Supported comparators are equal, not_equal, less_than, greater_than, less_equal, and greater_equal.

related_records__EqualFilterCriterionReq.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

related_records__NotEqualFilterCriterion.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the not-equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the not-equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the not-equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
not_equal - Matches records where the field value does not equal the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the not_equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the not_equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

related_records__EqualityFilterCriterion.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

related_records__TextFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the text filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the text filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the text comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern.
not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern.
starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string.
ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string.
contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string.
not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

value.description: Represents the string filter value used in the text comparator. Accepts a scalar string or an array of string values.

oneOf.description: Contains an array of primitive string values for the text filter comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

related_records__OrderingFilterCriterion.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the ordering filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the ordering filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the ordering comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
less_than - Matches records where the field value is less than the specified filter value.
less_equal - Matches records where the field value is less than or equal to the specified filter value.
greater_than - Matches records where the field value is greater than the specified filter value.
greater_equal - Matches records where the field value is greater than or equal to the specified filter value.

value.description: Represents the scalar filter value used in the ordering comparator. Arrays and objects are not supported for ordering comparators.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

related_records__BetweenFilterCriterionR.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the range comparison operator applied to the criterion, indicating whether the field value falls within or outside the specified bounds.
Possible values:
between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range.
not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.

related_records__SetFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:

not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

related_records__MultiSelectLookupFilter.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the multi-select lookup filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the multi-select lookup filter criterion is applied. The field must have a data_type of multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

comparator.description:
Represents the multi-select lookup comparison operator applied to the criterion. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Possible values:
include_all - Matches records that include all specified lookup values.
include_any - Matches records that include at least one of the specified lookup values.
exclude_all - Matches records that exclude all specified lookup values.
exclude_any - Matches records that exclude at least one of the specified lookup values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

related_records__SimpleFilterCriterionRe.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

related_records__GroupedFilterCriterionR.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description:
Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.
Possible values:
AND - All conditions in the group must be satisfied.
OR - At least one condition in the group must be satisfied.
and - Equivalent to AND; all conditions in the group must be satisfied.
or - Equivalent to OR; at least one condition in the group must be satisfied.

related_records__FilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user, in which only the name property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property is included.

name.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the currently logged-in user.

${CURRENTUSER} - Represents the currently logged-in user.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user's role, in which the ID property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and the name property is an optional display label.

id.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the logged-in user's role record ID.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSERROLE} - Represents the role of the currently logged-in user.

name.description: Represents an optional display label for the predefined role, such as Logged in User Role.

scoring_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionValu.description: Represents a Boolean filter criterion value. Applicable only when the field has a Boolean data type (checkbox field).

Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).

scoring_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionValu.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.

x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.

scoring_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionValu.description: Represents a predefined N-period range placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator. Follows the pattern ${NEXT_N_<PERIOD>:<n>} or ${LAST_N_<PERIOD>:<n>}, where PERIOD is DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, or YEARS and n is a positive integer. The current period is always excluded from the range.

Represents a predefined age or due-in-days placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime. Follows the pattern ${AGEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field was exactly n days in the past, or ${DUEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field is exactly n days in the future. Supported comparators are equal, not_equal, less_than, greater_than, less_equal, and greater_equal.

comparator.description:

equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values returned for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value returned for the equal comparator. Contains a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:

value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.

items.description: Each string specifies a business day on which the service is available.

Duration.description: Specify the duration of the service, in minutes. Must be greater than 5 minutes and less than 24 hours.

Tax.description: Specify the taxes applied to the service cost. Each entry carries a tax ID and the tax value label.

Price.description: Specify the price charged for the service in the organization currency, with up to 16 digits and 2 decimal places.

zia_suggested_users.description: Specify the Zia-suggested users payload associated with the service record.

Availability_Type.description:
Specify how the service availability is defined. 


**Possible values**: 

- Every Business Days - service is available on every business day.

- Specific Date Range - service is available within an
Available_From and Available_Till range.

- Specific Date(s) - service is available on the dates listed in
Available_Dates.

- Specific Day(s) - service is available on the weekdays listed in
Available_Days.

$zia_owner_assignment.description: Specify the Zia owner-assignment recommendation behavior for the service record.

Members.description: Specify the users who deliver the service. Refer to the [Get users](users.yaml#$.paths./users.get) resource for valid values.

Available_Dates.description: Specify the list of dates on which the service is available, in YYYY-MM-DD format. This key is mandatory when Availability_Type is Specific Date(s).

items.description: Each string specifies one date on which the service is available, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Location.description:
Specify where the service is delivered. 


**Possible values**: Client Address, Business Address, Business
Address and Client Address.

territories__FilterFieldBase.description: Represents the base field reference used in filter operations, containing minimal required properties. The field's data_type is not part of this object; resolve it from the corresponding FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the field used for filter operations.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field used for filter application. Supports relationship notation, for example, Deals__r.Stage.

territories__SimpleFilterCriterionValueS.description: Represents a string filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime, as well as any data_type not explicitly covered by SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber, SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse, or the multiselect lookup value schemas.

territories__SimpleFilterCriterionValueN.description: Represents a numeric filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of integer, currency, or double.

territories__SimpleFilterCriterionValueO.description: Represents the base minified record structure of a lookup module, containing the record's unique identifier and display name.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the lookup module record.

name.description: Represents the display name of the lookup module record.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint that the ID property is required for the lookup object filter criterion value in request bodies.

territories__SimpleFilterCriterionValueO.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for request bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. The ID property is required.

Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user, in which only the name property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property is included.

name.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the currently logged-in user.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSER} - Represents the currently logged-in user.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user's role, in which the ID property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and the name property is an optional display label.

id.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the logged-in user's role record ID.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSERROLE} - Represents the role of the currently logged-in user.

name.description: Represents an optional display label for the predefined role, such as Logged in User Role.

territories__SimpleFilterCriterionValueB.description: Represents a Boolean filter criterion value. Applicable only when the field has a Boolean data type (checkbox field).

territories__SimpleFilterCriterionValueG.description:
Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator.
Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

territories__SimpleFilterCriterionValueD.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROWPLUS}: Matches records where the date field is on tomorrow or any later date (tomorrow onwards).
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the previous calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAYMINUS}: Matches records where the date field is on yesterday or any earlier date (up to and including yesterday).
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the entire previous calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar week (Monday–Sunday).
x-enumDescriptions.${THISWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has no value set.
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has a value set.

territories__SimpleFilterCriterionValueN.description: Represents a predefined N-period range placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator. Follows the pattern ${NEXT_N_<PERIOD>:<n>} or ${LAST_N_<PERIOD>:<n>}, where PERIOD is DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, or YEARS and n is a positive integer. The current period is always excluded from the range.

territories__SimpleFilterCriterionValueA.description: Represents a predefined age or due-in-days placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime. Follows the pattern ${AGEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field was exactly n days in the past, or ${DUEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field is exactly n days in the future. Supported comparators are equal, not_equal, less_than, greater_than, less_equal, and greater_equal.

territories__EqualFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories__NotEqualFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the not-equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the not-equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the not-equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
not_equal - Matches records where the field value does not equal the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the not_equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the not_equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories__EqualityFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

territories__TextFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the text filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the text filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the text comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern.
not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern.
starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string.
ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string.
contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string.
not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

value.description: Represents the string filter value used in the text comparator. Accepts a scalar string or an array of string values.

oneOf.description: Contains an array of primitive string values for the text filter comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories__OrderingFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the ordering filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the ordering filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the ordering comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
less_than - Matches records where the field value is less than the specified filter value.
less_equal - Matches records where the field value is less than or equal to the specified filter value.
greater_than - Matches records where the field value is greater than the specified filter value.
greater_equal - Matches records where the field value is greater than or equal to the specified filter value.

value.description: Represents the scalar filter value used in the ordering comparator. Arrays and objects are not supported for ordering comparators.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories__BetweenFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the range comparison operator applied to the criterion, indicating whether the field value falls within or outside the specified bounds.
Possible values:
between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range.
not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories__SetFilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the set membership comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
in - Matches records where the field value is in the specified set of values.
not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories__MultiSelectLookupFilterCrit.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the multi-select lookup filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the multi-select lookup filter criterion is applied. The field must have a data_type of multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

comparator.description:
Represents the multi-select lookup comparison operator applied to the criterion. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Possible values:
include_all - Matches records that include all specified lookup values.
include_any - Matches records that include at least one of the specified lookup values.
exclude_all - Matches records that exclude all specified lookup values.
exclude_any - Matches records that exclude at least one of the specified lookup values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

territories__SimpleFilterCriterionReques.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

territories__GroupedFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description:
Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.
Possible values:
AND - All conditions in the group must be satisfied.
OR - At least one condition in the group must be satisfied.
and - Equivalent to AND; all conditions in the group must be satisfied.
or - Equivalent to OR; at least one condition in the group must be satisfied.

territories__FilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint that both the ID and name properties are required for the lookup object filter criterion value in response bodies.

territories__SimpleFilterCriterionValueO.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for response bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. Both the ID and name properties are included.

territories__EqualFilterCriterionRespons.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the equal comparison operator returned for the criterion.
Possible values:
equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values returned for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value returned for the equal comparator. Contains a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the equal filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories__NotEqualFilterCriterionResp.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for numeric types; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse for lookup types; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role placeholders.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the not-equal filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the not-equal filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the not-equal comparison operator returned for the criterion.
Possible values:
not_equal - Matches records where the field value does not equal the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values returned for the not_equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value returned for the not_equal comparator. Contains a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the not-equal filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories__EqualityFilterCriterionResp.description: Represents the response for an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionResponse or NotEqualFilterCriterionResponse schema based on the comparator value.

territories__TextFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value is a string scalar or array; SimpleFilterCriterionValueString applies to text-based field types.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the text filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the text filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the text comparison operator returned for the criterion.
Possible values:
like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern.
not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern.
starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string.
ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string.
contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string.
not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

value.description: Represents the string filter value returned for the text comparator. Contains a scalar string or an array of string values.

oneOf.description: Contains an array of primitive string values returned for the text filter comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the text filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories__OrderingFilterCriterionResp.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value is a scalar; arrays and objects are not valid.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the ordering filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the ordering filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the ordering comparison operator returned for the criterion.
Possible values:
less_than - Matches records where the field value is less than the specified filter value.
less_equal - Matches records where the field value is less than or equal to the specified filter value.
greater_than - Matches records where the field value is greater than the specified filter value.
greater_equal - Matches records where the field value is greater than or equal to the specified filter value.

value.description: Represents the scalar filter value returned for the ordering comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the ordering filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories__BetweenFilterCriterionRespo.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the between and not_between comparators. The value is an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the range comparison operator returned for the criterion, indicating whether the field value falls within or outside the specified bounds.
Possible values:
between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range.
not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field was evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the between filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories__SetFilterCriterionResponse.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the in and not_in comparators. The value is an array of primitive values.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion was applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the set membership comparison operator returned for the criterion.
Possible values:
in - Matches records where the field value is in the specified set of values.
not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values returned for the set comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
