field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the set filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories__MultiSelectLookupFilterCrit.description: Represents the response for a filter criterion using the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the multi-select lookup filter criterion response.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the multi-select lookup filter criterion was applied. The field has a data_type of multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

comparator.description:
Represents the multi-select lookup comparison operator returned for the criterion. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Possible values:
include_all - Matches records that include all specified lookup values.
include_any - Matches records that include at least one of the specified lookup values.
exclude_all - Matches records that exclude all specified lookup values.
exclude_any - Matches records that exclude at least one of the specified lookup values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references returned for the multi-select comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the multi-select lookup filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable field or value reference.

territories__SimpleFilterCriterionRespon.description: Represents the response for a simple field-based filter criterion, dispatching to the appropriate comparator-specific response schema.

territories__GroupedFilterCriterionRespo.description: Represents the grouped filter criterion returned in the response, containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description:
Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.
Possible values:
AND - All conditions in the group must be satisfied.
OR - At least one condition in the group must be satisfied.
and - Equivalent to AND; all conditions in the group must be satisfied.
or - Equivalent to OR; at least one condition in the group must be satisfied.

$disrupted.description: Indicates whether the grouped filter criterion is in a disrupted state, typically due to an invalid or unresolvable condition within the group.

territories__FilterNotSupportedApiName.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter criterion references a field API name that is not supported for filtering. The details object identifies the unsupported field and its location within the filter parameter.

code.description:
Indicates the error classification assigned to this response.
Possible values:
**NOT_SUPPORTED** - The referenced field API name is not permitted for use in filter criteria.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field that is not supported for use in filter criteria and triggered this error.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSONPath location of the unsupported field within the filter expression.

param_name.description: Represents the name of the filter request parameter that carried the unsupported field API name.

details.description: Contains the contextual details identifying the unsupported field that caused the error, including its API name, its location within the filter expression, and the name of the filter parameter involved.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the nature of the error returned by the API.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the API response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because an unsupported field API name was used in the filter criteria.

territories__FilterEmptyFilterObject.description: Represents the error response returned when a filter object is submitted without any recognized fields — such as group or criteria — where at least one is required for the expression to be valid. The error code is EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING.

code.description:
Indicates the error classification for this failure.
Possible values:
**EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING** - None of the expected filter fields were present in the submitted filter object.

details.description: Contains structured diagnostic detail about the empty filter object, including the parameter name and the list of fields that were expected but entirely absent from the filter expression.

expected_fields.description: Contains the collection of fields that the filter object was expected to include, of which at least one must be present for the request to be valid. Each entry identifies the field by its API name and JSON path.

items.description: Represents a single expected field entry, providing its API name and the JSON path at which it was anticipated within the filter expression.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of a field expected to be present in the filter object.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSON path at which the expected field should be present within the filter object.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the filter parameter associated with the empty filter object error. This field is a filter-specific extension to the standard error detail structure.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the empty filter object error.

status.description:
Represents the outcome status of the API response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because the filter object did not contain any of the expected fields.

territories__FilterMandatoryNotFound.description: Represents an error response returned when a mandatory field required by the filter criteria is absent from the request. Includes a filter-specific param_name field that extends the standard MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND error structure.

code.description:
Indicates the error code identifying the category of failure.
Possible values:
**MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND** - A mandatory field was absent from the filter criteria.

details.description: Contains detailed information identifying the mandatory field that is absent from the request, including its API name, JSON path location, and, as a filter-specific extension, its parameter name.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the mandatory field that was not found in the filter criteria.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the mandatory field that is missing from the filter criteria.

param_name.description: Represents the parameter name associated with the missing mandatory field, as a filter-specific extension to the standard error detail.

message.description: Contains a brief error message describing which mandatory field was not found in the filter criteria.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because a mandatory field was absent from the filter criteria.

territories__FilterInvalidComparator.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field is provided with a comparator operator that is not supported for that field. The error code is INVALID_DATA.

code.description:
Indicates the category of error associated with this response.
Possible values:
**INVALID_DATA** - An unsupported comparator operator was provided for the filter field.

details.description: Contains structured details identifying the filter field that received an unsupported comparator, including its location, parameter name, and the list of valid comparator values accepted for that field.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the filter field to which an unsupported comparator operator was applied.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the specific filter field within the request payload that carries the unsupported comparator operator.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the filter parameter whose comparator was rejected, scoped as a filter-specific extension to the standard error detail.

items.description: Represents a single comparator value that is valid and accepted for the associated filter field.

supported_values.description: Contains the list of comparator values that are valid for the offending filter field.

message.description: Contains a descriptive summary of the invalid-comparator error, identifying the rejected operator and the affected filter parameter.

status.description:
Indicates the overall outcome of the request.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed due to an invalid filter comparator.

territories__FilterFieldComparatorValueM.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field that requires a comparator value is submitted without one, typically because a required upstream dependee field is absent from the filter expression.

code.description:
Indicates the error classification assigned to this response.
Possible values:
**DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING** - A filter field's required comparator value is absent because its upstream dependee field was not supplied in the filter criteria.

details.description: Contains structured details about the missing comparator value error, identifying the field in error, the upstream dependee field that constrains it, and the filter parameter context in which the violation occurred.

dependee.description: Represents the upstream field whose value constrains the comparator requirements of the field currently in error. Contains the API name and JSONPath location of that upstream dependee field within the filter expression.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the upstream dependee field whose value constrains the comparator requirements of the field currently in error.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSONPath location of the upstream dependee field within the filter expression.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the filter field whose comparator value is absent, identifying which field in the filter expression triggered the error.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSONPath location of the field in error within the filter expression, pinpointing where the missing comparator value was detected.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the filter parameter that carries the filter criteria in which the missing comparator value was detected.

message.description: Contains a descriptive message summarizing the missing comparator value error.

status.description:
Represents the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because a required comparator value was absent from the filter criteria.

territories__FilterFieldComparatorMismat.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter field's comparator value does not match any of the values permitted by the upstream dependee field's value. Contains the offending field's API name and JSONPath location, the dependee field's identity, the filter parameter context, and the list of supported comparator values.

code.description:
Indicates the error type for this response.
Possible values:
**DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** - The comparator supplied for the field does not match the set of comparators permitted given the current value of the dependee field.

details.description: Contains structured details about the comparator mismatch, identifying the field in error, the upstream dependee field whose value constrains valid comparators, and the set of comparator values that are permitted.

dependee.description: Represents the upstream field whose current value determines which comparators are valid for the field identified in `api_name`. Contains the upstream field's API name and its location within the filter expression.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the upstream dependee field whose value constrains the set of comparators permitted for the field currently in error.

json_path.description: Contains the JSONPath expression locating the dependee field within the filter expression submitted in the request.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the field whose supplied comparator value does not match the comparators permitted given the current value of the dependee field.

json_path.description: Contains the JSONPath expression locating the field in error within the filter expression submitted in the request.

items.description: Represents a single comparator value that is valid for the field in error given the current value of the dependee field.

supported_values.description: Contains the complete set of comparator values that are permitted for the field in error, as determined by the current value of the dependee field.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the filter query parameter that carries the filter expression containing the comparator mismatch.

message.description: Represents a short, descriptive summary of the comparator-field dependency violation.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome of the request.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed due to a comparator value mismatch in the filter criteria.

territories__FilterFieldValueMismatch.description: Represents the error response returned when a filter field's value carries a data type that does not satisfy the requirement imposed by its dependee field's current value.

code.description:
Indicates the category of error associated with this response.
Possible values:
**DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** - A filter field's value has a data type that conflicts with the requirement set by the dependee field.

details.description: Contains diagnostic details identifying the offending filter field, its expected data type, the dependee field that governs that expectation, and the filter parameter in which the mismatch was detected.

dependee.description: Represents the field whose current value dictates the required data type for the offending filter field.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the dependee field whose value drives the data type requirement for the offending filter field.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSON path locating the dependee field within the request payload.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the filter field whose supplied value does not match the data type required by the dependee field.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSON path locating the filter field whose value carries the data type mismatch within the request payload.

expected_data_type.description: Indicates the data type expected by the dependee field against which the submitted filter value was validated.

param_name.description: Represents the filter-specific query parameter name associated with the field that failed value validation.

message.description: Contains a descriptive explanation of the filter field value mismatch error.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because a filter field value did not match the type required by the dependee field.

territories__FilterComparatorValueMismat.description: Represents an error returned when a value associated with a filter comparator fails validation due to constraints imposed by a dependee field. This error targets the value driven by the comparator rather than the comparator operator selection itself.

code.description:
Indicates the classification of the error.
Possible values:
**DEPENDENT_MISMATCH** - The comparator-driven value failed validation due to constraints imposed by the dependee field.

details.description: Contains structured diagnostic details identifying the filter field whose comparator-driven value failed dependency validation, including the controlling dependee field reference.

dependee.description: Represents the dependee field whose state or constraints govern the validation rules applied to the comparator value of the current filter field.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the dependee field whose constraints triggered the comparator value validation failure.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the dependee field within the request structure whose constraints govern the comparator value validation.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the filter field whose supplied value does not match the requirements of the comparator operator in use.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the specific filter field whose value is incompatible with the comparator operator applied to it.

param_name.description: Represents the filter-specific parameter name identifying the request parameter associated with the comparator value mismatch.

message.description: Contains a descriptive error message summarizing the comparator-value mismatch encountered in the filter request.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because the comparator-driven value did not satisfy dependency validation rules.

territories__FilterInvalidParamDataType.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter parameter is supplied with an incorrect data type. Contains the error code, a descriptive message, and details identifying the offending parameter along with its expected data type.

code.description:
Represents the error classification code for this response.
Possible values:
**INVALID_DATA** - The filter parameter was supplied with an incorrect data type.

details.description: Contains structured details about the data type mismatch, including the name of the offending filter parameter and the data type it is expected to carry.

expected_data_type.description: Represents the data type that the filter parameter is required to carry for the request to be valid.

param_name.description: Represents the name of the query or body parameter — such as `filters` — that carries the filter criteria and was supplied with an invalid data type.

message.description: Represents a descriptive message explaining the data type error encountered for the filter parameter.

status.description:
Represents the outcome of the request.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed due to an invalid filter parameter data type.

territories__FilterInvalidFieldDataType.description: Represents the error response returned when a field within the filter criteria contains a value of an incorrect data type. Includes the API name of the offending field, its JSONPath location within the filter expression, and the data type the field expects.

code.description:
Indicates the category of error returned.
Possible values:
**INVALID_DATA** - A field in the filter criteria was supplied with an incorrect data type.

details.description: Contains diagnostic details identifying the specific filter field whose value failed the data type check, including its API name, its location in the filter expression, the expected data type, and the name of the filter parameter that carried the criteria.

api_name.description: Indicates the API name of the filter field whose supplied value does not match the field's required data type.

json_path.description: Indicates the JSONPath location within the filter criteria expression where the data type mismatch was detected.

expected_data_type.description: Indicates the data type that the identified filter field requires, against which the submitted value was evaluated and found incompatible.

param_name.description: Indicates the name of the query or body parameter that carried the filter criteria containing the invalid field value.

message.description: Represents a brief description of the data type error encountered for the filter field.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome of the request.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed due to an invalid data type in the filter criteria.

territories__FilterFieldNotSupportedInCr.description: Represents an error response returned when a filter criteria field references a field type that is not supported for filtering, such as file upload or image upload fields.

code.description:
Indicates the error code identifying the category of failure.
Possible values:
**INVALID_DATA** - The field referenced in the filter criteria is not supported for filtering.

details.description: Contains details identifying the specific field that is not supported in filter criteria, including its API name, JSON path, and associated parameter name.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field that is not supported within the filter criteria expression.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the unsupported field within the filter criteria structure.

param_name.description: Represents the parameter name associated with the unsupported field, as a filter-specific extension to the standard error detail.

message.description: Contains a brief error message describing why the specified field is not supported in the filter criteria.

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the response.
Possible values:
**error** - The request failed because a field type not supported in filter criteria was referenced.

territories__InvalidDataType.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion field value is provided with an incorrect data type. Contains the error code, a descriptive message, the response status, and details identifying the offending field and its expected data type.

code.description:
Represents the error code that identifies the category of validation failure.
Possible values:
INVALID_DATA - Indicates that the value provided for a criterion field does not match the expected data type.

details.description: Contains the details of the invalid data type error, including the API name of the offending criterion field, its JSON path within the request body, and the data type that was expected.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the criterion field whose value was supplied with an invalid data type.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path that locates the specific field within the request body where the invalid data type was detected.

expected_data_type.description: Represents the data type that the API expected for the criterion field identified by the API name, against which the supplied value was validated.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the invalid data type failure in a form suitable for display or logging.

status.description:
Represents the response status for this error response.
Possible values:
error - Indicates that the request failed due to an invalid data type on a criterion field.

territories__FieldComparatorValueMissing.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion comparator cannot be applied because the comparator value supplied by the dependee field is absent. Carries error code DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING along with details identifying both the field in error and the dependee field whose value is missing.

code.description:
Represents the error code that identifies the category of failure for this error response.
Possible values:
DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING - Indicates that the comparator value required from the dependee criterion field is absent, preventing the comparator from being evaluated.

details.description: Contains detailed information about the criterion field that caused the error and the dependee field whose comparator value is missing, including the API name and JSON path for each.

dependee.description: Represents the dependee criterion field — that is, the field whose value determines what the current comparator accepts — and whose missing comparator value triggered this error. Contains the API name and JSON path of that dependee field.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the dependee criterion field whose comparator value is absent and caused the evaluation failure.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path that locates the dependee criterion field within the request body, identifying where the missing comparator value was expected.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field that triggered the DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field in error within the request body.

message.description: Error message describing the DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING condition returned in the response envelope.

status.description: Status of the response. Possible values: error.

territories__FieldComparatorMismatch.description: Error schema returned when the comparator value supplied for a criterion field does not match the valid comparator values determined by its dependee field. Contains the error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and a details object identifying the criterion field, its dependee field, and the list of supported comparator values.

code.description: Error code identifying the type of field comparator mismatch condition. Possible values: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH.

details.description: Detailed information about the field comparator mismatch, including the API name and JSON path of the criterion field in error, the dependee field that governs valid comparator values, and the array of supported comparator values.

dependee.description: The dependee field whose value determines which comparator values are valid for the criterion field that raised the DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Contains the API name and JSON path of the dependee field.

api_name.description: API name of the dependee field that determines the valid comparator values for the criterion field in error.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the dependee field within the request body.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the criterion field whose comparator value does not match any of the supported values determined by the dependee field.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path locating the criterion field whose comparator value does not match any of the supported values determined by the dependee field.

items.description: Represents one supported comparator value valid for the criterion field, as determined by the dependee field.

supported_values.description: Contains the comparator values that are valid for the criterion field, as determined by the dependee field.

message.description: Represents the error message describing the comparator mismatch condition for the criterion field.

status.description: Represents the status of the error response. Possible values: error.

territories__FieldValueMismatch.description: Represents the error response returned when the data type of the value supplied for a criterion field does not match the expected data type determined by the dependee field. Returned with error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Contains details identifying the mismatched criterion field, its dependee field, and the expected data type.

code.description: Represents the error code identifying the type of error condition encountered. Possible values: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH.

details.description: Contains detailed information about the data type mismatch, including the criterion field that raised the error, the dependee field whose value determines the expected data type, and the expected data type itself.

dependee.description: Represents the dependee field whose value determines the expected data type for the criterion field that raised the mismatch error. Contains the API name and JSON path of the dependee field.

api_name.description: API name of the dependee field that determines the expected data type for the criterion field in error.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the dependee field within the request body.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field whose value does not match the expected data type.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field whose value contains the data type mismatch.

expected_data_type.description: Data type expected for the criterion field value, as determined by the dependee field.

message.description: Descriptive message providing details about the field value mismatch error.

status.description: Status of the response. Possible values: error.

territories__ComparatorValueMismatch.description: Error schema returned when the comparator value itself does not satisfy the dependency validation rules imposed by the dependee field. Carries error code DEPENDENT_MISMATCH and includes details identifying the criterion field with the invalid comparator value, its dependee field (api_name, json_path), and the criterion field own api_name and json_path.

code.description: Error code identifying the comparator dependency mismatch condition. Possible values: DEPENDENT_MISMATCH.

details.description: Object containing diagnostic detail about the dependency mismatch, including the criterion field with the invalid comparator value (api_name, json_path) and the dependee field that imposed the violated validation rule (dependee.api_name, dependee.json_path).

dependee.description: Identifies the dependee field whose value determines the validation rules applied to the comparator of the criterion field in error. Contains the API name and JSON path of the dependee field.

api_name.description: API name of the dependee field whose value imposed the violated validation rule on the criterion field comparator.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the dependee field within the request body.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field whose comparator value does not satisfy the dependency rule imposed by the dependee field.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field with the invalid comparator value within the request body.

message.description: Descriptive message providing details about the comparator value mismatch error.

status.description: Status of the response indicating the outcome of the request. Possible values: error.

territories__InvalidComparator.description: Error schema returned when the comparator specified in a criterion field is not one of the allowed comparator values for the given field type. Returned with error code INVALID_DATA. The details object identifies the offending field by API name and JSON path, and enumerates the supported comparator values.

code.description: Error code identifying the category of error. Possible values: INVALID_DATA.

details.description: Contains structured information about the invalid comparator error. Identifies the offending criterion field by API name and JSON path, and provides the list of supported comparator values valid for the given field type.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field for which an invalid comparator was specified.

json_path.description: JSON path locating the criterion field with the invalid comparator within the request body.

items.description: Represents one valid comparator value accepted for the criterion field type.

supported_values.description: Contains the comparator values that are valid for the criterion field type.

message.description: Descriptive error message conveying the nature of the invalid comparator condition to the caller.

status.description: Status of the response indicating the outcome of the request. Possible values: error.

territories__LookupLimitExceeded.description: Represents the error response returned when the count of lookup fields used in criterion expressions exceeds the allowed limit. The error code is LOOKUP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED. The details object contains a used_in array (minItems: 1, maxItems: 10) in which each entry identifies an affected location by name and provides the relevant lookup fields and the applicable lookup limit.

code.description: Identifies the error code that signals the lookup field limit has been exceeded. Possible values: LOOKUP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

details.description: Provides structured information about the locations where the lookup field count exceeded the allowed limit. The required used_in array contains objects that each specify a location name (such as "criteria" or "cross_filters"), the lookup fields in use, and the applicable lookup limit.

used_in.description: Lists the locations (for example, "criteria" or "cross_filters") where lookup field usage exceeded the allowed limit. Each entry in the array contains a location name, the lookup fields involved, and the applicable lookup limit. The array contains between 1 and 10 items.

items.description: Represents one location — such as criteria or cross_filters — where lookup field usage has exceeded the allowed limit. Each entry identifies the location by name, lists the offending lookup fields, and specifies the maximum number of lookup fields permitted in that location.

name.description: Identifies the location — such as criteria or cross_filters — where the lookup field count exceeded the allowed limit.

lookup_fields.description: Lists the lookup fields present in the specified location that contributed to exceeding the allowed lookup field limit. Contains between 1 and 100 entries, each identifying a single lookup field by its API name.

items.description: Represents one lookup field used in the specified criterion location that was counted against the lookup field limit. Each entry exposes the API name of the offending field.

api_name.description: Specifies the API name of a lookup field that was counted against the lookup field limit for the specified location.

lookup_limit.description: Specifies the maximum number of lookup fields permitted in the associated location, such as criteria or cross_filters.

message.description: Contains a descriptive error message explaining why the lookup field limit was exceeded.

status.description: Indicates the outcome of the request. Possible values: error.

territories__NotSupportedApiName.description: Represents the error response returned when the API name specified in a criterion field is not supported by the target module. Contains the error code, a descriptive message, the response status, and details identifying the unsupported field and its location in the request body.

code.description:
Represents the error code that identifies the category of validation failure.
Possible values:
NOT_SUPPORTED - Indicates that the API name specified for the criterion field is not supported by the target module.

details.description: Contains detailed information identifying the criterion field whose API name is not supported by the target module, including the field API name and its location within the request body.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the criterion field that is not supported by the target module.

json_path.description: Represents the JSON path that locates the unsupported criterion field within the request body.

message.description: Represents the error message describing why the criterion field API name is not supported by the target module.

status.description:
Represents the outcome status of the response for this error condition.
Possible values:
error - Indicates the request failed because the specified criterion field API name is not supported by the target module.

territories__FieldNotSupportedInCriteria.description: Represents the error response returned when a criterion field type is not supported in filter criteria. Field types such as file upload and image upload cannot be used as filter criteria fields. The error code is INVALID_DATA. The details object identifies the unsupported field via its api_name and json_path.

code.description:
Indicates the classification of the error returned by the API.

Possible values:
INVALID_DATA - The request contains a criterion field whose type is not supported in filter criteria.

details.description: Contains detailed information identifying the unsupported criterion field. The api_name property specifies the API name of the offending field, and the json_path property locates it within the request body.

api_name.description: Specifies the API name of the criterion field whose type is not supported in filter criteria.

json_path.description: Specifies the JSON path that locates the unsupported criterion field within the request body.

message.description:
Provides a fixed descriptive message identifying the unsupported criterion field.

Possible values:
"The given field api_name is not supported in criteria" - Indicates that the field identified by api_name cannot be used in filter criteria.
enum: The given field api_name is not supported in criteria

status.description:
Indicates the outcome status of the API response.

Possible values:
error - The request failed because the specified criterion field type is not supported in filter criteria.

territories__MandatoryNotFound.description: Error schema returned when a mandatory criterion field is absent from the request. The error code MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND is issued, and the details object identifies the missing field via its api_name and json_path properties.

code.description:
Error code identifying the category of error.

Possible values:
MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND - Indicates that a required criterion field was absent from the request.

details.description: Object identifying the mandatory criterion field that is absent from the request. Contains the api_name of the missing field and the json_path indicating its expected location in the request body.

api_name.description: API name of the criterion field that is required but was not found in the request.

json_path.description: JSON path to the location in the request body where the mandatory criterion field was expected but not found.

message.description: Error message describing the mandatory field not found condition returned in the response envelope.

status.description:
Status of the error response.

Possible values:
error - Indicates that the request failed because a mandatory criterion field was not found.

webhooks__WebhookRequestBody.description:
Represents the request body configuration for the outgoing webhook request. For type **form_data**, provide form_data_content with module_parameters and custom_parameters; format may be null. 

For type **raw**, supply raw_data_content and a format value of JSON, XML, Text, or HTML. For type **none**, the body carries no content and format may be null.
webhooks__WebhookRequestBody.x-zs-llm-description: Configures the webhook request body; type and format are required for all variants. For type=form_data: supply form_data_content with module_parameters and custom_parameters sub-arrays; format may be null. For type=raw: supply raw_data_content (a string) and a format value of JSON, XML, Text, or HTML note the field is raw_data_content, not data, and format, not content_type. For type=none: the body carries no content and format may be null, but the field must still be present. Example form_data: {"type":"form_data","format":null,"form_data_content":{"module_parameters":[{"name":"Lead_Source","value":"${!Leads.Lead_Source}"}],"custom_parameters":[{"name":"key","value":"val"}]}}. Example (raw): {"type":"raw","format":"JSON","raw_data_content":"{\"lead\":\"${!Leads.Full_Name}\"}"}.

Specify the body content format.
Possible values:

**XML** - XML format.
**Text** - Plain text format.
**HTML** - HTML format.
**null** - Valid for form_data and none body types.

type.description:

**form_data** - Sends data as key-value pairs in the request body.
**raw** - Sends plain text, JSON, HTML, or XML content directly.

webhooks__WebhookCreateInput.description: Represents the writable fields for creating a new webhook. Required fields are name, module, url, http_method, authentication, and feature_type. webhooks__WebhookCreateInput.x-zs-llm-description: Defines the writable fields when creating a webhook. Before submitting: `getModules` to confirm valid module api_names. Required: name, module, url, http_method, authentication, and feature_type. System-managed fields (id, created_time, modified_time, created_by, modified_by, lock_status, editable, deletable, associated, source, category) must not be included.

name.description: Specify the display name of the webhook. The name must not contain the tilde (~) character.

module.description: The CRM module this webhook is associated with. Provide at least one of api_name or id. Cannot be changed after creation.

url.description: Specify the destination URL that receives the webhook request when triggered. The URL must begin with http://, https://, www., or a merge-field token (${...}). URLs resolving to internal or private host addresses are rejected by SSRF protection.

http_method.description:
Specify the HTTP method used when the webhook fires. POST and PUT accept headers and body. GET and DELETE accept url_parameters. DELETE also accepts headers.
Possible values:
**POST** - Sends a POST request.
**GET** - Sends a GET request.
**PUT** - Sends a PUT request.
**DELETE** - Sends a DELETE request.

authentication.description: Authentication configuration. Required for all webhooks, including those without authentication credentials. Use type=general for webhooks that do not require authentication (no connection_name needed). Use type=connection when the webhook endpoint requires authenticated access via a pre-configured connection (connection_name is required).

description.description: Specify the optional description of the webhook purpose.
description.example: Fires when a new lead is created

related_module.description: Related CRM module. Required when feature_type is kiosk. Null otherwise.

feature_type.description:
Specify the automation feature type for this webhook.
Possible values:
**workflow** - Workflow Rule.
**approval_process** - Approval Process.
**blueprint_transition** - Blueprint transition.
**blueprint_state** - Blueprint state.
**assignment_rules** - Assignment Rules.
**kiosk** - Kiosk feature.
**commandcenter_service** - CommandCenter service.

headers.description: HTTP headers for the outgoing webhook request. Only allowed when http_method is POST, PUT, or DELETE. Restricted header name: HOST is not allowed. Parameter names must be unique across the collection (DUPLICATE_DATA).

url_parameters.description: URL query parameters for the outgoing request. Only allowed when http_method is GET or DELETE.

body.description: Request body configuration. Only allowed when http_method is POST or PUT. type and format are required. When type=form_data: provide form_data_content (object with module_parameters and custom_parameters arrays); When type=raw: provide raw_data_content (string) and format (JSON, XML, Text, or HTML). When type=none: format may be null.

date_time_format.description: Optional. Only relevant when a date or datetime merge-field is used in any parameter (headers, url_parameters, or body). Use datetime_format + time_zone when a datetime field is referenced (e.g., ${!Leads.Created_Time}). Use date_format when a date field is referenced (e.g., ${!Leads.Date_1}). Ignored if no date/datetime merge-fields are present.

webhooks__AutomationUsageResource.description: Represents a reference to the specific automation action that generated usage. The identifier and name are resolved from the action's configuration record; for deleted actions, the name falls back to the corresponding automation audit log entry. When the include_inner_details parameter includes resource.layout_id and the action is associated with a wizard layout, a layout_id field is included in the representation.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the automation action, such as an email notification ID or a webhook ID.

name.description: Represents the display name of the automation action. Falls back to the name recorded in the automation audit log when the action has been deleted.

layout_id.description: Represents the identifier of the wizard layout associated with the automation action. Present only when the include_inner_details query parameter is set to resource.layout_id and the action is linked to a wizard layout.

webhooks__AutomationUsageResource.title: Automation Usage Resource

webhooks__AutomationUsageDataEntry.description: Represents a single daily usage data point capturing the execution count for an automation action. When the group_by parameter includes resource, the embedded resource object identifies the individual email notification or webhook. When group_by is date only, the resource object is omitted and the count reflects total executions across all actions for that day. The type field indicates the automation feature responsible for the executions, such as workflow_rules, approval_process, or Blueprint.

date.description: Represents the date of this usage data point in YYYY-MM-DD format. All dates are evaluated in the organization's time zone.

resource.description: Reference to the specific automation action (email notification or webhook) that generated the usage count. Only present when group_by includes 'resource'.

count.description: Represents the number of times the automation action was executed on this date. When the group_by parameter is set to 'date' only, this value reflects the total across all actions.

type.description: Represents the automation feature type associated with the reported executions. Values correspond to the filter types supported by the type query parameter, such as workflow_rules, approval_process, Blueprint, email_notifications, webhooks, and kiosks.

webhooks__AutomationUsageDataEntry.title: Automation Usage Data Entry

webhooks__AutomationUsagePaginationInfo.description: Represents pagination metadata returned with automation usage report responses. Includes a max_limit value that reflects the edition-specific daily execution cap for the relevant action type, derived from the organization's feature limits.

per_page.description: Represents the number of records returned in each page of the result set.

count.description: Represents the number of records included in the current page of results.

page.description: Represents the one-based index of the current page within the paginated result set.

more_records.description:
Indicates whether additional pages of results are available beyond the current page.
Possible values:
true - More records exist beyond the current page.
false - The current page contains the last records.

max_limit.description: Represents the edition-specific daily execution cap for the automation action type. For email notifications, this reflects the WORKFLOWALERT day limit; for webhooks, it reflects the WFWEBHOOK day limit. Lower-tier editions carry smaller caps.

webhooks__AutomationUsagePaginationInfo.title: Automation Usage Pagination Info

webhooks__AutomationUsageReportResponse.description: Represents a successful response from an automation usage report endpoint. Contains an array of daily usage data points alongside pagination metadata that includes the edition-specific daily execution cap. When no usage exists for the queried period, the endpoint returns an empty data array rather than null, and the response resolves with HTTP 200.

data_usage.description: Contains the collection of usage data points for the queried period. Each entry represents the execution count for a specific automation action on a given date. Returns an empty array when no usage exists for the queried period.

info.description: Pagination metadata including the edition-specific daily execution cap.

webhooks__AutomationUsageReportResponse.title: Automation Usage Report Response

workflow_configurations__Getworkflowconf.title: Workflow Configurations Response

workflow_configurations__WorkflowConfigu.description: Configuration metadata for workflows on a specific module. Contains three sections: triggers (events that fire the rule), actions (operations available when the rule fires with their per-type limits and scheduling support), and related_triggers_details (child/related modules like Notes or Calls whose events can also trigger rules on the parent module).
workflow_configurations__WorkflowConfigu.x-zs-llm-description: Use this schema to understand which triggers and action types can be used when composing workflow rule requests for the module.

related_triggers_details.description: List of related modules (e.g., Notes, Calls, Activities) whose record events can trigger workflow rules on the parent module. Each entry contains the related module's identity and available trigger types.
related_triggers_details.x-zs-llm-description: Use this list only when a workflow rule should be triggered by events from a related module rather than the primary module.

triggers.description: Represents the list of trigger types available for the module. Each entry defines an event that can initiate a workflow rule, along with the action types supported for that trigger (for example, create, edit, delete, field_update, date_or_datetime).
triggers.x-zs-llm-description: Use each trigger api_name as the execute_when type when creating or updating workflow rules.

actions.description: List of available action types for the module. Each action defines an operation that can be performed when the workflow rule fires, along with its per-type limit (applies independently to instant_actions and scheduled_actions), scheduling support, and whether it is an associate action (reusable entity referenced by ID) or non-associate action (defined inline).
actions.x-zs-llm-description: Use this list to validate action types and limits before selecting instant or scheduled actions for a workflow rule.

workflow_configurations__WorkflowConfigu.title: Workflow Configurations Metadata

workflow_configurations__WorkflowConfigu.description: A trigger type available for the module. Defines the event that initiates a workflow rule. Use the api_name value in the execute_when.type field when creating or updating a workflow rule via POST/PUT /settings/automation/workflow_rules.
workflow_configurations__WorkflowConfigu.x-zs-llm-description: Use this object to choose a workflow trigger and to know which action api_names are compatible with that trigger.

api_name.description: Represents the API identifier of the trigger type. Use this value in the execute_when.type field when creating a workflow rule (for example, create, edit, create_or_edit, delete, field_update, section_update, date_or_datetime, score_increase, score_decrease, score_update).
api_name.x-zs-llm-description: Use this value as the trigger type identifier in workflow rule payloads.

deprecated.description:
Indicates whether this trigger type is deprecated.
Possible values:
true - The trigger type is deprecated and should not be used for new workflow rules, though it may still appear on existing rules.
false - The trigger type is active and available for use.

name.description: Represents the display name of the trigger type as shown in the CRM UI (for example, Create, Edit, FieldUpdate, DateBased).

scheduled_actions_supported.description:
Indicates whether this trigger type supports scheduled (time-delayed) actions.
Possible values:
true - Both instant_actions and scheduled_actions are available for workflow rules with this trigger.
false - Only instant_actions can be used in workflow rules with this trigger.

actions.description: Represents the list of action type API names supported by this trigger. Only these action types can be used in workflow rules with this trigger type. Cross-reference with the top-level actions array in the response for full action metadata, including per-type limits and scheduling support.
actions.x-zs-llm-description: Use these values to restrict workflow actions to the action types supported by the selected trigger.

items.description: Represents an action type API name supported by this trigger (for example, field_updates, email_notifications, webhooks, assign_owner, add_tags, remove_tags, create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call, convert, functions, flow).

component_id.description: Represents the component identifier for marketplace or custom triggers. Returns null for standard built-in trigger types.

generated_type.description: Represents the generated type identifier for marketplace or custom triggers. Returns null for standard built-in trigger types.

workflow_configurations__WorkflowConfigu.title: Workflow Configurations Trigger

workflow_configurations__WorkflowConfigu.description: Represents an action type available for the module. Defines an operation that can be performed when a workflow rule triggers. The limit field is the per-type cap that applies independently to instant_actions and scheduled_actions - for instance, if limit=5, you can add up to 5 instances in instant_actions and up to 5 in scheduled_actions of the same rule.
workflow_configurations__WorkflowConfigu.x-zs-llm-description: Use this object to choose an action type and understand whether it is reusable, schedulable, and how many instances are allowed.

is_clickable.description: Indicates whether this action type can be edited directly from the workflow configuration UI page. Not relevant for API usage.

associate_action.description:
Indicates whether this action type is an associate action. Associate actions link or associate records between modules (for example, linking a Contact to a Deal or associating a Product with an Order). Associate actions differ from standard data-write actions such as field_updates or email_notifications.
Possible values: **true** - This action type is an associate action. **false** - This action type is a standard non-associate action.
associate_action.x-zs-llm-description: When true, reference an existing reusable automation entity by ID instead of defining the action inline.

limit_per_action.description: Represents the maximum number of items within a single action instance. For example, add_tags and remove_tags allow a maximum of 10 tags per action. Returns null if no per-action item limit applies.
limit_per_action.x-zs-llm-description: Use this as the maximum number of items inside one action instance when the value is not null.

api_name.description: Represents the API identifier of the action type used when creating or modifying workflow rules (for example, field_updates, email_notifications, webhooks, assign_owner, add_tags, remove_tags, create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call, convert, functions, flow).

supported_in_scheduled_action.description: Indicates whether this action type can be used as a scheduled (time-delayed) action in a workflow rule. **Possible values:** true - This action type is supported in scheduled_actions (for example, time-delayed email_notifications or field_updates). false - This action type is only supported in instant_actions.
supported_in_scheduled_action.x-zs-llm-description: When false, do not place this action type inside scheduled_actions.

name.description: Represents the display name of the action type as shown in the CRM UI.

limit.description: Maximum number of instances of this action type allowed per workflow rule. Applies independently to instant_actions and scheduled_actions - for instance, if limit=5, you can add up to 5 instances in instant_actions and up to 5 in scheduled_actions. Returns LIMIT_EXCEEDED if exceeded.
limit.x-zs-llm-description: Use this as the maximum number of action instances of this type allowed in instant_actions and separately in scheduled_actions.

workflow_rules__WorkflowRulePostNestedSc.x-zs-llm-description: The rule object for creating a workflow rule. Required fields: name (max 100 chars), module ({api_name, id}), execute_when (trigger config), conditions (array with actions). Optional: description (max 1000), lock ({status, message}). Must call getWorkflowConfigurations before constructing to validate trigger and action availability for the module.

name.description: Specify the workflow rule name. Required. Cannot exceed 100 characters. Special characters are not allowed.

description.description: Specify an optional description for the workflow rule. Set to null to clear an existing description.

module.description: The module to which the workflow rule applies. Use the [Get Modules API](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) to retrieve module IDs. Required. Must be a workflow-supported module. If both id and api_name are provided, they must match. Use `getWorkflowConfigurations` to discover supported modules. Cannot be changed after creation.

execute_when.description: Specifies when the workflow rule is triggered. This is a required JSON object with "type" and "details" properties. For example: {"type": "create_or_edit", "details": {"trigger_module": {"api_name": "Leads", "id": "..."}, "repeat": false}}. Passing a string instead of a JSON object, such as "create_or_edit", returns an "INVALID_DATA" error. The "details.trigger_module" must match the module associated with the workflow rule. Use "getWorkflowConfigurations" to retrieve the available triggers and their supported actions.

conditions.description: Specify the conditions that define the branching logic of the workflow rule. Each condition evaluates records against criteria and executes its own set of actions. At least one condition is required.

lock.description: Specify the lock configuration to prevent other users from editing the rule. Only administrators can lock or unlock rules.

message.description: Specify the reason or context for locking the rule. Valid only when **lock.status** is set to true.

status.description:
Specify whether to lock the rule.
Possible values:
true - Locks the rule to prevent editing.
false - Unlocks the rule.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the workflow rule to update. Required.

active.description:
Specify whether the workflow rule is active or inactive.
Possible values:
true - The rule is active and executes when triggered.
false - The rule is inactive and does not execute.

delete_schedule_action.description:
Specify whether to delete all scheduled actions associated with the workflow rule when deactivating it.
Possible values:
true - Delete all scheduled actions when the rule is deactivated.
false - Preserve scheduled actions when the rule is deactivated.

status.description: Specify the activation state of the workflow rule. When setting **active** to false, you can optionally delete all associated scheduled actions.

message.description: Specify a note or label indicating the reason or context for locking the rule.

status.description:
Specify whether to lock or unlock the workflow rule.
Possible values:
true - Locks the rule to prevent editing.
false - Unlocks the rule.
