source.description: Represents the origin of the workflow rule. For example, **crm** for rules created through the CRM UI, or **API** for rules created through the API.

last_executed_time.description: Represents the ISO 8601 timestamp of the last time this workflow rule was triggered. Null if the rule has never been triggered.

name.description: Represents the name of the workflow rule.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the workflow rule.

category.description: Represents the classification category of the workflow rule.

conditions.description: Represents the array of condition objects that define the criteria for executing the actions of the workflow rule.

workflow_rules__WorkflowRuleSingleGetSch.title: Workflow Rule

workflow_rules__ModuleOrFieldNestedSchem.description: Represents a CRM module or field reference using its API name and unique numeric ID.
workflow_rules__ModuleOrFieldNestedSchem.x-zs-llm-description: Reusable reference object for modules and fields. Both api_name and id must be provided  -  API returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND if id is missing. Used across: rule module, action module, criteria field, field_mappings field, lookup_field.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the module or field, such as **Leads**, **Contacts**, or a custom field API name.

id.description: Represents the unique numeric ID of the module or field.

workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenNestedSchema.description: Represents the trigger configuration that defines when the workflow rule fires, including the trigger type and its associated details.
workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Trigger configuration discriminator (oneOf). The type field selects the trigger template  -  route to the matching schema: T1 (simple lifecycle/event types), T2 (field_update), T3 (section_update), T4 (date_or_datetime), T5 (time offset), T6 (score_update), T7 (mail_sent_replied_within). Not all triggers work on all modules  -  validate with getWorkflowConfigurations first.

workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT1Simple.description: Represents a simple trigger type (T1) that fires on record creation, editing, deletion, or when specific CRM events occur, with optional repeat and cross-module support.
workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT1Simple.x-zs-llm-description: Simple trigger template for record lifecycle and event types: create, edit, create_or_edit, delete, cancel, and module-specific variants (email_received, missed_call, mail_sent_*, fb_*, tw_*). Only requires details.repeat (bool). Email/call/social triggers require their dedicated module with relational_criteria linking to target module. Validate availability via getWorkflowConfigurations.

type.description: Represents the trigger API name that activates the workflow rule. Supported values vary by module; use the getWorkflowConfigurations endpoint to retrieve supported triggers for the target module.

details.description: Represents the optional trigger configuration details, including **repeat** (Boolean) and **trigger_module** (object) for cross-module triggers.

repeat.description: Indicates whether the rule fires every time the trigger condition is met. When false, the rule fires only on the first occurrence.

trigger_module.description: The module that actually triggers the rule. Defaults to the rule's top-level module if omitted. Must be explicitly set when the trigger targets a different module, such as a rule on Leads triggered by a note creation event, which requires the trigger module to reference the Notes module. To discover module API names and identifiers, retrieve the available modules from the system.

workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT2FieldUpdate.description: Represents a field update trigger type that fires when a specified field value on a record changes according to defined criteria.
workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT2FieldUpdate.x-zs-llm-description:
Field update trigger. Fires when a specific field value
changes. The monitored field is defined inside
details.criteria.field  -  not at top level. Set details.criteria.value
to '${ANYVALUE}' to fire on any change regardless of new value.
Call-prefixed variants require the Calls module. details.repeat controls
re-execution on subsequent edits. details.match_all controls
multi-criteria evaluation.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for field update rules. Availability varies by the target module.

details.description: Represents the field update trigger details, including the criteria that define which field value change activates the rule.

criteria.description: Represents the field value change criteria that activate the trigger. Defines which field is monitored and what change condition fires the rule.

match_all.description:
Controls the logic applied across criteria groups.
Possible values:
true - All criteria groups must match (AND logic).
false - Any one criteria group is sufficient (OR logic).

repeat.description: Indicates whether the rule fires every time the field update condition is met. When false, the rule fires only on the first occurrence.

trigger_module.description: The module that actually triggers the rule. Defaults to the rule's top-level module if omitted. Must be explicitly set when the trigger targets a different module  - e.g., a rule on Leads triggered by 'note created' requires trigger_module = {api_name: 'Notes', id: '...'}. Use `getModules` to discover module api_name and id values.

workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT3SectionUpda.description: Represents the trigger type for section update rules. Availability varies by the target module
workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT3SectionUpda.x-zs-llm-description: Section update trigger. Fires when any field within specific layout sections is modified. Required: details.sections (array of section objects). Call-prefixed variants require the Calls module. Validate available sections via getLayouts for the module.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for section update rules. Use getWorkflowConfigurations to verify the trigger is available for the target module.

details.description: Represents the section update trigger details, including the layout section IDs to monitor.

section_ids.description: Represents the array of layout section IDs to monitor for updates. Each ID must correspond to a valid section ID for the target module.

items.description: Represents the unique ID of a layout section to monitor.

repeat.description:
Indicates whether the rule fires every time a section update
condition is met. When false, the rule fires only on the first
occurrence.

trigger_module.description: Optional. The module that actually triggers the rule. Defaults to the rule's top-level module if omitted. Must be explicitly set when the trigger targets a different module  - e.g., a rule on Leads triggered by 'note created' requires trigger_module = {api_name: 'Notes', id: '...'}. Use `getModules` to discover module api_name and id values.

workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT4DateBased.description: Represents the date or datetime field to monitor for triggering the rule. Must reference an existing date or datetime field on the module.
workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT4DateBased.x-zs-llm-description: Date-based trigger. Fires relative to a date/datetime field value (before or after). Required: details.field ({api_name, id}  -  must be date/datetime type), details.period ('days'|'hours'), details.sign ('negative' for before, 'positive' for after), details.unit (integer  -  number of days/hours). Broadly available across modules.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for date or datetime-based rules, which fire relative to a date field value on the record.

details.description: Represents the date-based trigger details, including the target date field, time offset, and recurrence configuration.

field.description: Represents the date or datetime field to monitor for triggering the rule. Use the getFields endpoint to discover available date and datetime fields.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the date or datetime field, such as **Created_Time**, **Modified_Time**, or a custom field API name.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the date or datetime field.

period.description: Represents the time unit for the offset relative to the monitored date field. For example, **days**, **weeks**, or **months**.

unit.description: Represents the offset magnitude relative to the monitored date field value. Negative values indicate before the date; positive values indicate after.

execute_at.description: Represents the exact time of day at which to fire the trigger, in 24-hour HH:mm format. Applicable only to datetime fields.

recur_cycle.description:
Represents the recurrence frequency for the date-based trigger.
Possible values:
once - Fires once.
monthly - Fires monthly on the same date.
yearly - Fires yearly on the same date.

repeat.description: Indicates whether the trigger fires repeatedly. When true, the trigger fires on each recurrence as configured.

trigger_module.description:
Specifies the module that triggers the workflow rule. If omitted,
it defaults to the rule's top-level module. Specify this when the trigger
targets a different module. For example, a workflow rule on Leads triggered
when a note is created requires 'trigger_module': {"api_name": "Notes",
'id': '...'}. Use 'getModules' to retrieve the module API name and ID.

workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT5TimeOffset.description: Represents the trigger type for time-offset rules. Availability varies by the target module.
workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT5TimeOffset.x-zs-llm-description: Time offset trigger. Fires after a specified delay from an event. Required: details.period ('days'|'hours'), details.unit (integer). Module-specific triggers: email time-offset types (email_received_notreplied, mail_sent_notopened) require a dedicated email module with relational_criteria. 'overdue' requires an activity module. Does not support repeat.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for time-offset rules. Use getWorkflowConfigurations to verify the trigger is available for the target module.

details.description: Represents the time offset trigger details, including the time unit and magnitude for the offset.

period.description:
Represents the time unit for the offset.
Possible values:
days - Offset in days.
hours - Offset in hours.

unit.description: Represents the time offset magnitude. Always a positive integer for time-offset triggers, such as 1 for one day or 3 for three hours.

trigger_module.description:
The module that actually triggers the rule. Defaults to
the rule's top-level module if omitted. Must be explicitly set
when the trigger targets a different module  - e.g., a rule on
Leads triggered by 'note created' requires trigger_module =
{api_name: 'Notes', id: '...'}. Use `getModules` to discover
module api_name and id values.

field.description: Represents the field reference returned in GET responses for time-offset triggers, including the trigger field details.

id.description: Represents the field identifier for the time-offset trigger. Returns **-1** when the field is system-determined.

workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT6ScoreUpdate.description: Represents a score update trigger type (T6) that fires when a record score changes due to configured scoring rules.
workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT6ScoreUpdate.x-zs-llm-description: Score update trigger. Fires when a record's score changes based on scoring rules. Required: details.type ('All_Rules' for any scoring rule, 'Selective_Rules' for specific ones). For Selective_Rules also requires details.scoring_rules array with rule IDs. Trigger types: score_increase, score_decrease, score_update, zia_scoring_rule.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for scoring rules. Supports score increase and score decrease trigger events.

details.description: Represents the score update trigger details, including the Scoring Rule scope and the applicable scoring rules.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for scoring rules. Supports score increase and score decrease trigger events.

rules.description: Represents the array of Scoring Rule references to monitor. Required when **type** is set to **Selective_Rules**.

items.description: Represents a single Scoring Rule reference. Must include the Scoring Rule ID for POST and PUT requests. The name field is read-only and returned in GET responses.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the Scoring Rule.

name.description: Represents the display name of the Scoring Rule. This field is read-only and returned in GET responses.

repeat.description: Indicates whether the rule fires every time the score condition is met. When false, the rule fires only on the first occurrence.

trigger_module.description: The module that actually triggers the rule. Defaults to the rule's top-level module if omitted. Must be explicitly set when the trigger targets a different module, such as a rule on Leads triggered by a note creation event, which requires the trigger module to reference the Notes module. To discover module API names and identifiers, retrieve the available modules from the system.

workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT7EmailReplie.description: Represents an email-reply-window trigger type (T7) that fires when a sent email receives a reply within a configured time window.
workflow_rules__ExecuteWhenT7EmailReplie.x-zs-llm-description:
Email replied-within trigger. Fires when a sent email
receives a reply within a time window.Required-details.period ('days'|'hours'), details.unit (integer). Only type: mail_sent_replied_within. Typically requires a dedicated email module with relational_criteria. Does not support repeat.

type.description: Represents the trigger type for email-reply-window rules. Requires a dedicated email module workflow rule.

details.description: Represents the email-reply-window trigger details, including the time unit and magnitude for the reply window.

period.description:
Represents the time unit for the reply window.
Possible values:
days - Window measured in days.
hours - Window measured in hours.

unit.description: Represents the reply window magnitude, such as 3 for a window of three days or three hours.

trigger_module.description: The module that actually triggers the rule. Defaults to the rule's top-level module if omitted. Must be explicitly set when the trigger targets a different module  - e.g., a rule on Leads triggered by 'note created' requires trigger_module = {api_name: 'Notes', id: '...'}. Use `getModules` to discover module api_name and id values.

workflow_rules__ConditionsNestedSchema.description: Represents a single condition within a workflow rule that defines which records are evaluated and what actions are executed when the criteria are met.
workflow_rules__ConditionsNestedSchema.x-zs-llm-description: A condition defines WHICH records to act on and WHAT actions to execute. Each rule has 1+ conditions evaluated in sequence_number order. Required: sequence_number (integer, starting from 1). At least one of instant_actions or scheduled_actions must be present. Optional: criteria_details (filter gate). Convert action requires criteria_details.criteria to be non-null.

sequence_number.description: Represents the execution order of this condition within the workflow rule, starting from one. Must be unique across all conditions in the rule.

instant_actions.description: Actions to execute immediately when the condition is met. At least one of instant_actions or scheduled_actions must be present  - returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND if both are absent.

scheduled_actions.description: Actions to execute after a configured delay. Scheduled actions require both the trigger and the action type to support scheduling.

criteria_details.description: Record matching criteria for this condition. When provided, criteria_details must be a JSON object and cannot be null. To match all records, pass an object with criteria set to null, but do not set criteria_details itself to null. This field is required for certain trigger types, such as related module triggers like Notes on Leads. The convert action type requires criteria_details.criteria to be a non-null filter object. Omit criteria_details entirely or pass criteria as null to match all records when the trigger does not require specific criteria and no convert action is present.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the condition. Auto-generated on creation. Required on PUT to identify which condition to update.

_delete.description: Indicates that this condition should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__CriteriaDetailsNestedSch.description: Represents the filter criteria that determine which records satisfy the workflow rule condition.
workflow_rules__CriteriaDetailsNestedSch.x-zs-llm-description: Filter configuration determining which records pass through to action execution. Contains two independent blocks: criteria (filters on trigger module's own fields) and relational_criteria (filters on a related module). Both are optional  -  null or omitted criteria matches ALL records. Required for certain triggers (related-module triggers) and for convert action.

oneOf.description: Represents a null variant indicating no criteria or module filter is applied.

criteria.description: Represents the filter criteria applied to the trigger module records. When null, the rule applies to all records without additional field-level filtering.

relational_criteria.description: Represents the filter criteria applied to a related module when the trigger involves cross-module data, such as emails, calls, or notes.

oneOf.description: Represents a null variant indicating no criteria or module filter is applied.

criteria.description: Represents the filter criteria applied to the related module records. Follows the same structure as the top-level criteria field.

module_selection.description: Represents the scope selector for the related module filter. Required when **relational_criteria** is present.

oneOf.description: Represents a null variant indicating no criteria or module filter is applied.

module.description: Represents the related module to filter on. Required when **module_selection** is set to **specific**.

workflow_rules__InstantActionsNestedSche.description: Represents the container for instant actions that execute immediately when the workflow rule condition is met.
workflow_rules__InstantActionsNestedSche.x-zs-llm-description: Container for actions that execute immediately when the condition is met. Contains actions array (non-empty required). Each action is either associate (pre-configured entity referenced by type+id) or non-associate (inline type+details). Check getWorkflowConfigurations actions[].associate_action to determine which pattern to use for each action type.

actions.description: Represents the array of action objects configured for this condition. Required and must be non-empty. Each action object specifies the action type and its configuration or reference ID.

workflow_rules__ScheduledActionsNestedSc.description: Represents the container for scheduled actions that execute after a configured delay from the time the workflow rule condition is triggered.
workflow_rules__ScheduledActionsNestedSc.x-zs-llm-description: Container for delayed action groups. Each group has execute_after ({period, unit}) defining the delay and an actions array. Not supported when: trigger has repeat=true, convert action present in instant_actions, or trigger doesn't support scheduling (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). Max groups governed by getWorkflowRulesCount scheduled_actions_per_rule_limit.

items.description: Specify when the scheduled actions should be executed

execute_after.description: Defines the delay before the scheduled actions execute. Required. Cannot be an empty object.

period.description: Represents the type of time interval. Required. Must be one of the allowed period values (invalid_schedule_actions_period if invalid). business_hours and business_days are only available when org business hours are configured. The API returns available periods from getWorkflowConfigurations.

unit.description: Represents the numeric delay value. Required. Allowed ranges per period (unit_not_allowed_for_period if out of range): minutes: 5-180 (2-180 if 1-min repetition feature is enabled), hours: 0-99, days: 0-2000, weeks: 0-100, months: 0-24, years: 0-10, business_hours: 0-99, business_days: 0-2000. All values must be non-negative (no pre-event offsets for scheduled actions).

actions.description: Represents the array of action objects for this scheduled group. Uses the same associate and non-associate action structure as instant actions, but only action types that support scheduled execution are allowed. Per-type limits apply independently to instant and scheduled actions.

id.description: Represents unique Id of the scheduled action

workflow_rules__AssociateActionsNestedSc.description: Represents an associate action that references a pre-configured action entity by its unique ID. Use the appropriate entity API to retrieve valid IDs.
workflow_rules__AssociateActionsNestedSc.x-zs-llm-description: Union (oneOf) for pre-configured action references. Routes to: EmailNotificationAssociateActionSchema, FieldUpdateAssociateActionSchema, TaskAssociateActionSchema, or SimpleAssociateActionSchema based on type value. Associate actions reference an entity created via its own API  -  they carry type + id (and optionally related_details).

workflow_rules__EmailNotificationAssocia.description: Represents an associate action that sends a pre-configured email notification when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
workflow_rules__EmailNotificationAssocia.x-zs-llm-description: References a pre-configured email notification entity by ID. Create the entity first via postEmailNotifications, then use its ID here. Supports related_details.best_time for optimal send timing. Entity must be created for the correct module (main module, or relational_criteria.module if module_selection='specific' with Emails/Facebook/Twitter).

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the email notification. Required when associating an existing email notification with the rule.
id.title: Email Notification Action Id

name.description: Represents the display name of the EmailNotificationAssociate action. Returned in GET responses and derived from the associated action configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a EmailNotificationAssociate action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Represents the read-only details of the associated email notification. Returned in GET responses and not required in POST or PUT requests.

module.description: The module this action applies to.

related_details.description: Controls whether the email is sent at the best time for the recipient (powered by Data Intelligence). Null when best_time is not enabled.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__FieldUpdateAssociateActi.description: Represents an associate action that updates field values using a pre-configured field update action when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
workflow_rules__FieldUpdateAssociateActi.x-zs-llm-description: References a pre-configured field update entity by ID. Create the entity first via createFieldUpdates, then use its ID here. Supports related_details.lookup_field for targeting a related module's field  -  set null for same-module updates. Entity must be created for the correct module context.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the field update action. Use the Get Field Updates API to retrieve available IDs.
id.title: Field Update Action Id

name.description: Represents the display name of the FieldUpdateAssociate action. Returned in GET responses and derived from the referenced action configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a FieldUpdateAssociate action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Represents the read-only details of the associated field update action. Returned in GET responses and not required in POST or PUT requests.

module.description: The module this action applies to.

related_details.description: Specifies the lookup field when the field update targets a related module. Null when the update targets the workflow rule's own module.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__TaskAssociateActionSchem.description: Represents an associate action that creates a task based on a pre-configured task template when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
workflow_rules__TaskAssociateActionSchem.x-zs-llm-description: References a pre-configured task action entity by ID. Create the entity first via createWorkflowTasks, then use its ID here. Supports related_details.followup_details for auto-creating follow-up tasks on status change. Entity must be created for the correct module context.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the task action. Required to associate a pre-configured task with the workflow rule.

name.description: Represents the display name of the TaskAssociate action. Returned in GET responses and derived from the referenced action configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a TaskAssociate action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Represents the read-only details of the associated task action. Returned in GET responses and not required in POST or PUT requests.

module.description: The module this action applies to.

related_details.description: Configures a followup task that is automatically created after the original task, based on a status condition and time delay. Null when no followup is configured.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__SimpleAssociateActionSch.description: Represents an associate action that references a pre-configured action entity by its unique ID, applicable to action types such as webhooks, functions, and notifications.
workflow_rules__SimpleAssociateActionSch.x-zs-llm-description: References a pre-configured action entity (webhooks, functions, sms, whatsapp) by type and ID. No related_details supported. Create entities via: webhooks->createWebhooks, functions->Create_Functions, sms/whatsapp->postMessageNotifications. Entity must target the correct module based on module_selection context.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the pre-configured action entity. Required to associate an existing action with the workflow rule.

name.description: Represents the display name of the SimpleAssociate action. Returned in GET responses and derived from the referenced action configuration.

type.description:
Represents the type of associate action.
Possible values:
webhooks - HTTP callback to an external URL.
functions - Custom function execution.
email_notifications - Automated email notification.
tasks - Task creation action.

details.description: Represents the read-only details of the associated action entity. Returned in GET responses and not required in POST or PUT requests.

module.description: The module this action applies to.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__NonAssociateActionsNeste.description: Represents an inline action configuration that is defined directly within the workflow rule condition, rather than referencing a pre-created action entity by ID.
workflow_rules__NonAssociateActionsNeste.x-zs-llm-description: Union (oneOf) for inline action configurations. Routes by type to: AssignOwnerActionSchema, CreateRecordActionSchema, AddMeetingActionSchema, ScheduleCallActionSchema, AddTagsActionSchema, RemoveTagsActionSchema, ConvertActionSchema, ChatNotificationActionSchema, CircuitsActionSchema, ZohoFlowActionSchema, SocialActionSchema, EmailCreateRecordActionSchema, CreateConnectedRecordActionSchema. Each carries type + details with full inline config.

workflow_rules__RelatedDetailsNestedSche.description: Represents the optional action-specific configuration attached to an associate action, such as best-time delivery settings for email notifications or lookup field references for field updates.
workflow_rules__RelatedDetailsNestedSche.x-zs-llm-description: Discriminator (oneOf) for action-specific supplementary configuration. Only three action types support related_details: email_notifications (best_time delivery), tasks (followup_details), and field_updates (lookup_field for cross-module targeting). Other action types do not use related_details.

oneOf.description: Represents the email notification related details, including best-time delivery configuration.

best_time.description: Indicates whether to send the email notification at the best time for the recipient. When set to true, the platform determines the optimal send time.

oneOf.description: Represents the task related details, including followup task configuration.

followup_details.description: Represents the followup task configuration, including the trigger condition and delay settings.

condition.description: Represents the task status condition that triggers the followup task, such as **Completed** or **Not Started**.

unit.description: Represents the numeric time value for the delay before creating the followup task.

period.description: Represents the time period label for the delay before creating the followup task, such as **days**, **hours**, or **minutes**.

oneOf.description: Represents the field update related details, including the lookup field for cross-module updates.

lookup_field.description: The lookup field linking the rule module to the target module (e.g., Account_Name on Contacts). Provide the field's id and api_name. When the field update targets the same module, related_details is null.

oneOf.description: Represents a null value indicating no related details are configured for this action.

workflow_rules__EmailNotificationRelated.description: Represents the optional related configuration details for email notification actions, including best-time delivery settings.
workflow_rules__EmailNotificationRelated.x-zs-llm-description: Supplementary config for email_notifications associate action. Controls best-time delivery scheduling  -  when best_time=true, the email is sent at the recipient's optimal engagement time rather than immediately.

oneOf.description: Represents the best-time delivery configuration for the email notification action, controlling when the email sends to reach the recipient at the optimal delivery time.

best_time.description: Indicates whether to send the email notification at the best time for the recipient. When set to true, the platform determines the optimal send time.

oneOf.description: Represents a null value indicating best-time delivery is not configured for this email notification action.

workflow_rules__TaskRelatedDetailsSchema.description: Represents the optional related configuration details for task actions, specifying whether and how a followup task should be created.
workflow_rules__TaskRelatedDetailsSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Supplementary config for tasks associate action. Configures automatic followup task creation based on condition/unit/period  -  creates a new followup task after the original task's status changes.

oneOf.description: Represents the followup task configuration that defines the status condition and delay for automatically creating a followup task.

followup_details.description: Represents the followup task configuration, including the trigger condition and delay settings.

condition.description: Represents the task status condition that triggers the followup task, such as **Completed** or **Not Started**.

unit.description: Represents the numeric time value for the delay before creating the followup task.

period.description: Represents the time period label for the delay before creating the followup task, such as **days**, **hours**, or **minutes**.

oneOf.description: Represents a null value indicating no followup task is configured for this task action.

workflow_rules__FieldUpdateRelatedDetail.description: Represents the optional related configuration details for field update actions, specifying the lookup field used for cross-module field updates.
workflow_rules__FieldUpdateRelatedDetail.x-zs-llm-description: Supplementary config for field_updates associate action. Specifies lookup_field ({api_name, id}) to target a related module's field via a lookup relationship. Set to null for same-module field updates.

oneOf.description: Represents the lookup field configuration that identifies the related module record for cross-module field update actions.

lookup_field.description: The lookup field linking the rule module to the target module (e.g., Account_Name on Contacts). Provide the field's id and api_name.

oneOf.description: Represents a null value indicating the field update targets the workflow rule own module with no lookup field required.

workflow_rules__CreatedModifiedByObjectS.description: Represents the identity details of the CRM user who created or last modified the workflow rule.
workflow_rules__CreatedModifiedByObjectS.x-zs-llm-description: User reference object containing name and id. Used in GET responses for created_by and modified_by fields showing who created or last modified the workflow rule.

name.description: Represents the name of the CRM user who created or last modified the workflow rule.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the CRM user.

workflow_rules__TimeObjectSchema.description: Represents a time offset specification combining a period label and a numeric magnitude, used in time-based workflow trigger configurations.
workflow_rules__TimeObjectSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Timestamp object used in GET responses for created_time, modified_time, and last_executed_time fields.

workflow_rules__LockStatusSchema.description: Represents the lock configuration of a workflow rule, including the lock state and the identity of the user who applied the lock.
workflow_rules__LockStatusSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Lock state of a workflow rule. Contains status (boolean  -  is currently locked), locked_by (user object), and message (lock reason string). Locked rules cannot be deleted or updated  -  returns RECORD_LOCKED error.

locked_by.description: Represents the details of the CRM user who locked the workflow rule.

workflow_rules__AssignOwnerActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that assigns or reassigns the record owner when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
workflow_rules__AssignOwnerActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='assign_owner'. Requires module and assign_to array (1-5 entries). assign_to discriminates on type: user/role/group/profile/assignment_rule need resource.id; merge_field needs details.api_name (user-type field); criteria needs criteria array. Optional: notify (trigger notification), related_records (transfer child record ownership), apply_assignment_threshold.

name.description: Represents the display name of the AssignOwner action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a AssignOwner action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Configuration for the assign_owner action. Requires a module reference and an assign_to array with one to five entries, each specifying who to assign the record to — a user, role, group, assignment rule, or profile, a merge field, or matching criteria. Optionally sends a notification, includes related records, applies an assignment threshold, or bases assignment on user availability.

related_details.description: Optional. For assign_owner, related_details is not typically used. Applicable sub-fields: best_time (for email_notifications only), followup_details (for tasks only), lookup_field (for field_updates only).

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the AssignOwner action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__CreateRecordActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that creates a new record in a specified CRM module when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
workflow_rules__CreateRecordActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='create_record'. Creates a record in a specified module (NOT Tasks/Events/Calls  -  use tasks/add_meeting/schedule_call). Requires module, layout, and field_mappings (1-25 entries, must include all mandatory fields). Each mapping: {field, type, value} with type discriminating: static (literal), merge_field (${!Module.Field} token), execution_time (date offset), composite (multi-value).

name.description: Represents the display name of the CreateRecord action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a CreateRecord action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Configuration for the create_record action. Requires a module, a layout, and one to twenty-five field mappings that supply values for the new record fields, using a static value, a merge field, an execution-time offset, or a composite value. All fields marked mandatory by the layout must be included. Optionally restricts creation to prevent duplicate records.

related_details.description: Optional. For create_record, related_details is not typically used. Applicable sub-fields: best_time (for email_notifications only), followup_details (for tasks only), lookup_field (for field_updates only).

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the CreateRecord action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__AddMeetingActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that schedules a meeting when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
workflow_rules__AddMeetingActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='add_meeting'. Creates an Event record. Requires module (Events), layout, field_mappings (must include Event_Title, Start_DateTime), meeting_duration ({value, period}  -  not when All_Day=true), and host_unavailable (either assign_record_owner_as_host:true or assign_task:{id}). Optional: apply_restriction.

name.description: Represents the display name of the add-meeting action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this action as an add-meeting action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must correspond to a type supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Configuration for the add_meeting action. Requires the Events module, a layout, and field mappings that include the event title and start date and time. Also requires the meeting duration, unless the event is set to all day, and specifies whether the record owner or another assigned user hosts the meeting. Optionally restricts creation to prevent duplicate records.

related_details.description: Optional. For add_meeting, related_details is not typically used. Applicable sub-fields: best_time (for email_notifications only), followup_details (for tasks only), lookup_field (for field_updates only).

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the add-meeting action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this add-meeting action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. When this field is provided with a null value, the platform interprets it as a deletion signal and removes the action from the rules action list.

workflow_rules__ScheduleCallActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='schedule_call'. Creates a Calls record. Requires module (Calls), layout, and field_mappings (must include Subject). Key fields: Subject, Call_Purpose, Call_Type, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Optional: apply_restriction.

name.description: Represents the display name of the ScheduleCall action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a ScheduleCall action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

related_details.description: Optional. For schedule_call, related_details is not typically used. Applicable sub-fields: best_time (for email_notifications only), followup_details (for tasks only), lookup_field (for field_updates only).

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the ScheduleCall action within the workflow rule.

workflow_rules__ConvertActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that converts a record to another module type, such as converting a lead to a contact, account, and deal.
workflow_rules__ConvertActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='convert'. Converts records across modules: Leads->Contacts+Accounts+Deals, Quotes->SalesOrders/Invoices, SalesOrders->Invoices. Limit 1 per rule. Requires criteria_details.criteria to be non-null. For Leads: add_to_existing_contact, add_to_existing_account, change_owner are mandatory. For Quotes/SalesOrders: convert_to is mandatory. No scheduled actions allowed with convert.

name.description: Represents the display name of the Convert action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a Convert action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Configuration for converting records. This action is only available when the trigger module is Leads, Quotes, or Sales_Orders. The convert action requires non-null criteria in the condition; null criteria will result in a dependent field missing error. For Leads conversion, the following fields are mandatory: add_to_existing_contact, add_to_existing_account, apply_restriction, and change_owner which is an object containing the apply_assignment_threshold flag. Key optional fields include create_deal for creating a deal, carry_tags which is an array of module references and not a boolean, field_mappings with a maximum of 25 entries, move_attachment_to for specifying a target module, contact_role which is applicable only when create_deal is true, and convert_to which is used for Quotes and SalesOrders conversions. Example configuration for a Leads conversion without creating a deal.

related_details.description: Optional. For convert, related_details is not typically used. Applicable sub-fields: best_time (for email_notifications only), followup_details (for tasks only), lookup_field (for field_updates only).

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the Convert action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

Not for Notes, Rebuy, or Competitor Mentions. Requires ManageAutomation or ManageConnectedWorkflow permission. Needs module, layout, and field_mappings.

name.description: Represents the display name of the CreateConnectedRecord action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a CreateConnectedRecord action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Configuration for the create_connected_record action. Uses the same structure as create_record — module, layout, and field mappings — but the module must be a valid connected-record child module. Not supported for the Notes, Rebuy, or Competitor Mentions modules.

related_details.description: Optional. Not typically used for create_connected_record.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the CreateConnectedRecord action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__ChatNotificationActionSc.description: Represents a non-associate action that sends a chat notification to an integrated chat service, such as Slack or Zoho Cliq, when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
workflow_rules__ChatNotificationActionSc.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action for chat integrations: type=slack_notifications|cliq_notifications|cisco_notifications|google_chat_notifications|microsoft_teams_notifications. Limit 1 per type per rule. Requires name, details.message (supports ${Module.Field} merge tokens), and details.notify_to ({type: user|channel|fields} with appropriate sub-fields).

name.description: Represents the display name of the ChatNotification action. This field is required.

type.description: Represents chat service type. Each service has a limit of 1 action per rule.

details.description: Configuration for the chat notification action. Requires a message, which supports merge fields, and a target channel, user, or field to notify.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the ChatNotification action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__CircuitsActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that executes a Zoho Circuits workflow when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
workflow_rules__CircuitsActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='circuits'. Executes a Zoho Circuits workflow. Limit 1/rule. Requires name, details.circuit_id (Zoho Circuits circuit identifier). Verify 'circuits' is enabled for the module via getWorkflowConfigurations before using.

name.description: Represents the display name of the Circuits action. This field is required.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a Circuits action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Configuration for the Zoho Circuits action. Requires the ID of the circuit to execute.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the Circuits action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__ZohoFlowActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that triggers a Zoho Flow workflow when the workflow rule condition is met.
workflow_rules__ZohoFlowActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='flow'. Triggers a Zoho Flow custom action. Limit 1/rule. Requires name, details.custom_action_id and details.custom_action_name (obtained from getCustomActions filtered by service_type='zoho_flow', component_type='workflow'). Verify 'flow' is enabled via getWorkflowConfigurations.

name.description: Represents the display name of the Zoho Flow action. This field is required.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a Zoho Flow action within the workflow rule.

details.description: Configuration for the Zoho Flow action. Requires the ID and name of the custom action to trigger in Zoho Flow.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the Zoho Flow action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this Zoho Flow action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__SocialActionSchema.description: Represents a non-associate action that publishes a post to a social network such as Facebook or Twitter when the workflow rule condition is triggered.
workflow_rules__SocialActionSchema.x-zs-llm-description: Inline social action for Facebook (comment_to_post, reply_to_comment, like_to_comment, reply_to_message) or Twitter (retweet, reply_to_tweet). Available only with matching social triggers (fb_* or tw_*). Limit 1 per type per rule. details.content required for comment/reply types, not needed for like/retweet.

name.description: Represents the display name of the Social action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

type.description: Represents the social action type. Facebook actions require Facebook-specific triggers, and Twitter actions require Twitter-specific triggers.

details.description: Configuration for the social action, containing the message content with merge field support. Required for commenting or replying actions, and not needed for like or retweet actions.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the Social action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__EmailCreateRecordActionS.description: Represents a non-associate action that creates a record via an email-based trigger, applicable to modules such as Leads or Contacts.
workflow_rules__EmailCreateRecordActionS.x-zs-llm-description: Inline action type='create_record_email'. Creates a Leads or Contacts record via email. Limit 1/rule. Requires details.module (api_name: 'Leads' or 'Contacts') and details.field_mappings (exactly 1 entry specifying owner assignment: field with value.type user|role|group|country and value.resource.id).

name.description: Represents the display name of the EmailCreateRecord action as it appears within the workflow rule configuration.

type.description: Represents the action type discriminator that identifies this as a EmailCreateRecord action within the workflow rule. The value is fixed for this action type and must be supported by the target module and trigger event.

details.description: Configuration for the create-record-from-email action. Requires the target module, either Leads or Contacts, and exactly one field mapping that assigns the record owner.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the EmailCreateRecord action within the workflow rule.

_delete.description: Indicates that this action should be removed from the workflow rule when set in a PUT request. Provide a null value to signal deletion.

workflow_rules__WorkflowSimpleFilterCrit.description: Represents a simple filter criterion for workflow rule queries, specifying the field API name, comparator, and value to match.
workflow_rules__WorkflowSimpleFilterCrit.x-zs-llm-description: Single filter criterion in a workflow criteria array. Required: field ({api_name, id}), comparator (equal, not_equal, like, starts_with, etc.), value. Special: '${ANYVALUE}' comparator supported only in field_update triggers to match any value change. Type field distinguishes value source: 'value' (literal), 'merge_field' (runtime token), 'pre_defined' (system), 'field' (other field comparison).

allOf.description: Represents additional field reference constraints for the filter criterion, requiring the `api_name` property to identify the target field.

field.description: Represents the field to which the filter criterion is applied.

comparator.description: Represents the comparison operator applied to the filter criterion. **${ANYVALUE}** is a special value supported only in field update triggers; it matches any change to the monitored field value.

type.description: Indicates whether the criterion value is a direct value or a system variable placeholder.

workflow_rules__WorkflowGroupedFilterCri.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple simple filter conditions evaluated together using a logical operator such as AND or OR.
workflow_rules__WorkflowGroupedFilterCri.x-zs-llm-description: Grouped filter criterion containing multiple WorkflowSimpleFilterCriterion items joined by group_operator (AND/OR). Use for complex multi-field conditions. The group array holds the individual criteria and group_operator defines their logical relationship.

group.description: Represents the array of filter conditions to be evaluated together using the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description: Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.

workflow_rules__FilterFieldBase.description: Represents the base field reference used in filter operations, containing minimal required properties. The field's data_type is not part of this object; resolve it from the corresponding FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the field used for filter operations.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field used for filter application. Supports relationship notation, for example, Deals__r.Stage.

workflow_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionVal.description: Represents a string filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime, as well as any data_type not explicitly covered by SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber, SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectResponse, or the multiselect lookup value schemas.
Represents a numeric filter criterion value applicable to fields with a data_type of integer, currency, or double.
Represents a Boolean filter criterion value. Applicable only when the field has a Boolean data type (checkbox field).
Represents the base minified record structure of a lookup module, containing the record's unique identifier and display name.

id.description: Represents the unique ID of the lookup module record.

name.description: Represents the display name of the lookup module record.

allOf.description: Represents the constraint that the ID property is required for the lookup object filter criterion value in request bodies.

workflow_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionVal.description: Represents a lookup object filter criterion value for request bodies, applicable when the field's data_type is lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup. The ID property is required.

workflow_rules__AutomationModuleRef.description: PURPOSE: Module reference used across non-associate actions. At least one of api_name or id required (EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING if neither). If both given, must match (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). GET /settings/modules to discover. Always use full 19-digit module ID.
workflow_rules__AutomationModuleRef.x-zs-llm-description: Module reference for action targeting. At least one of api_name or id required  EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING if neither is present. If both provided and they refer to different modules  AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getModules. Used in most non-associate action details to specify where the action operates.

api_name.description: API name of the module (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Vendors).

id.description: Unique module ID (19-digit format). Always use the full ID as returned by GET /settings/modules - truncated or shortened IDs return INVALID_DATA ('the tabId given seems to be invalid'). Optional in requests if api_name is provided; always present in responses.

workflow_rules__AutomationModuleRef.title: Automation Module Reference

workflow_rules__AutomationAssignOwnerRes.description: PURPOSE: Resource reference for assign_to entry. MANDATORY: id (string). OPTIONAL: name, type. Obtain from GET /settings/users (user), /settings/roles (role), /settings/user_groups (group), /settings/automation/assignment_rules (assignment_rule), /settings/profiles (profile). If both id and name given, must match (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING).
workflow_rules__AutomationAssignOwnerRes.x-zs-llm-description: Resource reference within an assign_to entry. id is mandatory (DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING if absent). name is optional (server resolves from id). type indicates resource kind when present. Obtain IDs from: getUsers (user), getRoles (role), getUserGroups (group), getAssignmentRules (assignment_rule), getProfiles (profile).

id.description: Unique identifier of the target entity. Obtain from the corresponding API: GET /settings/users (for user), GET /settings/roles (for role), GET /settings/user_groups (for group), GET /settings/automation/assignment_rules (for assignment_rule), or GET /settings/profiles (for profile).

name.description: Display name of the target entity. Optional in POST/PUT requests (server resolves from id); always present in GET responses.

type.description: Type of the target entity. Present in GET responses; not required in POST/PUT requests.

workflow_rules__AutomationAssignOwnerRes.title: Assign Owner Resource

workflow_rules__AutomationAssignToResour.description: PURPOSE: assign_to entry for resource-based ownership. MANDATORY: type (user|role|group|assignment_rule|profile), resource ({id, name}). For type=profile: associated_to must be 'team_profile'. For round-robin: use multiple entries of type=user.
workflow_rules__AutomationAssignToResour.x-zs-llm-description: assign_to entry where ownership is assigned to a specific resource. type selects the resource kind: user, role, group, assignment_rule, or profile. resource object provides the target's id and optionally name. For profile type: associated_to must be 'team_profile'. Returns DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING if resource is omitted.

type.description: Assignment method. Determines what kind of entity receives ownership. Values: "user" - assign to a specific CRM user (GET /settings/users), for round-robin include multiple assign_to entries of type=user; "role" - assign to a user holding the specified role (GET /settings/roles), system picks an eligible user at execution time; "group" - assign to a member of the specified user group (GET /settings/user_groups); "assignment_rule" - assign using a pre-configured assignment rule (GET /settings/automation/assignment_rules), the rule's criteria and round-robin logic determine the final owner; "profile" - assign to a user matching the specified profile (GET /settings/profiles), must include associated_to=team_profile.

resource.description: Identifies the target user, role, group, assignment rule, or profile by ID and/or name. At least one of id or name must be provided; if both are given and they do not match, the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

allow_agent_user.description: Whether to allow assignment to an agent user or not. When true, the record can be assigned to an agent user also. When false, agent users are excluded from assignment. Applicable only for types: role, group, profile, merge_field, criteria. Not supported for types user and assignment_rule.

associated_to.description: Association context for profile-based assignment. Must be "team_profile" when type=profile. Not applicable for other assignment types; if provided for a non-profile type, the API returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH.

details.description: Always null for resource-based assignments. Present in GET responses for schema consistency with other assign_to types.

workflow_rules__AutomationAssignToResour.title: Assign To Resource Entry

workflow_rules__AutomationAssignToMergeF.description: PURPOSE: assign_to entry for merge-field-based ownership. Resolves to a user at execution time from a user-type field. MANDATORY: type (const 'merge_field'), details.api_name (merge field token e.g., '${!Leads.Created_By}'). Field must be data_type=ownerlookup or userlookup. GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} to discover.
workflow_rules__AutomationAssignToMergeF.x-zs-llm-description: assign_to entry where ownership resolves at runtime from a user-type lookup field on the trigger record. type must be 'merge_field'. details.api_name specifies the field (e.g., a custom user lookup). The field must be a user-type field  non-user fields return INVALID_DATA.

type.description: Assignment method indicating merge field resolution.

details.description: Contains the merge field reference that resolves to a user at execution time.

api_name.description: Merge field token referencing a user-type field. Must use the format ${!Module.User_Field} ,${!Module.Lookup_Field_API_Name.User_Field} where Field is a user-type field (data_type=ownerlookup or userlookup) from the trigger module. Fetch valid fields from GET /settings/fields?module={module_api_name}. Common user-type fields: Owner, Created_By, Modified_By. Examples: ${!Leads.Created_By}, ${!Deals.Owner}, ${!Contacts.Account_Manager}.

resource.description: Always null for merge field assignments. The owner is resolved dynamically from the merge field at execution time.

allow_agent_user.description: Whether to allow assignment to an agent user or not. When true, the record can be assigned to an agent user also. When false, agent users are excluded from assignment. Applicable only for types: role, group, profile, merge_field, criteria. Not supported for types user and assignment_rule.

workflow_rules__AutomationAssignToMergeF.title: Assign To Merge Field Entry

workflow_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionVal.description: Represents a predefined placeholder object filter criterion value for lookup fields, applicable with equal or not_equal comparators when the field's data_type is ownerlookup or userlookup. Two forms are supported: (1) the currently logged-in user, represented by passing only the name property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property; and (2) the logged-in user's role, represented by passing the ID property with the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and an optional display label in the name property. For specific real users or roles that are not predefined, use SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest, which requires the ID property.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user, in which only the name property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSER} and no ID property is included.

name.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the currently logged-in user.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSER} - Represents the currently logged-in user.

oneOf.description: Represents the predefined object form for the currently logged-in user's role, in which the ID property carries the predefined value ${CURRENTUSERROLE} and the name property is an optional display label.

id.description:
Represents the predefined placeholder for the logged-in user's role record ID.
Possible values:
${CURRENTUSERROLE} - Represents the role of the currently logged-in user.

name.description: Represents an optional display label for the predefined role, such as Logged in User Role.

workflow_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionVal.description:
Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable to any field data_type with the equal comparator.
Possible values:
${EMPTY} - Matches records where the field has no value.
${NOTEMPTY} - Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the field has no value (null or empty string).
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the field has any non-empty value.

workflow_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionVal.description: Represents a predefined placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator.

x-enumDescriptions.${TODAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the current calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROW}: Matches records where the date field falls on the next calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${TOMORROWPLUS}: Matches records where the date field is on tomorrow or any later date (tomorrow onwards).
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAY}: Matches records where the date field falls on the previous calendar day.
x-enumDescriptions.${YESTERDAYMINUS}: Matches records where the date field is on yesterday or any earlier date (up to and including yesterday).
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the entire previous calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTMONTH}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar month.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar week (Monday–Sunday).
x-enumDescriptions.${THISWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTWEEK}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar week.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${THISFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the current fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${LASTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${PREVFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the previous fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTYEAR}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next calendar year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFY}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal year.
x-enumDescriptions.${NEXTFQ}: Matches records where the date field falls within the next fiscal quarter.
x-enumDescriptions.${EMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has no value set.
x-enumDescriptions.${NOTEMPTY}: Matches records where the date field has a value set.

workflow_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionVal.description: Represents a predefined N-period range placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime, with the equal comparator. Follows the pattern ${NEXT_N_<PERIOD>:<n>} or ${LAST_N_<PERIOD>:<n>}, where PERIOD is DAYS, WEEKS, MONTHS, or YEARS and n is a positive integer. The current period is always excluded from the range.

Represents a predefined age or due-in-days placeholder value applicable only when the field's data_type is date or datetime. Follows the pattern ${AGEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field was exactly n days in the past, or ${DUEINDAYS}+<n> for records where the date field is exactly n days in the future. Supported comparators are equal, not_equal, less_than, greater_than, less_equal, and greater_equal.

workflow_rules__EqualFilterCriterionRequ.description: Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules__NotEqualFilterCriterionR.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the not-equal filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the not-equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the not-equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
not_equal - Matches records where the field value does not equal the specified filter value.

anyOf.description: Contains an array of filter values for the not_equal comparator.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the not_equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules__EqualityFilterCriterionR.description: Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

workflow_rules__TextFilterCriterionReque.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. The value must be a string scalar or array; use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based field types. Object and Boolean values are not supported. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the text filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the text filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the text comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern.
not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern.
starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string.
ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string.
contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string.
not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

value.description: Represents the string filter value used in the text comparator. Accepts a scalar string or an array of string values.

oneOf.description: Contains an array of primitive string values for the text filter comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules__OrderingFilterCriterionR.description: Represents a filter criterion for the less_than, less_equal, greater_than, and greater_equal comparators. The value must be a scalar; arrays and objects are not supported. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the ordering filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the ordering filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the ordering comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
less_than - Matches records where the field value is less than the specified filter value.
less_equal - Matches records where the field value is less than or equal to the specified filter value.
greater_than - Matches records where the field value is greater than the specified filter value.
greater_equal - Matches records where the field value is greater than or equal to the specified filter value.

value.description: Represents the scalar filter value used in the ordering comparator. Arrays and objects are not supported for ordering comparators.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules__BetweenFilterCriterionRe.description: Represents a filter criterion for the between and not_between comparators. The value must be an array of exactly two elements — [lower_bound, upper_bound]. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for date or datetime fields, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema. For formula fields, use formula.return_type as the effective data_type; for rollup_summary fields, use rollup_summary.return_type.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the range filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the range filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the range comparison operator applied to the criterion, indicating whether the field value falls within or outside the specified bounds.
Possible values:
between - Matches records where the field value falls within the specified range.
not_between - Matches records where the field value falls outside the specified range.

value.description: Contains the two boundary values — [lower_bound, upper_bound] — against which the field is evaluated for the between or not_between comparator.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules__SetFilterCriterionReques.description: Represents a filter criterion for the in and not_in comparators. The value must be an array of primitive values. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text-based types, and SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the set filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the set filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the set membership comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
in - Matches records where the field value is in the specified set of values.
not_in - Matches records where the field value is not in the specified set of values.

value.description: Contains an array of primitive filter values used in the set comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules__MultiSelectLookupFilterC.description: Represents a filter criterion for the include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup. The value must be an array of SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest lookup objects.

allOf.description: Represents the field reference constraint that requires the api_name property to be present for the multi-select lookup filter criterion.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the multi-select lookup filter criterion is applied. The field must have a data_type of multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

comparator.description:
Represents the multi-select lookup comparison operator applied to the criterion. Applicable only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Possible values:
