include_all - Matches records that include all specified lookup values.
include_any - Matches records that include at least one of the specified lookup values.
exclude_all - Matches records that exclude all specified lookup values.
exclude_any - Matches records that exclude at least one of the specified lookup values.

value.description: Contains an array of lookup object references used in the multi-select comparison.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

workflow_rules__SimpleFilterCriterionReq.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.

workflow_rules__GroupedFilterCriterionRe.description: Represents a grouped filter criterion containing multiple filter conditions evaluated with a logical operator. Supports recursive nesting for complex filtering logic.

group.description: Contains an array of filter conditions grouped together and evaluated with the specified logical operator.

group_operator.description:
Represents the logical operator applied between the filter conditions in the group.
Possible values:
AND - All conditions in the group must be satisfied.
OR - At least one condition in the group must be satisfied.
and - Equivalent to AND; all conditions in the group must be satisfied.
or - Equivalent to OR; at least one condition in the group must be satisfied.

workflow_rules__FilterCriterionRequest.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

workflow_rules__AutomationAssignToCriter.description: PURPOSE: assign_to entry for criteria-based ownership. Evaluates filter criteria against the triggering record at execution time. MANDATORY: type (const 'criteria'), details.criteria (filter condition - simple or grouped with AND/OR). Criteria fields must reference valid trigger module fields - GET /settings/fields?module={api_name}.
workflow_rules__AutomationAssignToCriter.x-zs-llm-description: assign_to entry where ownership is determined by evaluating filter criteria at runtime. type must be 'criteria'. criteria array defines the conditions  the first user matching all criteria becomes the owner. If no user matches, the action silently skips assignment.

type.description: Assignment method indicating criteria-based evaluation.

details.description: Contains the filter criteria to evaluate against the triggering record.

criteria.description: Filter criteria defining when this assignment applies. Can be a simple condition (field + comparator + value) or a grouped condition (group_operator + group array). The field references in criteria must be valid fields of the trigger module  - fetch available fields from GET /settings/fields?module={module_api_name}. For example: {"field": {"api_name": "Department"}, "comparator": "equal", "value": "Engineering"} assigns ownership when the record's Department is Engineering.

resource.description: Always null for criteria-based assignments. The owner is determined by the criteria evaluation logic.

allow_agent_user.description: Whether to allow assignment to an agent user or not. When true, the record can be assigned to an agent user also. When false, agent users are excluded from assignment. Applicable only for types: role, group, profile, merge_field, criteria. Not supported for types user and assignment_rule.

workflow_rules__AutomationAssignToCriter.title: Assign To Criteria Entry

workflow_rules__AutomationRelatedRecord.description: Identifies a related module whose open records' ownership should be transferred alongside the parent record. Used by assign_owner actions, field_updates (Owner field), and convert actions (change_owner.related_modules). Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules and actions. Contacts is available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts, and for convert when converting Leads. Deals is available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts or Contacts, and for convert when converting Leads (requires create_deal=true).
workflow_rules__AutomationRelatedRecord.x-zs-llm-description: Identifies a related module whose open records should also change ownership when the parent record's owner changes. Used by assign_owner (related_records array) and convert (change_owner.related_modules). Requires api_name and/or id to identify the child module. Valid modules depend on parent: for Leads  Events, Calls, Tasks, Contacts, Deals.

api_name.description: API name of the related module. Events, Calls, Tasks - open activity records, available for all modules and actions (assign_owner, convert). Contacts - available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts, and for convert when converting Leads. Deals - available for assign_owner when parent is Accounts or Contacts, and for convert when converting Leads (requires create_deal=true).

id.description: Unique identifier of the related module. This is the module ID corresponding to the api_name.

workflow_rules__AutomationRelatedRecord.title: Automation Related Record

workflow_rules__AutomationLookupFieldRef.description: Identifies a lookup field that links the workflow rule's trigger module to the target module of a cross-module action. For example, if the trigger module is Leads and the assign owner action targets Contacts, the lookup_field identifies which lookup field on Leads points to Contacts (e.g., Lookup_2_cont).
workflow_rules__AutomationLookupFieldRef.x-zs-llm-description: Identifies a lookup field linking the rule's trigger module to an action's target module. Required for cross-module field_updates (via related_details.lookup_field) and cross-module assign_owner (when targeting a different module). Both api_name and id should refer to the same lookup field  mismatch returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getFields filtered by field_type=lookup.

api_name.description: API name of the lookup field (e.g., Lookup_1_same, Lookup_2_cont).

id.description: Unique field ID of the lookup field.

workflow_rules__AutomationLookupFieldRef.title: Automation Lookup Field Reference

workflow_rules__AutomationAssignOwnerDet.description: PURPOSE: Details object for assign_owner action. Assigns/reassigns record owner via user, role, group, profile, assignment_rule, merge_field, or criteria. MANDATORY: module ({api_name, id} - must match trigger module), assign_to (array 1-5 entries). OPTIONAL: notify (bool), related_records ([{api_name, id}] - Tasks/Calls/Events), apply_assignment_threshold (bool), user_availability_based_on, lookup_field (for cross-module). EXAMPLE: {"module": {"api_name": "Leads", "id": "111111000000000175"}, "assign_to": [{"type": "user", "resource": {"id": "111111000000050001", "name": "John"}}], "notify": true}
workflow_rules__AutomationAssignOwnerDet.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='assign_owner'. assign_to array (1-5 entries) discriminates on type field: user/role/group/profile/assignment_rule require resource.id; merge_field requires details.api_name (user-type lookup field); criteria requires a criteria array evaluated at runtime. Optional: notify (bool), related_records (transfer child ownership), apply_assignment_threshold (bool). Module reference required.

module.description: Target module for the ownership assignment. Must match the workflow rule's trigger module for direct assignments, or the lookup field's related module for cross-module assignments. At least api_name or id must be provided; if both are given and they do not match, the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

assign_to.description: Specifies how the new owner is determined. Each entry defines an assignment method  - a specific user, role, group, assignment rule, profile, merge field, or criteria-based filter. For round-robin assignment across multiple users, provide multiple entries of type=user. For criteria-based assignment, provide a single entry of type=criteria with filter conditions.

items.description: Represents a single owner-assignment entry that determines how the new record owner is resolved. Each entry is one of three variants: AutomationAssignToResourceEntry (assigns ownership to a specific user, role, group, assignment rule, or profile), AutomationAssignToMergeFieldEntry (resolves the owner at runtime from a user-type lookup field on the trigger record), or AutomationAssignToCriteriaEntry (determines the owner by evaluating filter criteria at runtime).

related_records.description: Related modules whose open record ownership should also be transferred when the parent record is reassigned. Common activity modules (Tasks, Calls, Events) are available for all modules. Additional modules depend on the parent module: Accounts can also include Contacts and Deals; Contacts can also include Deals. Null when no related modules are selected for ownership transfer.

notify.description: Whether to send an email notification to the new owner when the record is reassigned. When true, the newly assigned owner receives an email informing them of the ownership change.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) when assigning ownership. When true, the system checks whether the new owner has reached their record limit before applying the assignment. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

user_availability_based_on.description: Restricts assignment to users who are currently available. When set to ["online_status"], only users logged in to the Zoho CRM web interface are eligible for assignment. If the selected user is offline, the assignment is skipped or deferred. Null means no availability check is applied.

items.description: Availability criterion. Currently only "online_status" is supported - restricts to users currently logged in to Zoho CRM web interface.

lookup_field.description: The lookup field linking the trigger module to the target module. Required only for cross-module assign owner actions (where the action's module differs from the workflow rule's trigger module). For same-module assignments, this field is omitted and the action operates directly on the triggering record.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this assign owner action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST or PUT requests.

workflow_rules__AutomationAssignOwnerDet.title: Automation Assign Owner Details

workflow_rules__AutomationLayoutRef.description: PURPOSE: Layout reference for create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call actions. MANDATORY: id (string). Determines field availability and validation rules. GET /settings/layouts?module={api_name} to discover.
workflow_rules__AutomationLayoutRef.x-zs-llm-description: Layout reference for create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call. id is mandatory  determines which fields are available and required for the target module. Obtain from getLayouts?module={api_name}. Wrong layout returns INVALID_DATA.

id.description: Unique layout ID. Required. Obtain from GET /settings/layouts?module={module_api_name}.

name.description: Display name of the layout. Optional in requests; present in GET responses.

display_label.description: Human-readable label of the layout. Present in GET responses.

workflow_rules__AutomationLayoutRef.title: Automation Layout Reference

workflow_rules__AutomationFieldAttribute.description: Identifies the target CRM field to which a mapping value is applied within an automation rule. The api_name and ID properties must both be supplied and must refer to the same field; a mismatch between the two causes an AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING error. Available fields for a given module can be discovered via GET /settings/fields?module={api_name}.
workflow_rules__AutomationFieldAttribute.x-zs-llm-description: Target field identifier. Both api_name and id are mandatory  providing only one still works but both should be given for reliability. If both provided and they refer to different fields: AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING. Obtain from getFields?module={module_api_name}. The field must be writable and compatible with mapping type.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the target field in the destination module — for example, Subject, Due_Date, or Owner — used to identify the field receiving the mapped value within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, and convert.

id.description: Represents the numeric identifier of the target CRM field. Used in conjunction with the field's API name, both of which must resolve to the same field for a mapping to be valid.

workflow_rules__AutomationFieldAttribute.title: Automation Field Attributes

workflow_rules__StaticStringValue.description: Represents a plain string value used as the static value for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields. Numeric values are expressed as strings rather than numeric literals. Picklist values must exactly match one of the options defined for the field.
workflow_rules__StaticStringValue.x-zs-llm-description: String value for type=static mappings. Applies to: text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, percentage fields. Numbers must be sent as strings (e.g., '100' not 100). Picklist values must match available options  invalid values return INVALID_DATA.

workflow_rules__StaticArrayValue.description: Represents an array of string values used as the static value for multiselectpicklist fields, where each element corresponds to an available picklist option. Valid option labels are retrievable from the GET /settings/fields endpoint filtered by data_type=multiselectpicklist.
workflow_rules__StaticArrayValue.x-zs-llm-description: Array value for type=static on multiselect_picklist fields. Each element must match an available picklist option. Discover valid options from getFields for the target module. Invalid options return INVALID_DATA.

items.description: A single picklist option string to include in the multi-select field value. Each entry corresponds to one selectable option as defined for the target field in Zoho CRM.

workflow_rules__StaticObjectValue.description: Represents an object value used as the static value for ownerlookup and layout fields, containing an ID that identifies the target user or layout and an optional name that the server resolves from the ID when not supplied. Typically used to assign record ownership by providing the user ID.
workflow_rules__StaticObjectValue.x-zs-llm-description: Object value for type=static on ownerlookup and layout fields. id is mandatory (user ID or layout ID). name is optional server resolves from id. Use getUsers for owner IDs, getLayouts for layout IDs.

id.description: The system identifier of the referenced entity, such as a user or layout record. This value drives entity resolution by the automation engine and must be provided when the target field references an entity.

name.description: The display name of the referenced entity, such as a user full name or a layout label. When omitted from a request payload, the server resolves and populates this property from the supplied ID. The property is present in all GET responses.

workflow_rules__StaticObjectValue.title: Static Object Value

workflow_rules__StaticFieldMapping.description: Represents a static-type mapping that assigns a literal value directly to the target field at execution time. The value shape varies by field data type: a plain string for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields (numeric values expressed as strings); an array of strings for multiselectpicklist fields; and an object containing ID and name for ownerlookup fields. Date, datetime, and ALARM fields do not support this type — use execution_time instead, as static on those fields produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Fields marked unique in the module settings also require merge_field rather than static for create_record actions.
workflow_rules__StaticFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='static' mapping. Value is used as-is without runtime resolution. NOT for Date/DateTime/ALARM fields (use execution_time  static returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). NOT for unique fields or formula fields. Value structure depends on field data_type: string for most fields, array for multiselect_picklist, object for ownerlookup/layout.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping strategy for this field assignment. The value must be `static`, which instructs the automation engine to assign a fixed, literal value to the target field at execution time rather than resolving it dynamically.

value.description: The literal value assigned to the target field at automation execution time. The expected shape is determined by the target field data_type, discoverable via GET /settings/fields?module={module}. For most field types, supply a string (for example, "High", "Not Started", "1234"). For multi-select picklist fields (data_type: multiselectpicklist), supply an array of option strings. For fields that reference an entity such as an owner or layout (data_type: ownerlookup), supply an object with at minimum the entity ID.

workflow_rules__StaticFieldMapping.title: Static Field Mapping

workflow_rules__MergeFieldStringValue.description: Represents the string value carried by a merge_field mapping, containing one or more runtime-resolved token references. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), lookup traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Tokens may be combined with surrounding text for multi-line field targets. Fields that hold a single typed value such as email or URL accept exactly one token.
workflow_rules__MergeFieldStringValue.x-zs-llm-description: String containing merge-field tokens for type=merge_field mappings. Resolved at runtime. Formats: ${!Module.Field} (direct access), ${!Module.Lookup.Field} (traverse lookup). Multiple tokens can be combined in one string. Unsupported tokens return UNSUPPORTED_MERGE_FIELD error.

workflow_rules__MergeFieldMapping.description: Represents a merge_field-type mapping whose value is resolved at execution time by substituting token references with live field data. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Applies to text-based fields such as Subject, Description, and custom text fields. Targeting owner or lookup fields with this type produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error; those fields require a static mapping using an object with a numeric identifier and an optional name. Multiple tokens may be chained with surrounding text for multi-line fields, while single-value fields such as email or URL accept exactly one token.
workflow_rules__MergeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='merge_field' mapping. Value contains ${!Module.Field} tokens resolved at execution time. ONLY for text-based fields (Subject, Description, etc.)  using on date/number/picklist fields returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Supports lookup traversal: ${!Module.Lookup.Field}. Multi-module not supported.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping strategy for this field assignment. The value must be `merge_field`, which instructs the automation engine to resolve the field value dynamically from a merge field token at execution time rather than from a static literal.

value.description: A string containing one or more ${!...} merge-field tokens resolved at runtime.

allow_agent_user.description:
Controls whether agent users are eligible for record assignment. Possible values:
**true** — agent users are included in the assignment pool alongside standard users.
**false** — agent users are excluded from assignment.
Applies to mapping types role, group, profile, merge_field, and criteria. Does not apply to user or assignment_rule types.

workflow_rules__MergeFieldMapping.title: Merge Field Mapping

workflow_rules__ExecutionTimeValue.description: Represents the offset configuration used by an execution_time mapping to compute a final date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime. Contains period (the time unit granularity), unit (the numeric magnitude expressed as a string integer), and trigger_field (a merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}). Date fields use period, unit, and trigger_field with an implied positive direction. Datetime fields additionally accept sign to control direction. ALARM fields additionally accept time and notify_type, and always require a minus sign. Workflow task actions restrict period to days or business_days.
workflow_rules__ExecutionTimeValue.x-zs-llm-description: Offset computation object for date/datetime/ALARM fields. Required fields: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (string integer  quantity), trigger_field (merge-field token like ${!Leads.Created_Time} or ${CURRENTTIME}). Optional: sign ('positive' for after, 'negative' for before  default varies by context). Missing required fields return DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING.

period.description:
The calendar or time unit applied to the offset. Possible values:
**days** — counts all calendar days including weekends and holidays; supported by every action type.
**business_days** — excludes weekends and requires the organisation's business-day setting to be enabled; supported by all action types.
**hours** — available only for create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call.
**minutes** — available only for create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call.
workflow_tasks accept only **days** or **business_days**.

unit.description: The number of period units to offset from the trigger date, supplied as a non-negative integer string (for example, "1", "30"). Passing "0" produces a same-day result, such as scheduling a Remind_At on the same day as the due date.

sign.description:
The direction of the offset relative to the trigger date. Possible values:
**plus** — places the computed value after the trigger (for example, a due date two days after record creation).
**minus** — places the computed value before the trigger (for example, a reminder one day before the due date).
For datetime fields (data_type=datetime) a value is expected; omitting it returns a DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error. For date-only fields (data_type=date) the value defaults to **plus** when absent. When targeting Remind_At (data_type=ALARM), **minus** is the only applicable direction.

trigger_field.description: The reference date or datetime field from which the offset is measured. Accepts a merge-field token that resolves to a Date or DateTime field on the parent module (for example, "${!Leads.Modified_Time}", "${!Tasks.Due_Date}"), or the reserved constant "${CURRENTTIME}" to use the automation execution timestamp. When computing a Remind_At (ALARM) value, "${!Tasks.Due_Date}" is the typical anchor.

time.description: The time-of-day component of the computed value, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (for example, "13:00", "01:30"). Applies when the target field carries data type datetime or ALARM (as reported by GET /settings/fields). Supplying this property for a date-only field (data_type=date) produces a validation error.

notify_type.description:
The notification channel used to deliver the reminder. Applies exclusively when the target field carries data type ALARM (i.e., Remind_At); date and datetime fields do not use this property. Possible values:
**popup** — triggers an in-app notification.
**email** — sends a message to the task owner.
**emailandpopup** — delivers both simultaneously.

workflow_rules__ExecutionTimeValue.title: Execution Time Value

workflow_rules__ExecutionTimeFieldMappin.description: Represents an execution_time-type field mapping that computes a date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime by applying a signed offset to a trigger field or the current time. The value carries an ExecutionTimeValue object specifying the period, unit, trigger_field, and optional time or notify_type properties. A plus sign places the result after the trigger; a minus sign places it before. ALARM fields always require minus. Workflow task actions support only days and business_days as period values.
workflow_rules__ExecutionTimeFieldMappin.x-zs-llm-description: type='execution_time' mapping. REQUIRED for Date, DateTime, and ALARM field types (static/merge_field on these returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). Computes value as offset from trigger_field. Value object needs: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (integer as string), trigger_field (merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}), sign (for before/after offset).

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping variant as an execution-time offset. The value is always "execution_time" for this schema and acts as the polymorphic discriminator across the AutomationFieldMappings union.

value.description: Execution-time object specifying how to compute the date/datetime offset from a reference field.

workflow_rules__ExecutionTimeFieldMappin.title: Execution Time Field Mapping

workflow_rules__CompositeFieldMapping.description: Represents a composite-type field mapping used exclusively for the Participants field in the Events module via the add_meeting action. The value carries a structured object that encodes participant data and is not applicable to any other field or automation action type.
workflow_rules__CompositeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='composite' mapping. Used ONLY for the Participants field in Events module (add_meeting action). Value is a structured object representing multiple participant entries. Cannot be used on other field types  returns NOT_ALLOWED.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Serves as the polymorphic discriminator that identifies this field mapping as a composite mapping; the value must be set to "composite" to select this schema variant.

value.description: Holds the structured composite object that encodes participant data for the Events module Participants field; the shape of this object varies according to the participant type configuration defined for the automation rule.

workflow_rules__CompositeFieldMapping.title: Composite Field Mapping

workflow_rules__AutomationFieldMappings.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping used within automation actions such as workflow tasks, create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call. Each mapping identifies a target field via api_name or ID, declares a type discriminator that determines value interpretation, and supplies a value whose shape varies by type: static supplies a literal value, merge_field supplies a runtime-resolved token string, execution_time supplies a date or datetime offset object, and composite supplies structured participant data for the Events Participants field. The field_mappings array must include all fields the target module requires; omitting any produces a REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND error.
workflow_rules__AutomationFieldMappings.x-zs-llm-description: A single field-to-value mapping entry used in create_record, add_meeting, schedule_call, convert, and workflow task actions. Each entry targets one field and assigns a typed value. The type field discriminates the value structure: static (literal), merge_field (runtime token), execution_time (date offset), composite (multi-value). field identifies the target, type selects the value schema, value provides the data.
workflow_rules__AutomationFieldMappings.title: Automation Field Mappings

workflow_rules__AutomationCreateRecordDe.description: PURPOSE: Details object for create_record action. Creates a record in a module with field values from static data, merge fields, or execution-time refs. NOT for Tasks/Events/Calls (use tasks, add_meeting, schedule_call). PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/modules for id. GET /settings/layouts?module={api_name} for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name, id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include all mandatory fields). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool). EXAMPLE: {"module": {"api_name": "Contacts", "id": "111111000000000129"}, "layout": {"id": "111111000000000403"}, "field_mappings": [{"field": {"api_name": "Last_Name"}, "type": "merge_field", "value": "${!Leads.Last_Name}"}]}
workflow_rules__AutomationCreateRecordDe.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='create_record'. Creates a record in a module (NOT Tasks/Events/Calls  use dedicated action types). Requires module ({api_name, id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (1-25 entries covering all mandatory fields). Each mapping has field reference, type (static|merge_field|execution_time|composite), and typed value. Optional: apply_restriction (bool).

module.description: Target module in which the new record will be created. Supported modules: Leads, Contacts, Potentials (Deals), Accounts, Products, Cases, custom modules, and team modules. NOT supported: Tasks, Events, Calls - use add_meeting for Events and schedule_call for Calls. Fetch available modules from GET /settings/modules. At least api_name or id must be provided; always use the full 19-digit module ID as returned by the modules API.

layout.description: Layout to use when creating the record. Determines which fields are available and their validation rules. Fetch valid layouts from GET /settings/layouts?module={module_api_name}. The layout.id is required.

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new record. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Last_Name"}, "type": "static", "value": "Test"}. Must include all mandatory fields (system_mandatory=true or api_mandatory=true from GET /settings/layouts?module={module}) - missing ones cause REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist, phone, number fields; NOT for Date/DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH) or unique fields (INVALID_DATA, check unique=true in GET /settings/fields). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Company} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner fields (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Date/DateTime/ALARM fields; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes; sign required for datetime fields.

items.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping entry for the new record, conforming to the AutomationFieldMappings schema. Each entry identifies the target field via a field reference and specifies the value resolution strategy through a type discriminator: static for literal values, merge_field for runtime token substitution, execution_time for dynamically resolved values, or composite for compound values.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this create record action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

workflow_rules__AutomationCreateRecordDe.title: Automation Create Record Details

workflow_rules__AutomationCreateConnecte.description: PURPOSE: Details object for create_connected_record action. Same as create_record but module must be a connected-record child of the rule's module. Requires ManageAutomation or ManageConnectedWorkflow permission. Not for Notes, Rebuy, Competitor Mentions. Limit: 1/rule. MANDATORY: module ({api_name, id} of child), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include all mandatory fields). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool).
workflow_rules__AutomationCreateConnecte.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='create_connected_record'. Same structure as create_record but module must be a connected-record child. Requires module, layout, field_mappings. Not for Notes, Rebuy, or Competitor Mentions. Requires ManageAutomation or ManageConnectedWorkflow permission. Limit 1/rule.

module.description: REQUIRED. Target child module for connected record creation. Must be a valid connected-record child module of the rule's module. Use GET /settings/modules to discover api_name and id.

api_name.description: Module API name.

id.description: Module ID.

layout.description: Represents a layout reference, conforming to the AutomationLayoutRef schema, that determines which layout is applied when creating the connected record. The id field is mandatory and governs which fields are available and required for the target module; valid layout identifiers are obtainable from GET /settings/layouts?module={api_name}.

field_mappings.description: REQUIRED. Field mapping array (1-25 entries). Use GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} to discover field api_name and id. All mandatory fields for the target module/layout must be included.

items.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping entry for the new connected record, conforming to the AutomationFieldMappings schema. Each entry identifies a target field via its api_name and id, and specifies the value resolution strategy: static for literal values, merge_field for runtime token substitution, execution_time for dynamically resolved values, or composite for compound values.

id.description: Read-only. Unique identifier for the action.

workflow_rules__AutomationMeetingDuratio.description: PURPOSE: Meeting duration for add_meeting. MANDATORY unless All_Day=true. REQUIRED: unit (integer - quantity), period (string - 'hours' or 'minutes'). Must be a JSON object (not int/string - INVALID_DATA). Omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND. If All_Day=true and provided, returns INVALID_DATA (field1/field2 conflict). EXAMPLE: {"unit": 1, "period": "hours"}
workflow_rules__AutomationMeetingDuratio.x-zs-llm-description: Duration config for add_meeting. Required when All_Day is not true. unit is the quantity (integer), period is the time unit ('hours', 'minutes', or 'days'). Omit entirely when mapping All_Day=true (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH if both present).

period.description: The time unit for the duration. "hours" - duration in hours (e.g., unit=1, period=hours means a 1-hour meeting). "minutes" - duration in minutes (e.g., unit=30, period=minutes means a 30-minute meeting).

workflow_rules__AutomationMeetingDuratio.title: Automation Meeting Duration

workflow_rules__AutomationHostUnavailabl.description: PURPOSE: Fallback when meeting host or caller is unavailable. Exactly ONE must be specified: assign_record_owner_as_host (bool) OR assign_task ({id}). Both = INVALID_DATA. Neither = EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING.
workflow_rules__AutomationHostUnavailabl.x-zs-llm-description: Fallback config when the meeting host or caller is unavailable. Exactly ONE option must be set: assign_record_owner_as_host (bool  record owner becomes host) OR assign_task ({id}  delegates to an existing task entity). Setting both or neither returns INVALID_DATA.

assign_record_owner_as_host.description: When true, the record owner is automatically assigned as the host/caller if the originally designated host is unavailable. Mutually exclusive with assign_task.

assign_task.description: A follow-up task to create when the host is unavailable. Mutually exclusive with assign_record_owner_as_host. The task must be pre-configured in the CRM.

name.description: Name of the follow-up task.

id.description: Unique ID of the pre-configured task.

workflow_rules__AutomationHostUnavailabl.title: Automation Host Unavailable

workflow_rules__AutomationAddMeetingDeta.description: PURPOSE: Details object for add_meeting action. Creates an Event record when workflow fires. PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/layouts?module=Events for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module=Events for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name: 'Events', id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include Event_Title, Start_DateTime), meeting_duration ({unit: int, period: 'hours'|'minutes'} - NOT when All_Day=true), host_unavailable ({assign_record_owner_as_host: true} or {assign_task: {id}}). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool).
workflow_rules__AutomationAddMeetingDeta.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='add_meeting'. Creates an Event record. Requires module (Events), layout, field_mappings (must include Event_Title, Start_DateTime), meeting_duration ({unit, period}  omit when All_Day=true), host_unavailable (exactly one of: assign_record_owner_as_host=true OR assign_task={id}). Optional: apply_restriction.

module.description: Target module for the meeting. Must be the Events module. Provide either api_name ("Events") or the Events module id.

layout.description: Layout to use when creating the Event record. Determines which fields are available and their validation rules. Fetch valid layouts from GET /settings/layouts?module=Events. The layout.id is required.

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new Event. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Event_Title"}, "type": "static", "value": "Meeting"}. Must include all mandatory fields from GET /settings/layouts?module=Events. Common fields: Event_Title, Start_DateTime, All_Day, Participants (composite type), Remind_At. End_DateTime is auto-computed from Start_DateTime + meeting_duration - do NOT provide it. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist fields; NOT for DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Company} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Start_DateTime and Remind_At; sign required for datetime; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes. When All_Day=true, period must be "days" and omit meeting_duration.

items.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping entry for the new Event record, conforming to the AutomationFieldMappings schema. Each entry identifies a target Event field and specifies the value resolution strategy: static for literal values, merge_field for runtime token substitution, or execution_time for dynamically resolved DateTime and ALARM fields.

meeting_duration.description: Duration of the meeting. Specifies a numeric value and time period (e.g., 1 hour, 30 minutes). Required when All_Day is not set to true in field_mappings. If All_Day is true, meeting_duration must not be provided  - the API returns INVALID_DATA with field1/field2 conflict details.

host_unavailable.description: Fallback behavior when the designated meeting host is unavailable. Either assign the record owner as host (assign_record_owner_as_host=true) or create a follow-up task (assign_task with a pre-configured task ID). Exactly one option must be specified; providing both returns INVALID_DATA with field1/field2 conflict, providing neither returns EXPECTED_FIELD_MISSING.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the Event record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this add meeting action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

workflow_rules__AutomationAddMeetingDeta.title: Automation Add Meeting Details

workflow_rules__AutomationScheduleCallDe.description: PURPOSE: Details object for schedule_call action. Creates a Call record when workflow fires. PREREQUISITES: GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls for layout + mandatory fields. GET /settings/fields?module=Calls for field ids. MANDATORY: module ({api_name: 'Calls', id}), layout ({id}), field_mappings (array 1-25, include Subject, Call_Type). OPTIONAL: apply_restriction (bool). KEY FIELDS: Subject, Call_Type ('Outbound'|'Inbound'|'Missed'), Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At.
workflow_rules__AutomationScheduleCallDe.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='schedule_call'. Creates a Calls record. Requires module (Calls), layout, field_mappings (must include Subject). Key fields: Subject, Call_Purpose, Call_Type, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Same field_mapping structure as create_record. Optional: apply_restriction.

module.description: Target module for the call. Must be the Calls module. Provide either api_name ("Calls") or the Calls module id.

layout.description: Layout to use when creating the Call record. Determines which fields are available and their validation rules. Fetch valid layouts from GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls. The layout.id is required.

field_mappings.description: Field mappings for the new Call. Each entry: {"field": {"api_name": "Subject"}, "type": "static", "value": "Follow-up"}. Must include all mandatory fields from GET /settings/layouts?module=Calls. Call_Type is system-mandatory (values: "Outbound", "Inbound", "Missed") - omitting returns REQUIRED_DATA_NOT_FOUND. Common fields: Subject, Call_Type, Call_Purpose, Call_Start_Time, Remind_At. Mapping types: static - literal values for text, picklist fields; NOT for DateTime/ALARM (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). merge_field - runtime tokens like ${!Leads.Phone} for text-based fields; NOT for lookup/owner (DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). execution_time - REQUIRED for Call_Start_Time and Remind_At; sign required for datetime; periods: days, business_days, hours, minutes.

items.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping entry for the new Call record, conforming to the AutomationFieldMappings schema. Each entry identifies a target Call field and specifies the value resolution strategy: static for literal values, merge_field for runtime token substitution, or execution_time for dynamically resolved DateTime and ALARM fields.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the record owner when creating the Call record. When true, the system checks whether the owner has reached their record limit before creating the record. Only effective when the org has assignment thresholds configured.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this schedule call action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

workflow_rules__AutomationScheduleCallDe.title: Automation Schedule Call Details

workflow_rules__AutomationTagRef.description: PURPOSE: Tag reference for add_tags/remove_tags. Tags must pre-exist - GET /settings/tags?module={api_name} to list, POST to create. MANDATORY: id, name. Both must resolve to same tag (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING if mismatch). Non-existent = INVALID_DATA. Limits: 100 tags/module, 10 tags/record, name max 25 chars.
workflow_rules__AutomationTagRef.x-zs-llm-description: Tag reference for add_tags/remove_tags. Both id and name are mandatory  missing either returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND. Tags must pre-exist. Discover via getTags?module={api_name}, create via POST /settings/tags. Invalid tag id returns INVALID_DATA.

id.description: Unique identifier of the tag. Obtain from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If provided alone, the tag is resolved by ID. If both id and name are provided, they must resolve to the same tag.

name.description: Name of the tag. Obtain from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If provided alone, the tag is resolved by name. Must match an existing tag  - providing a non-existent name returns INVALID_DATA. Max 25 characters, cannot contain <, >, commas, or emojis.

color_code.description: Hex color code of the tag (e.g., '#879BFC'). Optional in requests; present in GET responses. Allowed values: #F17574, #F48435, #E7A826, #A8C026, #63C57E, #1DB9B4, #57B1FD, #879BFC, #D297EE, #FD87BD, #969696, #658BA8, #B88562.

workflow_rules__AutomationTagRef.title: Automation Tag Reference

workflow_rules__AutomationAddTagsDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for add_tags action. Adds pre-existing tags to the triggering record. PREREQUISITES: Tags must exist - GET /settings/tags?module={api_name} to list, POST to create first. MANDATORY: tags (array 1-10, each {id, name}). OPTIONAL: over_write (bool, default false - true replaces ALL existing tags), module ({api_name, id}). CONSTRAINTS: Not allowed with convert on Leads (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). over_write=true + remove_tags in same rule = INVALID_DATA. Unsupported: Visits, Users, LinkingModules (NOT_ALLOWED).
workflow_rules__AutomationAddTagsDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='add_tags'. Requires tags array (1-10, each {id, name}). Optional: over_write (true replaces all existing tags), module ({api_name, id}). Cannot coexist with convert on Leads. over_write=true + remove_tags in same rule = INVALID_DATA. Tags must pre-exist  discover via getTags or create via POST.

over_write.description: Whether to overwrite all existing tags on the record with the specified tags (true) or append to existing tags (false). Default is false. When set to true, any RemoveTags action in the same workflow rule becomes invalid and returns INVALID_DATA ('Remove tag not supported with Overwrite Add Tag').

tags.description: List of tags to add to the record. All tags must pre-exist in the org  - fetch available tags from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. To create new tags: POST /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If the list is empty after parsing, the API returns FAILURE ('Empty Tag'). If the tag count exceeds the edition limit, the API returns FAILURE ('Invalid Tag Count').

items.description: Represents a tag reference, conforming to the AutomationTagRef schema, that identifies a pre-existing org tag to be added to the record. Both id and name are mandatory fields on each entry; the referenced tag must already exist in the org before the action executes.

module.description: Target module for the tag action. Must match the workflow rule's trigger module. Supported modules: Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Deals, Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, Events, Calls, Solutions, Products, Vendors, Price_Books, Quotes, Sales_Orders, Purchase_Orders, Invoices, and custom modules. Unsupported modules (Visits, Users, LinkingModules) return NOT_ALLOWED.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this add tags action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

workflow_rules__AutomationAddTagsDetails.title: Automation Add Tags Details

workflow_rules__AutomationRemoveTagsDeta.description: PURPOSE: Details object for remove_tags action. Removes tags from the triggering record. PREREQUISITES: Tags must exist - GET /settings/tags?module={api_name} to list. MANDATORY: tags (array 1-10, each {id, name}). OPTIONAL: module ({api_name, id}). CONSTRAINTS: Not allowed with convert on Leads (AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING). If same rule has add_tags with over_write=true, this returns INVALID_DATA. Unsupported: Visits, Users, LinkingModules (NOT_ALLOWED). Note: over_write field is type-checked but its value is ignored for remove_tags.
workflow_rules__AutomationRemoveTagsDeta.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='remove_tags'. Requires tags array (1-10, each {id, name}). Optional: module ({api_name, id}). Cannot coexist with convert on Leads. Invalid if same rule has add_tags with over_write=true. Tags must already exist on the record for removal to have effect.

tags.description: List of tags to remove from the record. All tags must pre-exist in the org  - fetch available tags from GET /settings/tags?module={module_api_name}. If the list is empty after parsing, the API returns FAILURE ('Empty Tag'). If the tag count exceeds the edition limit, the API returns FAILURE ('Invalid Tag Count').

items.description: Represents a tag reference, conforming to the AutomationTagRef schema, that identifies a pre-existing org tag to be removed from the record. Both id and name are mandatory fields on each entry; the referenced tag must already exist in the org before the action executes.

module.description: Target module for the tag action. Must match the workflow rule's trigger module. Supported modules: Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Deals, Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, Events, Calls, Solutions, Products, Vendors, Price_Books, Quotes, Sales_Orders, Purchase_Orders, Invoices, and custom modules. Unsupported modules (Visits, Users, LinkingModules) return NOT_ALLOWED.

over_write.description: Present in GET responses. Its value is ignored for remove_tags actions.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this remove tags action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST or PUT requests.

workflow_rules__AutomationRemoveTagsDeta.title: Automation Remove Tags Details

workflow_rules__AutomationConvertChangeO.description: PURPOSE: Owner assignment during convert action. MANDATORY: id (user ID from GET /users). OPTIONAL: name, related_modules ([{api_name, id}] - which converted modules get new owner), apply_assignment_threshold (bool). For Leads: related_modules can include Events, Calls, Tasks, Contacts, Deals.
workflow_rules__AutomationConvertChangeO.x-zs-llm-description: Owner configuration during convert action. id (user ID) is mandatory  specifies who receives ownership of converted records. Optional: name, related_modules (which converted childmodules get new owner  e.g., Events, Calls, Tasks for Leads), apply_assignment_threshold (enforce per-user record limits). Obtain user ID from getUsers.

id.description: Unique user ID of the new owner. Obtain from GET /users. Must be an active user with permissions on the target modules.

name.description: Full name of the new owner. Optional  - present in GET responses for display purposes.

related_modules.description: List of target modules whose records should receive the new owner during conversion. Reuses the same related-record concept as assign_owner. For Leads conversion: Events, Calls, Tasks, Contacts, Deals are valid. For Quotes/SalesOrders conversion: only Events, Calls, Tasks are valid.

items.description: Represents a related module reference, conforming to the AutomationRelatedRecord schema, that identifies a child module whose records should also receive the new owner assignment during the conversion operation. At least one of api_name or id is required to identify the child module.

apply_assignment_threshold.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules (record count limits per user) on the new owner for each converted module. When true, the system checks whether the new owner has reached their record limit before assigning ownership.

workflow_rules__AutomationConvertChangeO.title: Automation Convert Change Owner

workflow_rules__AutomationConvertDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for convert action. Converts records - Leads to Contacts+Accounts+Deals, Quotes to SalesOrders/Invoices, SalesOrders to Invoices. PREREQUISITES: criteria_details.criteria MUST be non-null (NOT_ALLOWED otherwise). Module MUST be Leads/Quotes/Sales_Orders. MANDATORY (Leads): add_to_existing_contact (bool), add_to_existing_account (bool). MANDATORY (Quotes/Sales_Orders): convert_to ({api_name, id}). OPTIONAL: change_owner, carry_tags (ARRAY [{api_name, id}] NOT boolean), field_mappings (max 25), move_attachment_to, create_deal (Leads only), contact_role (with create_deal). CONSTRAINTS: No add_tags/remove_tags with convert on Leads. No scheduled actions with convert.
workflow_rules__AutomationConvertDetails.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='convert'. Converts records across modules (Leads→Contacts+Accounts+Deals, Quotes→SalesOrders/Invoices, SalesOrders→Invoices). Limit 1/rule. For Leads: add_to_existing_contact, add_to_existing_account, change_owner mandatory. For Quotes/SalesOrders: convert_to required. Optional: create_deal, carry_tags (array not boolean), field_mappings, move_attachment_to, contact_role. No scheduled actions allowed alongside convert.

add_to_existing_contact.description: MANDATORY for Leads conversion (omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND). Whether to link the converted record to an existing Contact instead of creating a new one. Only applicable for Leads module. When true, if a matching Contact exists (based on duplicate-check criteria), the Lead is merged into it rather than creating a new Contact. Not applicable for Quotes or Sales_Orders conversions.

add_to_existing_account.description: MANDATORY for Leads conversion (omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND). Whether to link the converted record to an existing Account instead of creating a new one. Only applicable for Leads module. When true, if a matching Account exists (based on Company name), the Lead is linked to it rather than creating a new Account. Not applicable for Quotes or Sales_Orders conversions.

move_attachment_to.description: Target module to which attachments from the source record should be moved during conversion. For Leads: typically Contacts or Accounts. For Quotes/SalesOrders: the target conversion module. Provide api_name and/or id.

carry_tags.description: List of target modules that should inherit tags from the source record during conversion. For Leads: may include Contacts, Accounts, Deals. Each entry identifies a module by api_name and/or id.

items.description: Represents a module reference, conforming to the AutomationModuleRef schema, that identifies a target module whose records should inherit tags from the source record during conversion. At least one of api_name or id is required to identify the module; valid values are obtainable from GET /settings/modules.

field_mappings.description: List of field-value pairs to populate in the converted record(s). Each entry maps a target field to a value using one of the supported types: static, merge_field, or execution_time. For Leads conversion, field mappings can target Contacts, Accounts, and Deals modules. Fetch available fields from GET /settings/fields?module={target_module_api_name}.

items.description: Represents a single field-to-value mapping entry for the converted record, conforming to the AutomationFieldMappings schema. Each entry identifies the target field and specifies the value resolution strategy: static for literal values, merge_field for runtime token substitution, or execution_time for dynamically resolved values.

create_deal.description: Whether to create a Deal record as part of Leads conversion. Only applicable when the trigger module is Leads. When true, the Deal module field mappings in field_mappings are used to populate the new Deal.

change_owner.description: New owner assignment for the converted records. Specifies the user (by id) who should own the converted records, which modules should receive the new owner (via related_modules), and whether to enforce assignment thresholds. When omitted, the source record's owner is retained.

contact_role.description: Unique ID of the Contact Role to assign when a Deal is created during Leads conversion. Only applicable when create_deal=true. Obtain valid Contact Role IDs from GET /Contacts/roles.

convert_to.description: MANDATORY for Quotes and Sales_Orders conversion (omitting returns MANDATORY_NOT_FOUND). Identifies the target module for conversion as an object with api_name and id. For Quotes: convert_to can be {api_name: 'SalesOrders', id: '<module_id>'} or {api_name: 'Invoices', id: '<module_id>'}. For Sales_Orders: convert_to must be {api_name: 'Invoices', id: '<module_id>'}. Obtain the module id from GET /settings/modules. Not applicable for Leads conversion (Leads always convert to Contacts+Accounts, optionally +Deals).

api_name.description: API name of the target module. For Quotes: 'SalesOrders' or 'Invoices'. For Sales_Orders: 'Invoices'.

id.description: Unique 19-digit module ID of the target module. Obtain from GET /settings/modules. Always use the full 19-digit ID as returned by the API; truncated IDs cause INVALID_DATA.

portal_user_type.description: Portal user type to assign during Leads conversion. Only applicable when the org has portals configured and the converted Contact should be provisioned as a portal user. The id and name must match an existing portal user type - validated against the org's portal metadata (CrmClientPortalFilterUtil). Not applicable for Quotes or Sales_Orders conversions.

id.description: Unique identifier of the portal user type. Must match an existing portal user type in the org's portal configuration.

name.description: Display name of the portal user type.

apply_restriction.description: Whether to enforce assignment-threshold rules on the record owner during conversion. Present in GET responses.

id.description: Server-generated unique identifier for this convert action. Present only in GET responses; not required in POST requests.

workflow_rules__AutomationConvertDetails.title: Automation Convert Details

workflow_rules__AutomationChatNotificati.description: PURPOSE: Details object for chat notification actions (slack/cliq/cisco/google_chat/microsoft_teams_notifications). Sends a message to a channel, user, or field-based recipient. Limit: 1 per type per rule. MANDATORY: message (string, supports ${Module.Field} merge fields), notify_to (object with type: 'user'|'channel'|'fields'). For user/channel: provide id + name. For fields: provide module + notify_fields.fields array. EXAMPLE: {"message": "New deal ${Deals.Deal_Name}", "notify_to": {"type": "channel", "id": "C0123", "name": "#sales"}}
workflow_rules__AutomationChatNotificati.x-zs-llm-description: Details for chat notification actions (type=slack_notifications|cliq_notifications|cisco_notifications|google_chat_notifications|microsoft_teams_notifications). Requires message (string, supports ${Module.Field} merge tokens) and notify_to ({type: user|channel|fields}). For user/channel: provide id + name. For fields: provide module + notify_fields.fields array. Limit 1 per chat type per rule.

message.description: REQUIRED. Notification message body. Supports merge fields in ${Module.Field} format (e.g., "New deal ${Deals.Deal_Name} created by ${Deals.Owner}!").

notify_to.description: REQUIRED. Notification target  - a channel, user, or field-based recipient.

type.description: Target type. 'user'  - send to a specific chat user. 'channel'  - send to a chat channel. 'fields'  - send to users resolved from CRM field values.

id.description: Required for user/channel types. The integration-specific user or channel ID.

name.description: Required for user/channel types. Display name of the user or channel (e.g., '#sales-alerts').

module.description: Required for type='fields'. The CRM module to resolve field values from. Use GET /settings/modules to discover api_name and id.

id.description: Module ID.

api_name.description: Module API name.

notify_fields.description: Required for type='fields'. Field references to resolve notification recipients.

fields.description: Array of field references. Each must have api_name and optionally id. If both given, cross-validated for consistency (AMBIGUITY_DUE_TO if mismatch).

items.description: A field reference with api_name and optional id.

id.description: Field ID.

api_name.description: Field API name. Use GET /settings/fields?module={api_name} to discover.

items.description: A static field reference with api_name and optional id.

id.description: Static field ID.

api_name.description: Static field API name.

id.description: Read-only. Unique identifier for the action, returned in GET responses.

workflow_rules__AutomationCircuitsDetail.description: PURPOSE: Details object for circuits action. Executes a Zoho Circuits workflow. Limit: 1/rule. MANDATORY: circuit_id (string). EXAMPLE: {"circuit_id": "7389640000001234"}
workflow_rules__AutomationCircuitsDetail.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='circuits'. Executes a Zoho Circuits workflow. Requires circuit_id (string  the Circuits workflow identifier). Limit 1/rule. Verify 'circuits' is enabled via getWorkflowConfigurations before using.

id.description: Read-only. Unique identifier for the action.

workflow_rules__AutomationZohoFlowDetail.description: PURPOSE: Details object for flow action. Triggers a Zoho Flow custom action. Limit: 1/rule. Fetch values from `getCustomActions` (filter service_type='zoho_flow', component_type='workflow'): use response `id` as custom_action_id, `action_name` as custom_action_name. MANDATORY: custom_action_id (string), custom_action_name (string). EXAMPLE: {"custom_action_id": "4839491000001566002", "custom_action_name": "Sync to ERP"}
workflow_rules__AutomationZohoFlowDetail.x-zs-llm-description: Details for type='flow'. Triggers a Zoho Flow custom action. Requires custom_action_id and custom_action_name (obtain from getCustomActions filtered by service_type='zoho_flow', component_type='workflow'). Limit 1/rule. Verify 'flow' is enabled via getWorkflowConfigurations.

custom_action_id.description: REQUIRED. Zoho Flow custom action ID. Value = `id` from `getCustomActions` response.

custom_action_name.description: REQUIRED. Display name of the Zoho Flow action. Value = `action_name` from `getCustomActions` response.

id.description: Read-only. Unique identifier for the action.

workflow_rules__AutomationSocialDetails.description: PURPOSE: Details object for social actions (Facebook/Twitter). Available only with fb_*/tw_* triggers. Limit: 1 per type per rule. content is REQUIRED for comment_to_post, reply_to_comment, reply_to_message, reply_to_tweet. NOT required for like_to_comment, retweet. Supports ${Module.Field} merge fields. EXAMPLE: {"content": "Thanks ${Leads.Full_Name}!"}

workflow_tasks__StaticFieldMapping.description: Represents a static-type mapping that assigns a literal value directly to the target field at execution time. The value shape varies by field data type: a plain string for text, picklist, phone, email, URL, number, decimal, currency, and percentage fields (numeric values expressed as strings); an array of strings for multiselectpicklist fields; and an object containing ID and name for ownerlookup fields. Date, datetime, and ALARM fields do not support this type — use execution_time instead, as static on those fields produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. Fields marked unique in the module settings also require merge_field rather than static for create_record actions.
workflow_tasks__StaticFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='static' mapping. Value is used as-is without runtime resolution. NOT for Date/DateTime/ALARM fields (use execution_time  static returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). NOT for unique fields or formula fields. Value structure depends on field data_type: string for most fields, array for multiselect_picklist, object for ownerlookup/layout.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping strategy for this field assignment. The value must be `static`, which instructs the automation engine to assign a fixed, literal value to the target field at execution time rather than resolving it dynamically.

value.description: The literal value assigned to the target field at automation execution time. The expected shape is determined by the target field data_type, discoverable via GET /settings/fields?module={module}. For most field types, supply a string (for example, "High", "Not Started", "1234"). For multi-select picklist fields (data_type: multiselectpicklist), supply an array of option strings. For fields that reference an entity such as an owner or layout (data_type: ownerlookup), supply an object with at minimum the entity ID.

workflow_tasks__MergeFieldStringValue.description: Represents the string value carried by a merge_field mapping, containing one or more runtime-resolved token references. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), lookup traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Tokens may be combined with surrounding text for multi-line field targets. Fields that hold a single typed value such as email or URL accept exactly one token.
workflow_tasks__MergeFieldStringValue.x-zs-llm-description: String containing merge-field tokens for type=merge_field mappings. Resolved at runtime. Formats: ${!Module.Field} (direct access), ${!Module.Lookup.Field} (traverse lookup). Multiple tokens can be combined in one string. Unsupported tokens return UNSUPPORTED_MERGE_FIELD error.

workflow_tasks__MergeFieldMapping.description: Represents a merge_field-type mapping whose value is resolved at execution time by substituting token references with live field data. Supports direct field tokens (${!Module.Field}), traversal tokens (${!Module.Lookup.Field}), and system tokens (${CURRENTTIME}, ${CURRENTUSER}). Applies to text-based fields such as Subject, Description, and custom text fields. Targeting owner or lookup fields with this type produces a DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error; those fields require a static mapping using an object with a numeric identifier and an optional name. Multiple tokens may be chained with surrounding text for multi-line fields, while single-value fields such as email or URL accept exactly one token.
workflow_tasks__MergeFieldMapping.x-zs-llm-description: type='merge_field' mapping. Value contains ${!Module.Field} tokens resolved at execution time. ONLY for text-based fields (Subject, Description, etc.)  using on date/number/picklist fields returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH. Supports lookup traversal: ${!Module.Lookup.Field}. Multi-module not supported.

display_value.description: The server-computed representation of the mapped value, included in GET responses. Omitted from create and update requests.

field.description: Target field to populate when the automation executes. api_name is required. If id is also provided, both must refer to the same field; otherwise the API returns AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING.

type.description: Identifies the mapping strategy for this field assignment. The value must be `merge_field`, which instructs the automation engine to resolve the field value dynamically from a merge field token at execution time rather than from a static literal.

value.description: A string containing one or more ${!...} merge-field tokens resolved at runtime.

allow_agent_user.description:

**false** — agent users are excluded from assignment.
Applies to mapping types role, group, profile, merge_field, and criteria. Does not apply to user or assignment_rule types.

workflow_tasks__ExecutionTimeValue.description: Represents the offset configuration used by an execution_time mapping to compute a final date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime. Contains period (the time unit granularity), unit (the numeric magnitude expressed as a string integer), and trigger_field (a merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}). Date fields use period, unit, and trigger_field with an implied positive direction. Datetime fields additionally accept sign to control direction. ALARM fields additionally accept time and notify_type, and always require a minus sign. Workflow task actions restrict period to days or business_days.
workflow_tasks__ExecutionTimeValue.x-zs-llm-description: Offset computation object for date/datetime/ALARM fields. Required fields: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (string integer  quantity), trigger_field (merge-field token like ${!Leads.Created_Time} or ${CURRENTTIME}). Optional: sign ('positive' for after, 'negative' for before  default varies by context). Missing required fields return DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING.

period.description:
The calendar or time unit applied to the offset. Possible values:
**days** — counts all calendar days including weekends and holidays; supported by every action type.
**business_days** — excludes weekends and requires the organisation's business-day setting to be enabled; supported by all action types.
**hours** — available only for create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call.
**minutes** — available only for create_record, add_meeting, and schedule_call.
workflow_tasks accept only **days** or **business_days**.

unit.description: The number of period units to offset from the trigger date, supplied as a non-negative integer string (for example, "1", "30"). Passing "0" produces a same-day result, such as scheduling a Remind_At on the same day as the due date.

sign.description:
The direction of the offset relative to the trigger date. Possible values:
**plus** — places the computed value after the trigger (for example, a due date two days after record creation).
**minus** — places the computed value before the trigger (for example, a reminder one day before the due date).
For datetime fields (data_type=datetime) a value is expected; omitting it returns a DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING error. For date-only fields (data_type=date) the value defaults to **plus** when absent. When targeting Remind_At (data_type=ALARM), **minus** is the only applicable direction.

trigger_field.description: The reference date or datetime field from which the offset is measured. Accepts a merge-field token that resolves to a Date or DateTime field on the parent module (for example, "${!Leads.Modified_Time}", "${!Tasks.Due_Date}"), or the reserved constant "${CURRENTTIME}" to use the automation execution timestamp. When computing a Remind_At (ALARM) value, "${!Tasks.Due_Date}" is the typical anchor.

time.description: The time-of-day component of the computed value, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (for example, "13:00", "01:30"). Applies when the target field carries data type datetime or ALARM (as reported by GET /settings/fields). Supplying this property for a date-only field (data_type=date) produces a validation error.

notify_type.description:
The notification channel used to deliver the reminder. Applies exclusively when the target field carries data type ALARM (i.e., Remind_At); date and datetime fields do not use this property. Possible values:
**popup** — triggers an in-app notification.
**email** — sends a message to the task owner.
**emailandpopup** — delivers both simultaneously.

workflow_tasks__ExecutionTimeValue.title: Execution Time Value

workflow_tasks__ExecutionTimeFieldMappin.description: Represents an execution_time-type field mapping that computes a date, datetime, or ALARM value at runtime by applying a signed offset to a trigger field or the current time. The value carries an ExecutionTimeValue object specifying the period, unit, trigger_field, and optional time or notify_type properties. A plus sign places the result after the trigger; a minus sign places it before. ALARM fields always require minus. Workflow task actions support only days and business_days as period values.
workflow_tasks__ExecutionTimeFieldMappin.x-zs-llm-description: type='execution_time' mapping. REQUIRED for Date, DateTime, and ALARM field types (static/merge_field on these returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH). Computes value as offset from trigger_field. Value object needs: period ('days'|'hours'|'minutes'), unit (integer as string), trigger_field (merge token or ${CURRENTTIME}), sign (for before/after offset).
